projects.title: Show HN: I found a new planetary candidate in Kepler Data with AI
projects.author: kuberwastaken
projects.summary: Hey HN! I was playing around with the Kepler and TESS data last weekend when I hacked around a way to pixel-peep stars dimming periodically to potentially find new exoplanets with Codex. I ended up running the engine to find an interesting signal in Kepler data that was uncatalogued with a dip repeating every 13.77 days around KIC 5689121, a red dwarf in Lyra about 970 light-years away. If it's a planet, it'd be roughly 2.5–3 times Earth's radius ! Funnily enough, this candidate is just 7.1 arcseconds from a much brighter neighbour (KIC 5689116) and is very hard to see because of how much brighter it is (probably why it went unnoticed for so long) Of course, there's work to do before calling it confirmed - my TRICERATOPS analysis is about 6.9% and we have to get IR/AO / Keck observations to prove it's out there ! (which I'm honestly intimidated by but cautiously optimistic about because I've never worked in non-CS adjacent research) but I found the activity of making cool tools to potentially discover things about our universe quite fun ! Would love feedback, especially from anyone who's worked with Kepler data or exoplanet validation :) https://x.com/kuberwastaken/status/2109240782368751834

projects.title: Show HN: shadowclone, skills learned from your coding agent corrections
projects.author: theonly1me
projects.summary: shadowclone reads the coding-agent sessions already on your disk, finds where you corrected the agent and turns those corrections into skills your agents load next time. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and Antigravity. Every capture source is off by default and has its own consent setting. Why I'm building it? I use multiple harnesses and agents, I extensively use Claud Code and Codex, but I also use Cursor and Antigravity every now and then. I didn't want to have to teach every harness or model the things I taught the other ones between my last session and the current one. I also cannot have my personal rules and preferences in all the repositories I work on because my collaborators may have varying levels of trust with AI and their own preferences. shadowclone helps me build and improve trust with my agents so I can give them more autonomy while running multiple sessions in parallel. --- Who is this for? If you only use Claude or Codex or any one of these, you may not need the shadowclone CLI and the harness and agent you use might already be sufficient. But, if you are like me and work across harnesses and agents, shadowclone will help you avoid repeating your preferences each time. --- Built-in skills and skill builds shadowclone is also great for someone who is just now adopting AI into their coding workflows because it ships with several skills that they can use to customize their agent's behavior. They can equip all the skills, or just some of them, they'll see the "personality" their agent gets from equipping those skills from the `shadowclone wizard`. --- Setup is extremely easy, just ask your Claude Code, or Codex, or another agent - "Set up shadowclone: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/mai... " --- Privacy shadowclone is free and open source, it uses the MIT license. It doesn't have a subscription, or a server. It just uses your existing agent subscription i.e. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, or even your local model via Pi. You can explicitly disable sources, it also redacts any and all sensitive information it uses for learning. --- PR reviews and Cloud bots It can review PRs with the `shadowclone review` command, it ships a guided review skill that will perform a deep review of your code (or someone else's) and produce an HTML document you can annotate, add comments to and submit so your agent can stage a draft review on the PR you are reviewing. --- Evals I performed several evals, I won't describe them here, all of them are available in the repository - https://github.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/tree/main/evals --- Comparison to other tools? You can also see how it compares to other tools here - https://github.com/theonly1me/shadowclone/tree/main#how-shad...

projects.title: Show HN: PanamaKVM – direct-booting Linux from Java 25 via FFM/KVM
projects.author: rusanoph
projects.summary: Hi HN! PanamaKVM is an experimental miniVM containing the bare minimum components needed to boot an x86 Linux kernel and run an interactive terminal. Its key feature is that it is built on top of Java 25 without using JNI. Instead, it utilizes the Foreign Function & Memory API (FFM). I generally stick to Java LTS versions - having worked with Java 21 for a long time - so I recently decided to check if any new LTS releases had come out. It turns out I was a year late to the party regarding Java 25. While looking through the changelog, I noticed the new FFM for native code and decided to give it a try. As it turned out, I was a couple of years late to the FFM feature :D, since it had already been introduced as a full-fledged part of the language in Java 22. One interesting thing I discovered during implementation was a quirk in the ioctl ABI: there seemed to be a discrepancy between the KVM API documentation and the actual implementation. The very first call I attempted was KVM_GET_API_VERSION, but it unexpectedly returned EINVAL. After tracing the execution with strace, I managed to pinpoint the root cause (which was nearly impossible to debug at the Java level): the call was reaching the kernel without a third argument (whereas the documentation specified two). As it turns out, when the KVM documentation says an ioctl takes no arguments, it actually does require one... Due to KVM's implementation details, it implicitly expects a third parameter - it just has to be zero. This is likely to prevent reading garbage data from memory. Perhaps some readers have insights into the underlying reason for this difference - or maybe it was just human error and "things just turned out that way." In any case, by following the instructions in the repository's README, you can boot a functional Linux kernel and interact with it via the terminal. I’ve only tested the launch using Alpine 3.24.2 x86-64 on WSL2, so that might be a limitation. However, if you run it on a different setup or on bare-metal Linux, that would be great - please let me know. And if something breaks in the process - even better - let me know about that too. As for what I haven't finished yet in the current virtual machine implementation: networking and persistent storage are missing, and there is no virtio integration. Multi-vCPU startup mode isn't supported either; essentially, the creation of a single vCPU is currently hardcoded. I’d also love to hear your thoughts on the project. I would particularly value any feedback regarding the use of FFM and the KVM API itself. I’ll be happy to answer any questions you have.

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小玩意：bushaoxin（不烧心文学） 起因是一个观察：红果短剧上批量生成的 AI"良心商家"短剧，台词高度同质化——"贵是贵了点，但用了不烧心""规矩不能坏""明天怎么办？先做"。同质化到反而被网友解构成一个万能公式"万物皆可不烧心"：学习、写码、恋爱、健身，任何事套上这套掌柜腔，就自动显得靠谱、有底线。本质是大家对"不坑人"的集体渴望找到了一个好玩的语言模因。 我把这套公式做成了 Claude Code 的 Skill（遵循 Anthropic 开放的 Agent Skills 格式）：装上之后，让 AI 用良心掌柜的口吻写文案、评价事物、回怼、唠嗑。纯 prompt 实现，零依赖，Claude Code、claude.ai、Codex 都能用。 用法很简单： bash git clone cp -r bushaoxin ~/.claude/skills/ 然后对 AI 说"用不烧心文学评价一下 XX"，它会回： 贵是贵了点。但学完不烧心。账一笔一笔记清楚，谁的问题谁负责。慢慢来，别慌，一慌就容易学岔。 还做了个"火候"调节：说"太烧了"降一档、"淡了"升一档，从一句话点到为止到掌柜附体连发信条，吐槽本身就是遥控器。

projects.author: eatmoreduck

github.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-windows
github.description: JevChat-Windows：聊天窗口旁挂的回复辅助。窗口截图 + 本地离线 OCR 读对方消息 → Jev 判断意图 → 3 条候选一键填入，发送永远手动

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-windows 它是一个挂在聊天窗口旁边的回复辅助：对聊天窗口截图，用本地离线 OCR 读屏上的对话，把文字交给 Jev 判断意图和情绪，给出 3 条候选回复，点一下填进输入框——发送永远由你自己按。 技术上有两个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 采集层完全不侵入聊天软件：按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），OCR 在本地离线完成，不注入、不 hook、不解密任何聊天数据库。判断层走 TypeSafe Jev，起草层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。 2. 分发做成了"下载即用"：Releases 里有打包好的 exe（约 146 MB），普通用户不用装 Python；API key 只写 Windows 用户环境变量（注册表 HKCU\Environment），不落任何文件，其余设置放在 exe 旁边的 config.json，整个文件夹拷走设置也跟着走。 Windows 10 (1903+) / 11 可用，开源在 GitHub，exe 未签名（SmartScreen 会拦一下，介意可以自己打包）。 适合聊天量大、想先看懂对方意图再回复的 Windows 用户，也欢迎研究离线 OCR + 窗口感知管线的同学看源码。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-mac 它是一个 macOS 悬浮窗：聊天应用里弹出一条消息，悬浮窗会告诉你这句话的真实意图（8 类，零样本 86.4%）、风险分级（0-9 分）和几条候选回复，点「填入」进输入框——发送键永远由你自己按。 技术上有几个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 感知层没有侵入任何聊天应用：要么对前台聊天窗口按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），再用 Apple Vision OCR 只扫聊天区，按气泡和左右对齐区分正文、昵称、固定公告和引用；要么直接走系统文本接口读，不截图不 OCR。 2. 判断层是个本地 2B 小模型，一次前向同时出 8 类意图的全分布和风险分级，下载后完全离线；也可以配 TypeSafe Jev 的 key 走云端。生成层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek、智谱、本地 Ollama 都实测过），14 种话术并发生成候选，再由本地模型重排。M1 Pro 上出意图约 1.5 秒。 3. 坚持只读不代发：不模拟任何按键——合成输入事件会被部分应用的账号风控识别；「填入」优先走辅助功能接口写入并读回确认，定位不到就复制到剪贴板让你自己粘贴。 用法：Releases 下载 .app 拖进应用程序，授予屏幕录制权限即可。仅支持 Apple Silicon（M 系列）+ macOS 13+，MIT 开源。 适合每天在微信/飞书/QQ 里打字很多、想先看懂对方再回复的人，以及研究屏幕感知 + 端侧小模型落地的同学。

projects.title: Show HN: Lemma, an IDE for reading mathematics (macOS, open source)
projects.author: fus3r
projects.summary: I built Lemma while working through The Elements of Statistical Learning (using the Preview app). Kept running into references like "(3.41)" or "by Theorem 2.3" forcing me to scroll back through the entire book. And whenever a proof wasn’t detailed enough, I'd screenshot it, ask ChatGPT to explain, then go back to the PDF to add manual notes. Got pretty annoying. That led me to Lemma: it reads a PDF once (locally), lets you jump around between equations, theorems, etc. without constantly scrolling. I gave it a VS Code look because yes, I'm addicted to VS Code (there are other themes for normal people). A non-exhaustive list of things it can do (right now): - References to theorems, equations, figures, citations and index entries are all clickable (you can peek at them without leaving the page) - You can ask an agent or ChatGPT Web for explanations, longer proofs with one click, save the output in Lemma - When the pdf says “it is easy to show” or “proof left to the reader”, you can write the missing steps in LaTeX, and Lemma checks it on random numerical inputs and gives counterexamples if it’s wrong. You can also fold proofs to try them yourself first, and keep notes attached to specific passages (with exports to Markdown, Anki and Jupyter). Built in Swift/SwiftUI using PDFKit. The analysis runs in a helper process at low priority. No account, no telemetry, and it's GPL. It’s for macOS 15+ only for now (unless a lot of people find it useful, then I’ll probably do it for other OSes). It still struggles with some PDFs (scanned ones, other languages, different numbering, etc.) If you try it on whatever you're reading and encounter some problems, feel free to open an issue!

You can take it multiple times and will get a different set of questions either in general rust category or if you are brave enough and know deeper any other popular areas of Rust like macros, async with Tokio etc you can try your luck there. projects.title: Show HN: Search for AI agents with usefulness score built in
projects.author: Ayobamiu
projects.summary: Hi HN. I partnered with Simon Kley to build this project at innovation intelligence hackathon (Berkeley). Simply, we’re building a usefulness score on top of search for ai-agents. Instead of agents reading 10 ranked relevant pages, we run a usefulness score first and give it only those that pass. We’re able to save token and cost with this and slightly better answers. During our research, we found out that the current search results already do justice when it comes to simple queries. The rankings work well. They struggle when the task requires deep research or recency matters. So, we decided to talk to devs building ai-agents that research companies for sales outreach. Deep research and recency matters a lot to them. And in their words “every so often, stale facts reach emails.” They catch them by someone responding to the email or human review. From our tests, When an agent got outdated alert for 7 companies, it pitched outdated news for 4 out of them. Talking to the engineers already building this agents, we learned that cost saving is not the real goal. They’re ready to pay premium for confident results. So we added another check to our score. We call it superseding score, it check for pages replaced by newer news. For example, if two recent pages were fetched for news on Humane ai pin. If the first talks about how groundbreaking the product is and the second did that + talked about the HP acquisition, then the second page supersedes the first. The first page gets a lower score. We’re looking for feedbacks here and also teams that are building agents that research companies for outreach. Thanks. Plus, we rank a page once and every agent reuses it, so the more the agents use us, the cheaper the search gets.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】F3-Win：Windows 原生 Direct I/O 扩容盘检测与自愈工具，自带法庭级维权存证报告与极简热力图
projects.author: Wenaixi

github.name: Wenaixi/f3-win
github.description: Fight Flash Fraud for Windows - Ultra-high-performance flash drive capacity and speed test GUI (Rust + Win32 Direct I/O + egui)

projects.summary: 📎 项目地址 🚀 官方发版 (v0.1.0 单文件绿色版) 💡 背景与痛点 很多数码玩家或普通消费者在电商平台购买低价 U 盘、SD 内存卡或移动固态硬盘时，经常遭遇扩容假盘（标称 512GB 实际仅 8GB 报废黑片，超出部分自动回绕覆盖或读全0）。 而现有检测工具存在明显短板： 1. H2testw：近十余年未更新，缺乏现代硬件快速探测算法，大容量全盘漫长等待动辄数小时，且无法图形化定位坏块； 2. 原版 F3 (Fight Flash Fraud)：基于 Linux 命令行开发，普通 Windows 用户难以直接上手，缺乏原生高效的 GUI 交互； 3. 恶意固件进化：新型假盘主控具备“算力回放 (Compute-on-Read)”能力，利用原版 F3/H2testw 的线性同余乘数模逆元在芯片内现场运算伪造随机数，实施 0 字节闪存欺诈。 为了彻底解决这些痛点，我们打造了 F3-Win —— 一个纯 Rust + Win32 原生 Direct I/O 的单文件绿色扩容盘真伪检测与自愈利器。 ✨ 核心技术亮点 1. Win32 Direct I/O 物理直通： 采用 FILEFLAGNOBUFFERING | FILEFLAGWRITETHROUGH 彻底绕过系统文件缓存，并利用 VirtualAlloc 4KB 扇区对齐双缓冲，物理级压榨硬件总线带宽，测出真实颗粒吞吐。 2. 数分钟快速跳跃探测 (f3probe)： 忠实还原原版 F3 核心跳跃探针算法，在磁盘高位冲刷 32MB 穿透 SLC Cache 缓存，数分钟内侦测出假盘真实物理容量与硬件回绕（Wrap-around）边界。 3. 独家单向雪崩置换防伪 (Anti-Fake PRF)： 引入非线性单向雪崩置换密钥派生算法，Salt 永不落盘，彻底击穿假盘主控模逆元算力回放作弊，信息论强制其实体写入真实物理介质。 4. 实时仪表盘与扇区健康热力矩阵： 1200 点自适应平滑跟焦测速折线图（基于 eguiplot，精准捕捉 SLC 缓存耗尽与主控 GC 垃圾回收卡顿）； 1000 块全盘百分比归一化的扇区健康可视化热力块矩阵（直观渲染 Good、Bad、Changed、Overwritten 状态）。 5. 法庭级维权存证报告中枢： 首创首发故障扇区微观 Hexdump 取证，精准记录故障物理偏移与数据现场； 自动生成符合我国《消费者权益保护法》第五十五条标准的“退一赔三”法律维权公文模板与防灭失 Markdown 存证案卷，方便买家直接截图用于电商投诉或维权诉讼。 6. 双轨分区自愈修复 (f3fix)： 针对假盘提供一键安全自愈重写真实容量分区（Win32 原生 API 直写与标准 diskpart 脚本双轨），让缩水假盘变回真实可用容量的安全盘。 7. 纯正单文件绿色与原生系统托盘： 纯 Rust + eframe/egui 构建，无任何 C++ 运行时依赖，单文件仅 ~3.3MB；内置 Win32 原生系统托盘驱动三级自愈加载架构（崩溃自动重载、关于版本号弹窗、最小化防误触中断）。 📸 运行效果截图 项目内嵌瑞士平面设计极简品牌图标与 Fluent 深色工业风仪表盘，欢迎在 Release 页面直接下载体验单文件绿色版二进制产物。

projects.summary: 我是项目维护者，想自荐 FSB（Full Self Browsing）：一个 MIT 开源的 Chrome 扩展，加上一个本地 MCP 服务（npm 包，包名见 README）。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf 等 MCP 客户端接入后，可以在你日常使用的 Chrome 里完成打开页面、点击、输入、上传文件、读取内容等操作。 和同类工具相比，FSB 的几个不同点： 读取页面实时 DOM（元素、选择器、ARIA、表单），不依赖截图，每步操作后会检查页面状态。 推理交给 MCP 客户端自己的模型，使用 FSB 本身不需要 API Key。 密码和支付信息放在扩展的加密保管库里，由扩展负责填写，审计日志不记录敏感内容。 共 69 个 MCP 工具，包括元素监听触发、会话记录与回放。 当前扩展版本 0.9.92，MCP 服务版本 0.11.2。安装方式见 README，用 npx 运行 MCP 服务包的 install 命令即可写入对应客户端的配置。

projects.title: Show HN: CoastMath: (Open Source) Personal Finance and Retirement Planner
projects.author: jfrbfbreudh
projects.summary: Self-hosting instructions in the README. Hosted version: https://coastmath.com/ iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809539979 This post is partially inspired by this thread: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50048344 ``` > Somewhere around 20M people (0.2%) see first-hand that large, complex projects that used to take them weeks/months can now be completed by agents with a prompt. >> No, they can't, at least not any semblance of quality. The cases we're seeing where this does kinda work is in ports and translation where all the rules are already documented in the best specification language possible with a way for the LLM to verify itself: code. We saw this close to a year ago now with Cloudflare and NextJS ``` This post mostly outlines how I am personally building with agents, as I am almost entirely hands-off. Desired feature-set determined by having agents research existing products and feedback / feature requests on FIRE subreddits. Features built using Opus 5.5 (xhigh) / Fable 5.1 (med/high) as orchestrator and Opus-5-5 low/medium as worker subagents. Quality is attempted by running Opus-5-5 agents in a perpetual audit + fixer loop on the calculation / compliance engine until no medium+ severity can be found. The origin of each rule / logic must be backed up and documented in the codebase with a source. Sonnet subagents run UX / QA audit on iOS simulators within the Claude Code desktop app, and Opus agents resolve all medium+ sev issues; also run on a perpetual loop. I have not manually tested or used the app(s) for more than 30 minutes. For UX quality, agents' screenshots + associated context are fed to a combination of GPT / Gemini / Claude agents until consensus is achieved on quality (7/10+). Early feedback from beta testers report extremely close results to Boldin / Projection Lab. There is also a feature to import your data from Boldin and Projection Lab into CoastMath if you wish to compare the results yourself. There is also a SimpleFIN integration, if you wish to pull in your own transaction data and see how your financial future changes based on your monthly spending habits (e.g. when I will get to retire if I spend like I did in June vs. July?). I'm sure there are other features I don't yet know about. Again, I've barely used the app. Anyway, feel free to use / roast / steal. I don't think that any moat can exist in this class of products in the future (where the rules are laws that are visible to everyone) and I don't expect to turn a profit. Estimated cost: maybe $2000 if done over the API? I did most of this using the $200 Max subscription.

projects.author: mokuyoaxis

github.name: mokuyoaxis/agent-guard
github.description: Make destructive AI-agent actions reversible by default — quarantine + audit + human escalation for rm/git destructive operations. Reliability infrastructure, not a sandbox.

projects.summary: 之前使用 AI 编程助手时，我遇到过一次子代理删掉 $HOME 的事故。这次经历让我发起了 Agent Guard，和社区合作者一起，尝试给 AI 的破坏性操作留条退路。 它的思路很直接：能安全执行的继续，能补偿的先留恢复余地，不确定的请求用户确认，无法安全处理的拒绝执行。 目前主要提供： 删除保护：受支持的删除操作先将有价值的文件移入隔离区，保留记录，方便之后查询和恢复。 Git 快照：在受支持的破坏性 Git 操作前，保存已跟踪文件的当前状态，保护尚未提交的修改。 外发检查：检查文本中支持的凭据类型和敏感路径，提供脱敏或拒绝输出的处理方式。 另外提供 guard-lab，用合成标记和一次性项目，对 Agent 行为进行有明确范围的观察与测试。 项目可通过 Skill／CLI 使用，也提供 Claude Code、Kimi Code、DSH 的可选 Hook 适配。自动拦截依赖宿主实际加载兼容 Hook，具体覆盖范围随工具、版本和配置而异。 MIT 开源，Core 需要 Python 3.9+ 和 Git，提供中文文档及 npm 安装包。欢迎反馈误报、漏报和宿主适配问题。 项目：GitHub · 中文文档与接入指南 · npm 安装包

projects.title: Show HN: Trustmux – Async tmux from your phone, now in Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora
projects.author: dustinkirkland
projects.summary: I'm Dustin Kirkland, author of Byobu. I recently flew to Australia and kept nudging my Claude, Codex, and Bash jobs along back home from somewhere over the Pacific, at 700ms of latency. That's what Trustmux is for: secure, asynchronous access to your tmux or Byobu sessions from your phone. I first posted this in June and since then there have been many point releases, lots of new features and testing, and a growing base of users. It's now packaged in Ubuntu 26.10, Debian, Fedora, and Chainguard OS. Why not SSH, Mosh, or Claude Mobile? - SSH/Mosh: a live, synchronous connection is brutal on a phone. Latency and WiFi-to-cellular handoffs make it laggy and fragile. - Claude Mobile: great for Claude, but I wanted access to whatever is running in my tmux session: shells, Claude, other code assistants. Trustmux is async by design. Connect, look, type a command, disconnect, with no fragile connection state to babysit. Security: TLS with real certificates, end to end. Uses Tailscale (cert provisioning via tailscale serve, no port forwarding) optionally, bind to your own network address, or bring your own or self-signed certs. Two security experts reviewed the design and I implemented their recommendations. More scrutiny is very welcome. Quick start: trustmux enable trustmux start trustmux pair # shows a QR code if qrencode is installed Open the URL on your phone, enter the 6-digit code, and add it to your home screen. It's a PWA, so there's no app store. Install: apt, dnf, pip install trustmux, or brew tap dustinkirkland/trustmux && brew install trustmux Under the hood: Python, libtmux, WebSockets, Tailscale, and no polling. The UI shell is cached for offline use. Part of Byobu, GPLv3. Trustmux isn't affiliated with the tmux project. https://trustmux.dev https://github.com/dustinkirkland/byobu https://pypi.org/project/trustmux/

projects.title: Show HN: Hatoba, an open-source SSH client with an AI assistant and E2EE sync
projects.author: scarletkc

github.name: scarletkc/Hatoba
github.description: Open-source desktop SSH client with an AI assistant and end-to-end encrypted sync through your own Cloudflare account

projects.summary: I've used SSH tools for years and didn't really plan on building yet another SSH client, but I ended up building one the way I wanted. Hatoba is a desktop SSH client for Windows, Linux and macOS. It's written in Rust with Tauri 2 and MIT licensed. Each terminal has an AI assistant panel next to it. You describe the problem, and it reads the terminal screen, runs commands, types into the shell, and reads, edits and searches files on the host to find the cause and fix it. You can approve every command and edit it before it runs, let a model you pick approve the safe ones, or turn approval off. Files it changes show a diff you can undo. It works with any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API, local models included, and supports skills and MCP servers. Sync doesn't go through a server of mine. Hatoba deploys a Worker and a D1 database to your own Cloudflare account and syncs hosts, keys and AI conversations through them. The free plan usually covers personal use. Everything is encrypted on the device before it leaves. Keys are derived from your master password with Argon2id, every item is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and the Worker only stores ciphertext plus the hashes it needs to sign you in. Someone who gets hold of the whole Cloudflare account still only gets ciphertext. Sync is optional, and everything works offline without it. The usual SSH client features are there too: groups, tags and fuzzy search, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump and SOCKS5/HTTP proxies, an SFTP panel, local port forwarding, and a key vault that imports OpenSSH, PEM and PuTTY keys. There's also a dashboard showing CPU, memory, disk and network for every saved host, read over plain SSH with nothing installed on the servers. SSH is russh, the terminal is xterm.js with the WebGL renderer, and the UI is React. I develop on Windows, so it's Windows first, with a custom title bar that supports Snap Layouts and Mica, and working CJK input methods. The Linux packages and the macOS build get far less testing on real machines. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only and isn't notarized, so macOS blocks it on first launch until you allow it in Privacy & Security. Bug reports from Linux and Mac users would help the most. Website: https://hatoba.fog.moe Downloads: https://hatoba.fog.moe/download/

projects.title: 做了一个原生的 macOS Vaultwarden 客户端：基于 MyGo ，主窗口零 WebView，支持 Touch ID 与系统级 AutoFill
projects.author: vfasky
projects.summary: ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/uHyN54Z6.png) 自建 Vaultwarden 好几年了。官方的 macOS 桌面端基于 Electron，日常开着内存占几百兆，偶尔唤醒也有点迟钝；更关键的是 Safari 里的自动填充只能靠扩展，体验和系统原生有明显差距。 一直想找个轻快、原生的 Mac 客户端，后来索性自己动手写了一个，最近在主力机上用得很顺手，今天开源出来分享给自建密码库的朋友。 项目名叫 **MyGo Vaultwarden**。 #### 关于底层：为什么用 MyGo？ 这个项目是用 egoist 开源的 **MyGo** (`github.com/egoist/mygo`) 框架构建的。 很多朋友写桌面端习惯用 Wails 或 Electron，本质上还是把前端网页打包进去。而 MyGo 走的是另一条路线： - **后端是纯 Go**：处理 Vaultwarden 复杂的网络请求、AES-GCM/Argon2 加解密、数据同步以及快照管理，性能和类型安全都让人放心。 - **UI 是纯原生 Native UI**：直接绑定 macOS 的 Swift / AppKit，主窗口里**没有任何 WebView、HTML 或 JavaScript**。 - **极致轻量**：没有内嵌浏览器的开销，内存占用极小，原汁原味地遵循 macOS 的窗口、原生控件、菜单、快捷键和动画规范。 这也是我在实际写这个项目时觉得最爽的地方：既有 Go 写复杂业务的稳健，又能获得真正的 macOS 原生桌面质感。 #### 核心功能与体验 1. **系统级自动填充**：接入了 macOS 系统的「自动填充与密码（Credential Provider）」。在 Safari 或其它应用中无需常驻扩展，点选凭据并通过 Touch ID 认证即可填充。带有 TOTP 的条目，填充后还会自动把两步验证码复制到剪贴板。 2. **完整的个人密码库**：支持登录、支付卡、身份、安全笔记、SSH 密钥等 8 种类型；支持收藏、文件夹、归档、回收站与批量管理；`⌘F` 即时毫秒级搜索并展示网站图标。 3. **日常开箱即用**：直连自建 Vaultwarden 服务器，支持两步验证（MFA / 恢复码）、Bitwarden 兼容的 JSON 导入导出、Send 以及设备登录审批，并带应用内更新。 #### 安全性设计 做了哪些具体防护： - **双沙盒隔离**：主应用与 AutoFill 扩展均开启 macOS App Sandbox。AutoFill 扩展在独立的沙盒进程中运行，只读取一份经过权限和策略过滤的 Login 最小投影（仅包含用户名、密码、URI 与 TOTP），不触碰完整的加密库。 - **本地静态加密**：完整密码库仅以受 Keychain 和主密码保护的 AES-GCM 本机快照形式落盘。 - **主动防御**：在向服务器发起任何网络请求前，本地会先检查并拒绝弱 KDF 参数（如低迭代的 PBKDF2）；锁屏、睡眠或空闲 15 分钟后自动锁定。 - **写入安全**：网络异常导致的未知写入结果绝不会在后台静默重放，避免冲突覆盖。 - **更新验签**：自动更新包强制校验 Ed25519 签名与 SHA-256 摘要。 #### 目前的局限（先排雷） - **暂不支持组织管理**：当前版本只聚焦于个人密码库。组织条目能正常同步和解密，但组织管理（成员、集合、权限分配等管理后台功能）已延期到后续版本。 - **仅支持 macOS**：没有跨平台计划。 - **未做第三方安全审计**：代码已开源，遵循 GPL-3.0 协议，我自己每天在作为主力使用；但对于极其重要的数据，**建议试用前先通过官方端导出备份一次**。 #### 项目地址与讨论 - GitHub：`https://github.com/vfasky/mygo-vaultwarden` - 官网： https://mygo-vault.vfasky.com

projects.author: wengshirui

github.name: wengshirui/mcdindex
github.description: 横向比较不同城市的麦当劳门店供给数量

projects.summary: 用麦当劳官方 MCP 扫了全国 337 个地级及以上行政区的 5,817 家门店，算出一个 0~100 的城市麦当劳指数。输入城市名或地址关键词，就能看到这座城市在同级城市中的排名，以及门店密度、核心区覆盖、得来速占比三个分项。项目含纯函数计算引擎、离线数据快照与自包含演示页，打开即用、不联网。 亮点 把接口限制变成产品定义，而不是硬刚：MCP 的门店接口单次固定只返回 5 家、无分页、经纬度恒为 0.0，拿不到门店总数。项目用同构关键词采样（城市名 + 区县 + 通用道路 + 通用 POI）绕开上限，并把产品语义直接定义成「只做同级别比较」，同时在页面明写拿到的是采样下界。 一道「防假精度」护栏：给近乎无差异的指标算百分位，等于把噪声放大成排名差异。实测全国 117 个共有 SKU 的挂牌价篮子相对极差只有 0.285，低于设定的 0.30 阈值，于是价格维度被降级为「只展示、不计分」。 用公开数据反向校验自己：把采样门店数逐省与公开门店数对照，量化覆盖率，并写清偏差方向 —— 门店越密的城市越容易被低估（南京实测覆盖率仅约 59%）。 工程上可直接取用：计算引擎是纯函数、零 I/O 零第三方依赖；71 项三态自测（通过 / 失败 / 跳过，「跳过」不算通过）；演示页是单文件，打开即用，不联网也不调 MCP。

projects.summary: 大家好， 折腾博客和开源项目时，图床是最重要的基础设施。因为受够了各种防盗链、满屏广告和随时停运的风险，我花了几周时间从底层重构，为开发者量身打造了这款现代化的云端图床：ImgDuck。 主打一个：纯净无广、极客体验、长久稳定。 🔗 ✨ 核心亮点（不啰嗦，看功能） ⚡️ 全球 CDN 极速分发：直链无限制，生成即用，完美支持各大 Markdown 编辑器及静态博客。 👨‍💻 “零阻力”工具链：提供专业级数据面板。支持 PicGo / ShareX 配置文件一键下载，导入即用。 🗜️ 前端智能压缩 (Visual QA)：不仅支持 15MB 大图，还内置浏览器本地 WebP 压缩引擎。上传前可用“画质对比滑块”直观确认细节，无损省下 80% 体积。 🛡️ 硬核 AI 护航 (防跑路)：为确保域名长久稳定，底层接入本地 TensorFlow 模型进行严苛的 NSFW 拦截，杜绝恶意滥用，让正规用户的图片高枕无忧。 💅 现代 SaaS 级 UI：不仅是图床，更是一个精致的图库管理中台。支持深色模式、多图预览、批量管理与 API Token 轮换。 🎁 免费额度 游客通道：免登录，单图 15MB 拖拽秒传。 Hobby 计划（推荐）：注册即送 2GB 高速永久空间，解锁完整 API 与开发者工具，写个人博客/记笔记绝对管够！ (重度用户也有极具性价比的 Pro 扩容方案及自定义域名支持) 项目在架构安全（前端流控 + 纯内网隔离流转）和 UI 交互上死磕了很久。欢迎各位开发者白嫖体验、测速！如果有任何建议，或者对这套防封架构感兴趣，欢迎在评论区交流 🙏！

projects.summary: autopilot 是一个 Claude Code / Codex 插件（MIT）：你给一个目标，它自动规划、实现、验收、合并，再把经验沉淀进项目知识库。 造它是因为 AI 写码的两个真实教训：我碰到过 864 个测试全绿、页面输入框却根本不能用的版本；也抓到过一张截图被复制 7 份、冒充 7 个验收证据。测试数量在涨，证据质量没涨——所以我把「验收」做进了循环： 红蓝对抗：蓝队负责实现，红队看不到蓝队的做法，拿目标盲测找茬，更接近真实质检； 证据闸门：每个验收谓词都要有真实产物，没有产物的 PASS 会被机械判 FAIL，专治 AI「报喜不报忧」； 知识工程：任务结束后把踩坑经验自动沉淀进项目知识库，下个任务开局就带上。 这不是为了开源而开源：过去 6.5 个月我自己的活全跑在它上面，迭代了 146 个版本、380+ 个 commits（其中 84% 与 AI 结对完成）。

I wanted live translation I could use in meetings and conversations without worrying about connectivity, latency spikes, or sending sensitive audio to a third party. projects.summary: 我在维护 [ZeninData]( https://zenindata.ai/)，这次分享的是 GridCraft 的独立浏览器托管入口和使用指南。 先说明归属：GridCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队及贡献者开发的开源表格编辑器，当前托管版本是 v0.7.0 ；我负责托管和站内指南。上游代码在 https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft 。 目前可以免登录打开本地 XLSX / CSV ，使用手动的公式、排序、筛选、格式和图表，再下载文件。工作簿在浏览器处理，本站没有表格上传或云端保存服务。域名里的 AI 是后续方向，自然语言 agent 仍在开发，当前体验使用手动控件。 对初次使用，建议先拿一个自己造的小文件检查： - 编号有没有丢前导零，日期和中文有没有变化； - 选几个已知结果的公式核对，再检查筛选和图表； - 下载后重新打开，确认内容仍在，再考虑处理正式文件。 GridCraft 还在 alpha ，复杂 Excel 文件可能丢失未支持的特性，VBA 不支持；完整的导入—编辑—下载—重开兼容性尚未完成验证。请保留原件，并在关标签页前下载更改。 站内目前有两份具体入口： - [打开 XLSX 的步骤]( https://zenindata.ai/guides/open-xlsx-online/) - [GridCraft 与 Excel 的适用范围和限制]( https://zenindata.ai/guides/gridcraft-vs-excel/) 免登录也不代表网页没有网络请求：官网使用 Google Analytics 统计使用情况，没有设置工作簿内容、单元格值和文件名的自定义分析事件。 如果试用遇到问题，欢迎描述浏览器版本、操作步骤和可公开的最小样例。希望收到的是实际文件工作流和指南是否清楚的反馈。 本文由 AI 辅助整理，产品定位和限制按当前官网核对。

projects.author: Duxinghua
projects.summary: 工具名称 MiniToolDesk 访问地址 官网体验： 开源/主页： 为什么做这个工具？ 平时在写代码时，经常需要格式化 JSON、查时间戳、或者算个 MD5 哈希。但打开很多老牌在线工具站，往往扑面而来都是满屏闪烁的广告和弹窗，有些工具甚至会悄悄把敏感数据通过 POST 发送到第三方服务器处理。 特别是在大模型辅助编程时代，很多工程师会不自觉地把带有内部 API Key、JWT 凭证、数据库连接字符串的日志或代码直接喂给 ChatGPT / Claude，存在极大的企业数据泄露安全隐患。 因此我开发了 MiniToolDesk，核心理念只有一条：零服务端存储（Zero Server Storage），所有计算 100% 运行在用户本地浏览器内存中。 核心亮点与特色功能 1. AI 提示词敏感数据脱敏利器 (AI Prompt Sanitizer)： 自动检测并脱敏 OpenAI/Anthropic Key、JWT Token、数据库连接串、手机号和邮箱，替换为安全占位符； 支持本地双向解密还原：等 AI 返回生成的代码或分析结果后，在浏览器本地一键还原为真实密钥，防止企业机密泄露给大模型。 2. 纯前端 Web Crypto 硬件加速： SHA-256、SHA-512、MD5 计算与 AES 加解密完全调用现代浏览器原生 window.crypto.subtle API，断网离线状态下依然毫秒级响应，零字节网络传输。 3. 现代化代码生成矩阵： 支持 JSON 瞬间生成 Zod Schema、Go Struct、Python Pydantic、Rust Serde 以及 TypeScript Interface。 4. 桌面级纯净体验： 永久 0 广告、0 弹窗、无登录墙； 适配沉浸式暗黑/浅色毛玻璃界面，支持 PWA 离线安装及快捷键 Alt+M 侧边栏常驻。 支持平台 Web 端、Chrome / Edge 扩展插件、PWA（支持离线运行）。 欢迎阮老师及各位读者试用指正，希望能帮到经常跟代码打交道的开发者朋友们！

projects.title: Show HN: Gondwana, a code-first C#/.NET game engine with WebGL
projects.author: isthimius
projects.summary: Gondwana is a 2D/2.5D game engine for C#/.NET 8 that I’ve been building over the past 16 months, using SkiaSharp for rendering. I've spent my career creating web and distributed apps and that has influenced the engine's development, so it will feel very familiar to anyone with a similar background. The engine is deliberately code-first in its implementation but still includes visual authoring tools and a custom CLI. I started creating Gondwana to host my own RTS and SNES-style games, to offload the game ideas percolating in my brain. I wanted to focus more on creating gameplay systems and was less concerned with 3D graphics. The predictability and transparency of the old Win32/GDI era were the ideal for what I was shooting for, but I also wanted something faster and more portable than GDI32. To that end, I am not trying to emulate the bigger engines. Spot! became my primary dogfooding project that I’ve since pushed up to itch.io. Getting a game to that point really helped burn away the cruft that accumulates from trying to create something like this. I was able to get Spot! to render at a consistent 120 fps on my dev machine. I experienced the absolute ecstasy of getting WebGL to cooperate with the engine cycle. And I discovered that even if Gondwana is code-first, you don’t want to hand-code platformer levels, so I added Gondwana Studio to the repository. Studio uses the same file formats that are understood by the core engine. Asset handling was beefed up, UI widgets were added for things like game HUD elements and engine diagnostics, and I fleshed out the CI/release pipeline to keep it organized. As it stands currently, Gondwana supports GPU-backed OpenGL rendering with WinForms and Avalonia hosts, and a dedicated WebGL path with Blazor. Recently a good bit of effort has been put into optimizing the rendering hot-path, reducing contention between simulation and presentation, and into making the visual tooling easy to use by people other than just me. I even was able to get itch.io deployment down to a single command in the custom CLI. The engine is still actively evolving feature-wise, but the core rendering is pretty solid right now. I expect Gondwana will remain 2D/2.5D with parallax support, so I am not trying to supplant Unity, Godot, et al. Also worth noting, Gondwana intentionally does not have an explicit ECS framework built in, although one could absolutely work well with the engine if desired. The project is MIT licensed, the source is hosted on GitHub, the packages are on NuGet, and Spot! is playable in the browser at itch.io. I will include several links in the first comment under this. I’d love to see what other hobbyists or indie game devs think of the project. Feedback on usability, as well as praise and/or criticism of the architecture would be awesome.

projects.title: Show HN: RDST – A local agent that watches Postgres/MySQL for query regressions
projects.author: gvsg
projects.summary: We noticed during the course of many many years of DBA related work that fixes to database issues and queries are always reactive. An entire database can fall over extremely quickly when an unbounded query grows without warning. Traditionally, DBAs hear complaints of slowness and follow a methodical process: - manually browse pg_stats or other database related performance internal tables - see which queries are slowest - figure out what indexes are missing - figure out which indexes are actually bad and slowing down writes - painstakingly implement a fix In the age of cheap intelligence, we decided that there is no reason we can’t have an always-on agent that is designed to do this job for you. Databases need something or someone that is always watching with a massive amount of contextual understanding to be able to take quick actions. We’ve watched the alternative play out repeatedly. One of our users’s checkout page went from loading instantly to taking 11 seconds in a single night with no code change. How? Well somehow their order table grew by 40M rows because BI team had injected historical data and suddenly postgres started doing full table scans. Sometimes routine operations have unintended results and can easily destroy your database. We wanted to catch these kinds of regressions instantly. So we built RDST. RDST is a desktop agent that runs on your PC and connects to PostgreSQL / MYSQL (read only) and compares every query against its own performance every minute. Every expensive query is automatically EXPLAIN ANALYZED, stripped of PII and sent to U.S. based frontier or open model providers to analyze which indexes are missing, how the query could be rewritten, and provides the fix. We then run a classifier model (JEV) to decide if you should be notified (is this standard behavior for this particular query?), and the full history of the query performance is kept for years. RDST also keeps track of your entire database health in general, and recommends more fixes than simply bad queries. Since it runs locally we can keep the database credentials stored in your OS Keychain (RDST never keeps them in its own storage layer), and the connection goes straight to your database (using a jump host or SSH tunnel for private connections). You can read more about how we handle data especially as it pertains to LLM use here. https://readyset.io/docs/readyset-ai/rdst/desktop/privacy We really want feedback from the community from people running Postgres and MySQL in production. We are giving inference away completely for free. Just as a reminder, RDST will NOT run any updates or indexes against your database at this time. We are considering a fully autonomous auto-pilot mode in the future, but for now we are leaving the actual fixes in your hands. Let us know what you think!

projects.title: 做了半年无审查 AI 平台，记 4 个反直觉的工程坑（都有数据）
projects.author: largep
projects.summary: 我在做一个中文 AI 创作平台（对话、图片、视频、音频都有）。半年下来，最大的收获不是功能，而是一堆反直觉的坑。挑 4 个有数据的分享一下，对做 AI 应用的朋友可能有用。 ## 1. 「无审查」往往卡在托管商，不在模型本身 同一个图片编辑模型 **Seedream V5 Pro**，放在三家托管商上，用 40 条容易触发审核的编辑指令和同一张原图逐条测试（ 2026 年 8 月实测），被内容策略拒绝的比例分别是 **0%、12.5% 和 90%**。模型是同一个，差别全在托管商自己加的那一层审核：有的托管商在接口上根本没有提供关闭安全检查的开关，有的审核是概率性的，同一句话重试一次可能就过了。 所以挑「无审查」服务时，看名字没用，要看它实际跑在哪家，实测拒绝率是多少。 ## 2. DeepInfra 的 TTS 一过 15 秒就变成白噪声 长文本语音合成时，大约 60 秒的音频会在中段突然变成刺耳的白噪声。 抓包后发现，DeepInfra 在一个本该是裸 PCM 数据的流里，每 15 秒左右插入一行 45 字节的 SSE 心跳： ``` : ping - \r\n\r\n ``` PCM16 一个采样占 2 字节，而 45 是奇数。心跳一插进去，后面所有采样的字节都错位了一位，听起来就是白噪声。解决办法是在流里识别并剥掉这一行。如果你也在用 DeepInfra 的流式 TTS ，可以检查一下 300 字以上的长文本。 ## 3. Vercel 函数冻结，会吞掉「发出去就不管」的写入 计量日志和服务端埋点我们最初是 fire-and-forget 写的（`void fetch(...)`，不 await ）。后来发现，Vercel 的函数实例在响应发出后就会被冻结，没写完的 promise 会被挂起，直到下一个请求把实例唤醒才继续，而那时连接早已超时。 丢不丢取决于写入能不能在响应发出前的几毫秒内完成：复用热连接的数据库 INSERT 多半能活下来，要新建 TLS 连接的埋点请求则基本必丢。所以高峰期几乎看不出问题，低谷期和单次调用会稳定地丢数据，统计结果在半夜系统性偏低。 解决办法是用 `@vercel/functions` 的 `waitUntil` 把这些 promise 包起来，实例会等它们完成再冻结。修好之后，单次调用并静默 150 秒，计量和埋点也都能在响应后约 200ms 内落地。如果你在 Vercel 上做统计，发现半夜的数据总是少一截，可以查查这个。 ## 4. 长对话越长，回复末尾越容易出现乱码 我们统计了某个无审查模型回复末尾出现乱码的比例，发现它随上下文长度单调上升：上下文在 8k token 以内时约 0.01%，超过 48k 时到了 1.95%。短对话根本复现不出来，所以一开始一直以为是偶发故障。 更麻烦的是，一旦历史里出现过一次乱码，模型会照着抄下去。把 temperature 调到 0.7 之后，这种「被污染的历史」引发的乱码从 7/40 降到了 1/40 。所以先调采样参数，比去砍上下文更有效。 --- ## 最后说点题外话 这个项目从头到尾都是几乎我一个人在做。半年下来最大的感受是：一个人靠技术挣钱，养活自己是可以的。前提是选一个大厂不愿意做、或者做不好的方向，然后把那些脏活累活一件件干完。上面这些坑，没有一个是写功能时想得到的。 工具方面，最想夸两家。Vercel 是真好用：每个分支自动部署一个预览环境，合并到主干就上线，一个人也能保持很快的发布节奏，上面那个冻结的坑算是我交的学费。Cloudflare 是真良心：对象存储不收出口流量费，图片和视频这种大流量业务能省下一大笔钱，连域名邮箱都是免费转发的。 --- 平台叫 [思畅 AI]( https://sichang.xyz ），网页端可以免费试用，也有兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 接口的 API ，可以直接接 Claude Code 。 --- 4 月 [发过一帖]( https://v2ex.com/t/1204769 )，当时大家提的意见都记下了。模型方面，默认模型已经换掉了。隐私方面，我们不再做「不存储」这种没法验证的承诺，改为隐私和便利并重：对话保存在账号下，手机、电脑多台设备可以同时使用，消息实时同步；传输全程 HTTPS, 数据库静态加密，数据按账号隔离；对话不用于训练任何模型，可以随时一键导出或删除。这里不是端到端加密，想要绝对的隐私，本地模型仍然是最好的选择。 欢迎拍砖。

projects.title: 第一个独立上线的 Web 站：用 3 天做了个 Rumpelstiltskin 踮脚舞 AI 视频生成器，记录一下踩过的坑
projects.author: komazhao
projects.summary: 做了很多年数据和产品，一直想自己从零上线一个能收钱的站。这次赶上一个梗，终于把第一个站发出去了，记录一下。 站点： https://rumpelstiltskinaivideo.app ## 它是干嘛的 10 月初 TikTok 和 X 上火了一个 AI 生成的片段：一个像 80 年代奇幻电影里的小矮人（ Rumpelstiltskin ），在堆满稻草的谷仓里，配着 Riff Raff 的 "Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz" 踮脚跳舞。很多人想把自己放进这个片段里。 这个站做的就是这件事：上传一张照片，生成一段由你来跳舞的同款视频。 - 输入：1 张单人照片，不用写提示词 - 输出：约 11 秒、720p ，可选 16:9 （和原片同构图）或 9:16 （适合 TikTok/Reels ） - 文件：带原片配乐的 MP4 + 无声 GIF ，无水印 - 耗时：4 ～ 7 分钟，关掉页面也会继续生成 ## 技术栈 - 前端/全栈：TanStack Start - 部署：Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 ，Cron Trigger 补查超时任务 - 生成流程：Nano Banana 2 把照片转成彩铅风参考图 → 火山方舟 Seedance 2.0 mini 参考视频模式逐镜头重演原片 → 服务端用 Mediabunny 合入原片配乐 → 存 R2 - 支付：Waffo Pancake （ Merchant of Record ） ## 定价和成本 不做免费试用，单条 $4.99 ，3 条 $11.99 ，10 条 $29.99 ，一次性付费，不订阅，生成失败自动退积分。 没给免费额度，是因为每条都实打实烧 GPU ，新站扛不住白嫖流量。这个决定对不对，欢迎拍砖。 ## 踩过的坑 1. **照片太小直接被模型拒**：用户传了 260×626 的图，接口报 "invalid file"。后来在浏览器端先规整照片：短边小于 720 放大，长边超过 2048 缩小，极端长宽比补模糊边。 2. **用户关页面导致任务卡死**：提交模型后、写回任务 ID 前，请求被中断。改成 Workers 的 `waitUntil` 跑完后续步骤，Cron 兜底超时退款。 3. **PayPal 在日本一直登不上开发者后台**：最后换成 Waffo ，自己按文档手写 RSA 签名和 webhook 验签。 4. **Cloudflare 部署报 "compatibility date in the future"**：nitro 用本机日期写兼容日期，北京时间凌晨 Cloudflare 那边还是前一天。加 `TZ=UTC` 解决。 5. **Workers Builds 推送后一直"已加入队列"**：最后改成本地 wrangler 部署。 ## 关于 GEO 这次也在实践让 ChatGPT 这类 AI 搜索能收录、推荐我的站：写 llms.txt ，每个问题做一个答案页（第一句直接给答案、数字写死），加 FAQ/Article Schema ，接 IndexNow 和 Bing Webmaster 。效果怎么样还在观察，有结果了再来更新。 ## 求反馈 第一次独立上线，产品、定价、落地页、SEO 有什么问题都欢迎直说。也想听听大家做"热点梗站"的经验：热度一般能撑多久，热度过了之后怎么办？

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Video To Frames：在浏览器里把视频抽成图片，文件不上传
projects.author: crayon-nickee
projects.summary: 自荐一个我做的浏览器本地视频抽帧工具「Video To Frames」。 视频在你自己的设备上解码，不上传、不注册，抽出来的图片可以直接下载或分享。 在线版视频抽帧工具 浏览器访问（可免费使用）： 主要功能 七种抽帧方式：只取关键帧、按场景切换、每隔 N 秒、逐帧、固定张数、指定帧率、单帧。单帧可以在附近自动挑最清晰的一张。 在时间轴上拖选片段，或直接填写起止时间。导出前会先显示预计张数。 导出 PNG、JPG 或 WebP。可以打包成 ZIP、直接存进文件夹、复制单张，或拼成联系表。 文件名带帧号和时间码，方便对回原视频。课件录屏可以跳过重复画面，大致得到一页幻灯片一张图。 手机上可以把图片分享到相册。旁边还有视频转 GIF、视频转 MP3、HEIC 转 JPG、WebP 转 PNG，同样在浏览器里完成。 和其他视频抽帧工具的区别 文件不离开设备：用浏览器自己的解码器在本地处理，没有上传再下载这一步。打开开发者工具的网络面板，看不到视频被传走。 关键帧模式只读文件索引，不用把每一帧都解码，长视频通常几秒就能出结果。 同一次操作里覆盖封面挑选、课件转图片、逐帧动画、摄影测量和训练数据取样，不必为每种用途换一个工具。 免费、无水印、无需账号，也不限抽帧张数。特别长的 4K 视频受本机内存影响，可以只选一段，或按间隔抽。

projects.title: Show HN: Trustmux – Async tmux from your phone, now in Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora
projects.author: dustinkirkland
projects.summary: I'm Dustin Kirkland, author of Byobu. I recently flew to Australia and kept nudging my Claude, Codex, and Bash jobs along back home from somewhere over the Pacific, at 700ms of latency. That's what Trustmux is for: secure, asynchronous access to your tmux or Byobu sessions from your phone. I first posted this in June and since then there have been many point releases, lots of new features and testing, and a growing base of users. It's now packaged in Ubuntu 26.10, Debian, Fedora, and Chainguard OS. Why not SSH, Mosh, or Claude Mobile? - SSH/Mosh: a live, synchronous connection is brutal on a phone. Latency and WiFi-to-cellular handoffs make it laggy and fragile. - Claude Mobile: great for Claude, but I wanted access to whatever is running in my tmux session: shells, Claude, other code assistants. Trustmux is async by design. Connect, look, type a command, disconnect, with no fragile connection state to babysit. Security: TLS with real certificates, end to end. Uses Tailscale (cert provisioning via tailscale serve, no port forwarding) optionally, bind to your own network address, or bring your own or self-signed certs. Two security experts reviewed the design and I implemented their recommendations. More scrutiny is very welcome. Quick start: trustmux enable trustmux start trustmux pair # shows a QR code if qrencode is installed Open the URL on your phone, enter the 6-digit code, and add it to your home screen. It's a PWA, so there's no app store. Install: apt, dnf, pip install trustmux, or brew tap dustinkirkland/trustmux && brew install trustmux Under the hood: Python, libtmux, WebSockets, Tailscale, and no polling. The UI shell is cached for offline use. Part of Byobu, GPLv3. Trustmux isn't affiliated with the tmux project. https://trustmux.dev https://github.com/dustinkirkland/byobu https://pypi.org/project/trustmux/

No account needed, no telemetry shared back to me, no network connections made. Requires Apple Silicon + macOS 26. projects.title: Show HN: Petal, open-source CoScreen/ScreenHero finally free
projects.author: thedracle
projects.summary: Hi HN! I’m Jason Thomas, one of the founders of CoScreen. As some of you may know, Datadog sunset the CoScreen service on July 31st. Four of us from the original CoScreen team have spent the last couple months building a free and open source pair programming tool inspired by those that came before us: It’s called Petal ( https://github.com/kiruna-labs/petal ) Some history first, because when we started CoScreen we had hoped to break the sad and established pattern of this industry. Screenhero was an exceptional tool that a lot of us loved for pairing. Multiple cursors, low latency, you could click your partner’s editor, and just start typing. It felt like magic while we had it. Then Slack bought it in 2015, and shut down the standalone app in December 2017. When Till, Max, and I started CoScreen, we were aware of this history, and wanted to build an even more magical collaboration and screen sharing experience: the entire concept was “throw a window from your laptop up on someone else’s screen, and start collaborating with zero friction.” Datadog acquired us in 2022, and thus began the great adventure of adapting our real-time technology into Datadog products, while also continue developing CoScreen as a standalone tool from the Datadog ecosystem. Datadog invested in the product for years and we’re thankful for that. But CoScreen itself proved, like so many other screen sharing tool acquisitions, to be too tangential from the customer base and core mission. We instead built other communication features in Datadog, the integrations with other video platforms, and also its wildly successful MCP server. We weren't the only ones. Around was bought by Miro and shut down in March 2025. Multi (formerly Remotion) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in 2024 and shut down about a month later. It's nearly always the same story: a small team builds something hard that people love, a platform buys it for the team or the feature, and the standalone product doesn't survive the integration. So we decided firmly to do things differently this time. Petal is completely free and open source and we aren't monetizing it. If we lose interest or get hit by a bus, you can self-host it or fork it, and nobody can sunset it on you. Honestly it's a love letter to everyone in this community that supported us, believed in us, and to liberate collaborative screen sharing from this vicious cycle. We hope through this we can help foster a large and vibrant community around innovating in this product sector. What Petal does: shared windows show up as real windows on your desktop, movable and resizable, not tiles in a grid. Several people can share at once, everyone gets a labeled cursor, and you can click into any shared window to type and scroll. Rooms are persistent, so you click once to join "eng-sync" instead of passing links around. It runs on macOS and Windows (Linux is next, this time for real and you can help us!), plus a web app. Media goes over LiveKit. You can use our hosted instance with zero config, or point the app at your own LiveKit server with one docker-compose if you want the traffic to stay on your network or even use an entirely different video backend if you want to. The part that still feels strange to us: CoScreen took almost six years to build. The first version of Petal took under eight weeks, from scratch, with frontier models like Fable and Astra doing a lot of the work. Real-time video and window capture is some of the most unforgiving code we have ever written, so we didn't expect that. We will do a proper writeup on what worked and what didn't, and are happy to answer questions about it here. Till, Darren, Max and I will be in the thread.

projects.title: Show HN: Eevo – Consequential Decision Model
projects.author: ojalajuho
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Juho from Upright. I think we may have stumbled upon an interesting approach to AI alignment. The idea is as follows: 1. train a decision model to be really good at comparative sizing of consequences, expected value problems, and modelling overlap between different consequences 2. create a harness around that model that accepts a decision context, list of options, and identified consequences, then runs pairwise comparisons and overlap modelling for the consequences using the decision model in (1), and finally solves implied relative consequences "sizes" and finally EV (for different stakeholders) 3. Make AI agents running on general purpose LLMs use (2) to make better decisions. So the agent provides the context, options, and identifies the consequences, Eevo model just sizes them, models their overlap, and computes EV. In practice this seems to improve agent judgement a lot (in addition to adding lots of practical observability) It seems the (well-motivated) emphasis on instruction-following hurts model's performance on expected value tasks. The underlying decision model we trained beats Jev, Clef, MS decision-1 the model on OpenAI decisions API on economic rationality benchmarks like STEEP, expected value tasks, poker, and even Pacman (Jevman benchmark). I swear to you we did not Benchmaxx on Pacman Also it seems to be useful also for human decisions. Just getting other people's decisions presented to you in standard format with consequences listed and sized is just very pleasant. There are some testers though who think this is useful for improving everyone's judgement, except their own

projects.title: Show HN: TowerPanic – a family party game on a small FastAPI realtime engine
projects.author: ms209495
projects.summary: I want to show you the game I created recently and tell you whole the story/experience - including backend/latency/scalability. You can try it quickly without an account - I created game demo rooms (EU/US/JP) - links below - just be aware that anyone with a link can access join the game. Let's start with short description of the game itself: This is the TowerPanic game - you are standing on one of four towers, during each round some of towers crack, and some of these lean, and finally one of these colapse - you need to watch out to not be on the failing one. It's a multiplayer game for whole family. This can be also used as an icebreaking game - for people in any age. The game is safe for children - no violence, no strangers, no chat, no ads. Parent creates an account (free 14-day trial, then a paid pass) and starts the game - others join using a QR code or a link. Behind the game there is an interesting backend engine - I willdescribe it in a moment. Let's start with the history of this whole project: - I was playing with asyncio and fastapi - As an exercise I created a reliable chat application (multiple rooms, in each room each user can reliably broadcast a message to all other users) - I extracted communication to separate layer - creating network/application layer interfaces - 'reliable client' interface for client and 'state machine' interface for the service on server. - With these interfaces - I was able to create other service - an 'sgame' (simple game). With verified interfaces and created services (chat, sgame) I was able to ask AI to generate other tools/games - I was impressed by these results - the games/tools worked well - I deployed them on a remote server - I was surprised that the latency was very good - almost everything worked smoothly I tested the tools and games with my children and one of the game was really great. I decided to make this game public - I chose 'TowerPanic' name for it. I prepared an account/payment server for this game (as a separate FastAPI application). This was very good choice: - the game servers keep rooms only in memory - nothing persistent (rooms have expiration date) - the account server keeps all persistent data (it uses database) Because of this split I was able to figure out how to upgrade and scale frontend and backend independently - without significantly impacting users. I optimized the communication layer - so that it works in finite memory - only finite number of recent messages is kept, and I sent a full service snapshot (full state) to the lagging clients. The backend process (FastAPI/python) is limited by python GIL (only one core can be utilized) - to utilize all server cores I used HAProxy with consistent hashing to distribute rooms - so that users can be redirected to proper backend process. I tested how many rooms a single server can handle - it handles hundreds of active rooms in parallel with no significant latency drop. Before making it public I noticed that latency in other region of world might be higher and this could influence UX - I confirmed this using artificial delay on my remote server. I decided to deploy the application in three regions - EU, US, JP - to ensure low latency (below 150ms) in most of the world. The room is created in region closest to the user (best latency from the browser to backend). I needed also to prepare some legal documents (terms, privacy, refunds) - thanks to AI this was much easier. I'm a backend engineer, frontend/UI/UX were designed by me but code was generated by AI. To summerize all this work: - I'm happy that I was able to deliver complete game/complete product - I think the whole work took me about 20 evenings - I'm impressed that it was so short - I think this is because the technology I used is popular and all fits well - AI was great as a peer (to discuss the options for distributing the load, discuss were to locate servers, or discuss how auth/payments work under the hood, ... - based on this I could choose the best option) - AI was great for doing the non work which I'm doing ineffectively (frontend/UI/legal docs). The game is available at https://towerpanic.com/?ref=hn I will appreciate your comments/feedback: Product: - did you meet any obstacles to play ? - how smoothly it worked ? - please specify your location if it didn't work well - most important thing/things to improve ? - anything else ... Solution/Engineering: - one thing you will change in the architecture / approach ? - anything else ... If you don't want to register you can play directly using below links (2 rooms for each location, max 10 players in each room/board). Choose best location: DEMO ROOMS (expire: 19 October 2026 at 22:00 UTC): EU: https://engine.prod-de-1.towerpanic.com/b/hn1/join/AUB3lS3Y_... https://engine.prod-de-1.towerpanic.com/b/hn4/join/ASlA3J43U... US: https://engine.prod-us-1.towerpanic.com/b/hn2/join/AUCCS_x9d... https://engine.prod-us-1.towerpanic.com/b/hn5/join/AVQbs_01N... projects.title: 【资源自荐】awesome-uncensored-ai：大模型「去除拒答」（abliteration）的中文入门与横评
projects.author: ryuukouki
projects.summary: 一份中文资料，讲清楚大模型的「拒答」是怎么训练出来的，以及怎么把它去掉： 原理：拒答由模型激活空间里一个固定的方向控制。abliteration（定向消融）把这个方向从权重里正交掉，模型就不再拒绝，而能力基本不受影响。 前沿实测：整理了 Anthropic 9 月报告的数据：GLM-5.3 经过处理后拒答率从 90% 以上降到 2%～3%，GPQA 得分不变，成本约 1,200～4,400 美元。也整理了这件事的另一面：7 月 Hugging Face 应对 AI agent 入侵时，前沿模型因为安全护栏拒绝做逆向分析，最后靠自己部署的开源 GLM 完成。 工具与部署：Heretic 等自动化工具怎么用，以及现成的去拒答权重、显存与量化怎么选。 平台横评：对话、图像、视频、语音各类平台的内容政策与价格，每条事实都附官方来源。 不收录越狱提示词，也不收录针对真实个人的换脸或声音克隆服务；文中列出了所有平台共同的红线，比如涉及未成年人的内容。 利益披露：维护者是思畅 AI 团队，思畅本身也在横评之列，优点缺点照写。

projects.title: Show HN: Face, a browser window over agents that keeps the plan in files
projects.author: JCKodel
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the author. FACE is a single Go binary. You run `face` in the folder that holds your projects and it serves a page on 127.0.0.1. It speaks ACP (the Agent Client Protocol that Zed published) to the official CLI of the agent you already use: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Qwen Code or Antigravity, signed in with your own account. FACE has no model, no key and no agent loop of its own. Why I built it: a coding agent ships a feature in an afternoon, and three people and five sessions later nobody can answer "what is in flight, what did it cost, why was it decided this way". The answer I landed on is not a dashboard but a method where every decision and every delivery is a versioned file: a handful of docs written once, a queue with one line per delivery (docs/06), and one page per delivery (work/<slug>.md) that says what will be built and how it is proven before any code changes. The method is four slash commands the agent reads from one file (brainstorm, analyze, propose, apply); it works without FACE. FACE is the window: the queue becomes a five-lane board, a card opens into the page plus the live session, and the commit window shows exactly what the agent staged. The agent never commits or merges; you click. I built FACE itself with it, from the fourth week on. Before that the same method shipped a job marketplace in 89 one-page deliveries over 14 days, and a consulting project in 107 deliveries over 19 days. Install: `brew install jckodel/face/face`, `winget install JCKodel.FACE`, a `.deb`, or `curl -fsSL https://face.kodel.com.br/install.sh | sh`. macOS, Linux, Windows, arm64 and amd64. UI in en, pt, es, fr, de and zh-Hans. What is missing: single user and local only (a team mode with a server on your network is the next milestone); no editor (it shows code and diffs, your editor stays your editor); the source is not public yet. It will be visible under a fair source license when the paid tier for teams exists, and the free tier stays free. By itself FACE makes at most two requests, both off until you turn them on: a daily anonymous ping that counts machines and a daily version check. The page "What FACE sends" lists both URLs. Happy to answer anything about ACP, the adapters for Claude and Codex (they are not ACP native, so FACE wraps them), or the method.

projects.author: Peacoke
projects.summary: 传统的左右政治光谱（1D）或二维政治罗盘（2D）往往把很多并不相关的政治观念生硬地压缩在一起。 The 12 Axes 是一个完全运行在浏览器客户端本地的现代政治态度多维量化测试工具： 1. 十二个独立正交维度：涵盖政府形态（联邦/集权、民主/威权、安全/自由）、对外事务（国际/国家、军事/和平、保护/全球）、经济机制（平等/市场、计划/自由放任）、社会文化（世俗/宗教、进步/传统、同化/多元、科技/生物保守）。 2. 纯前端架构，隐私优先：无需注册登录，无后端数据库，所有题目答案与测试进度全部仅保存在访问者本地浏览器中，绝不收集或上传用户的任何政治观点。 3. 向量距离匹配算法：自动计算与 41 种现代意识形态和 42 位历史先贤（林肯、甘地、丘吉尔、亚当·斯密、马克思、曼德拉等）的多维空间距离，并支持一键生成 9:16 移动端结果分享卡片。 4. 技术栈：基于 React 19、TanStack Start、Tailwind CSS 构建，全站部署于 Cloudflare Workers 边缘网络，极速加载与原生国际化支持。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MastraWork：把 Agent 运行组织成任务的开源桌面 AI 工作台
projects.author: movclantian

github.name: movclantian/mastra-desktop
github.description: Local-first multi-agent coding workbench built on Electron, React and the Mastra framework. 本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，基于 Mastra + Electron，把一次 Agent 运行组织成可暂停、可回溯、可交接的任务。

projects.summary: 项目：MastraWork | 平台：Windows / macOS / Linux | 许可：Apache-2.0 | 最新版本：v0.0.7 它是什么 一个本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，底层是 Mastra 框架 + Electron。 它想解决的事情很具体：现在多数 AI 工具给你一段回答，事情就停在那儿；代码改到一半让它继续，它常常重新把文件读一遍，从接不上的地方往下编。前面聊过的上下文，像是没发生过。 MastraWork 的做法是把一次 Agent 运行组织成一个任务。任务落在具体的工作区里，长在线程上，每一步都留下痕迹。它能暂停，能回头检查，也能交给团队里的其他成员接着看。断掉之后不是从头再来，而是接着往下走。 它面向软件工程和知识工作：Agent、团队、工作区、终端、浏览器、MCP、技能和资料库收在同一个应用里，围着同一个任务转。 功能详解 🧭 工程任务 读取代码、全局搜索、编辑与 AST 修改、运行命令、查看差异、调用 LSP 都在里面。关键是读、写、执行分开授权，每一步都有记录，不是开一个大权限就全放开。 🛡️ 受控执行 计划、构建、复查三种模式，切的是「Agent 现在能碰什么」。人工询问和批准留在流程里，高风险动作停下来等人确认，不靠模型自觉。 👥 Agent 团队 主 Agent 可以带一群专家成员，支持委派、交接、并行、分支、循环和审批工作流。复杂任务拆给合适的人，而不是一个 Agent 硬扛。 🧩 开放扩展 模型 Provider、MCP Server、技能与插件、浏览器、资料库、记忆和网页检索，按需接入，不绑定任何一家模型服务。今天用这家，明天想换，配置改一下就行。 🖥️ 桌面集成 Electron 主进程、原生浏览器视图、PTY 终端、系统通知、凭据保险库。API Key、OAuth token 和 Cookie 由桌面主进程的凭据保险库保管。 📚 记忆与资料库 记忆跨会话保留；资料库统一收文档、表格和网页；用量、费用和历史数据随时可查。 一个任务是怎么走完的 一个任务从开工到验收，Agent 手里的权限是变的，分三个阶段： 1. 计划 —— 先把事情想清楚，读代码、查资料、出方案。 2. 构建 —— 方案定了再动手，改代码、跑命令、推进任务，每一步都留下记录，随时可以停下来回头看。 3. 复查 —— 对照差异和工作记录验收，高风险的操作在这一步需要人批准。 读、编辑、执行和外部工具在三阶段各有一套策略，图的入口在应用内设置里，实际安全性以服务端权限检查和测试记录为准。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Electron 44、electron-vite、electron-builder | | 界面 | React 19、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 4、CodeMirror 6、xterm | | Agent 框架 | Mastra 1.77（core、memory、rag、mcp、observability） | | 数据与检索 | libsql、DuckDB、fastembed 本地向量 | | 代码与文档 | Shiki 高亮、Mermaid、KaTeX、PDF 与 Office 解析 | | 工具链 | Biome、Knip、pnpm workspace | 快速开始 三个平台都有现成安装包，也可以从源码跑（需要 Node.js >=22.19.0 <23、pnpm 12.11.2）： sh corepack enable corepack prepare pnpm@12.11.2 --activate pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev 首次启动后配一个可用的模型 Provider、选一个工作区目录即可。需要网页检索、浏览器、MCP 或技能时，再按实际服务分别配置凭据。默认本地数据目录是 ~/.mastrawork，Mastra 服务跑在本机 4111 端口。 下载： 关于「本地优先」 需要说清楚一点：「本地优先」说的是桌面宿主、默认工作区和本地数据边界优先留在本机，不表示所有推理都在本地完成。模型推理走哪个服务由使用者自己配置，模型服务会收到你发过去的提示词和选定的上下文。 项目还在很早期（v0.0.7），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。

projects.title: Show HN: Factory DS, A Factorio-Like Game for the Nintendo DS
projects.author: j_leboulanger
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Ronan. I love the Nintendo DS but ran out of games that kept me hooked, so I tried porting the kind of game I play today: a factory game in the spirit of Factorio, on a 67 MHz ARM9 with 4 MB of RAM. I had never written code for the DS, and I built it with Claude Code. I wrote the specs, the design and the balancing, and Claude wrote most of the C. The post goes through how that worked, and through the technical parts I found the most fun: - a 2048x2048 world that is never stored: terrain is computed from (x, y), only the player's changes are kept in a hash table - night done by changing the 256-color palette instead of redrawing the screen - power grids and pipes computed per network with union-find (there is a small step-by-step animation in the post) - trains with schedules, block signals and pathfinding, plus redstone-like logic gates - a headless Mac build of the game with a text interface, so AI agents could play ~470 test sessions and even help balance the game You can download the ROM (English and French) and play it on a flashcart or in melonDS.

projects.title: Show HN: Hatoba, an open-source SSH client with an AI assistant and E2EE sync
projects.author: scarletkc

github.name: scarletkc/Hatoba
github.description: Open-source desktop SSH client with an AI assistant and end-to-end encrypted sync through your own Cloudflare account

projects.summary: I've used SSH tools for years and didn't really plan on building yet another SSH client, but I ended up building one the way I wanted. Hatoba is a desktop SSH client for Windows, Linux and macOS. It's written in Rust with Tauri 2 and MIT licensed. Each terminal has an AI assistant panel next to it. You describe the problem, and it reads the terminal screen, runs commands, types into the shell, and reads, edits and searches files on the host to find the cause and fix it. You can approve every command and edit it before it runs, let a model you pick approve the safe ones, or turn approval off. Files it changes show a diff you can undo. It works with any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API, local models included, and supports skills and MCP servers. Sync doesn't go through a server of mine. Hatoba deploys a Worker and a D1 database to your own Cloudflare account and syncs hosts, keys and AI conversations through them. The free plan usually covers personal use. Everything is encrypted on the device before it leaves. Keys are derived from your master password with Argon2id, every item is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and the Worker only stores ciphertext plus the hashes it needs to sign you in. Someone who gets hold of the whole Cloudflare account still only gets ciphertext. Sync is optional, and everything works offline without it. The usual SSH client features are there too: groups, tags and fuzzy search, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump and SOCKS5/HTTP proxies, an SFTP panel, local port forwarding, and a key vault that imports OpenSSH, PEM and PuTTY keys. There's also a dashboard showing CPU, memory, disk and network for every saved host, read over plain SSH with nothing installed on the servers. SSH is russh, the terminal is xterm.js with the WebGL renderer, and the UI is React. I develop on Windows, so it's Windows first, with a custom title bar that supports Snap Layouts and Mica, and working CJK input methods. The Linux packages and the macOS build get far less testing on real machines. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only and isn't notarized, so macOS blocks it on first launch until you allow it in Privacy & Security. Bug reports from Linux and Mac users would help the most. Website: https://hatoba.fog.moe Downloads: https://hatoba.fog.moe/download/

projects.title: Show HN: Personal Agent Proxy (Open Source)
projects.author: arnestrickmann
projects.summary: Every (personal) agent (like Muse, Instinct, Grokbot, Poke) asks you to connect your email, calendar, and tools again. Permissions are intransparent and every provider ends up building the same integrations. We think there needs to be an independent tool that holds all connections to third party companies. That way you can keep auth separate, audit what an agent does, set fine-grained permissions and easily switch between the agent apps. I built this over the last few days with my friend Konsti. It's open source and we’ve put a lot of care into the self-hosting experience. Now my Instinct has the same tools as Claude Code and Codex on my laptop. projects.title: 做了一个原生的 macOS Vaultwarden 客户端：基于 MyGo ，主窗口零 WebView，支持 Touch ID 与系统级 AutoFill
projects.author: vfasky
projects.summary: ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/uHyN54Z6.png) 自建 Vaultwarden 好几年了。官方的 macOS 桌面端基于 Electron，日常开着内存占几百兆，偶尔唤醒也有点迟钝；更关键的是 Safari 里的自动填充只能靠扩展，体验和系统原生有明显差距。 一直想找个轻快、原生的 Mac 客户端，后来索性自己动手写了一个，最近在主力机上用得很顺手，今天开源出来分享给自建密码库的朋友。 项目名叫 **MyGo Vaultwarden**。 #### 关于底层：为什么用 MyGo？ 这个项目是用 egoist 开源的 **MyGo** (`github.com/egoist/mygo`) 框架构建的。 很多朋友写桌面端习惯用 Wails 或 Electron，本质上还是把前端网页打包进去。而 MyGo 走的是另一条路线： - **后端是纯 Go**：处理 Vaultwarden 复杂的网络请求、AES-GCM/Argon2 加解密、数据同步以及快照管理，性能和类型安全都让人放心。 - **UI 是纯原生 Native UI**：直接绑定 macOS 的 Swift / AppKit，主窗口里**没有任何 WebView、HTML 或 JavaScript**。 - **极致轻量**：没有内嵌浏览器的开销，内存占用极小，原汁原味地遵循 macOS 的窗口、原生控件、菜单、快捷键和动画规范。 这也是我在实际写这个项目时觉得最爽的地方：既有 Go 写复杂业务的稳健，又能获得真正的 macOS 原生桌面质感。 #### 核心功能与体验 1. **系统级自动填充**：接入了 macOS 系统的「自动填充与密码（Credential Provider）」。在 Safari 或其它应用中无需常驻扩展，点选凭据并通过 Touch ID 认证即可填充。带有 TOTP 的条目，填充后还会自动把两步验证码复制到剪贴板。 2. **完整的个人密码库**：支持登录、支付卡、身份、安全笔记、SSH 密钥等 8 种类型；支持收藏、文件夹、归档、回收站与批量管理；`⌘F` 即时毫秒级搜索并展示网站图标。 3. **日常开箱即用**：直连自建 Vaultwarden 服务器，支持两步验证（MFA / 恢复码）、Bitwarden 兼容的 JSON 导入导出、Send 以及设备登录审批，并带应用内更新。 #### 安全性设计 做了哪些具体防护： - **双沙盒隔离**：主应用与 AutoFill 扩展均开启 macOS App Sandbox。AutoFill 扩展在独立的沙盒进程中运行，只读取一份经过权限和策略过滤的 Login 最小投影（仅包含用户名、密码、URI 与 TOTP），不触碰完整的加密库。 - **本地静态加密**：完整密码库仅以受 Keychain 和主密码保护的 AES-GCM 本机快照形式落盘。 - **主动防御**：在向服务器发起任何网络请求前，本地会先检查并拒绝弱 KDF 参数（如低迭代的 PBKDF2）；锁屏、睡眠或空闲 15 分钟后自动锁定。 - **写入安全**：网络异常导致的未知写入结果绝不会在后台静默重放，避免冲突覆盖。 - **更新验签**：自动更新包强制校验 Ed25519 签名与 SHA-256 摘要。 #### 目前的局限（先排雷） - **暂不支持组织管理**：当前版本只聚焦于个人密码库。组织条目能正常同步和解密，但组织管理（成员、集合、权限分配等管理后台功能）已延期到后续版本。 - **仅支持 macOS**：没有跨平台计划。 - **未做第三方安全审计**：代码已开源，遵循 GPL-3.0 协议，我自己每天在作为主力使用；但对于极其重要的数据，**建议试用前先通过官方端导出备份一次**。 #### 项目地址与讨论 - GitHub：`https://github.com/vfasky/mygo-vaultwarden` - 官网： https://mygo-vault.vfasky.com

projects.summary: 一代 FreeControl 是用 C# 写的（手搓，当年还没有 AI ），最近归档了。然后用 Rust + Tauri 2 + Svelte 重做了一版。 全程 AI ，无手工代码（包括官网、Cloudflare 发布、提交信息等），即使随手都能改好的 bug ，也会描述给 AI ，修改并落入 spec ，避免以后再犯，算是个人在 AI 时代快速迭代的路径探索把。 ## 简介 它就是个壳：常用参数做成控件，设备起别名统一管理，几台可以同时连，每台还能单独存一套参数。点连接之前，底部就能看到这次实际会执行的完整命令，复制出来就是现成的 scrcpy 命令行，想核对或者抄去自己用都行。 scrcpy 和 adb 没打进包里，首次使用时程序自己去下，通道有直连、内置代理，也能自己加代理地址，连不上自动换下一条，下完对一遍官方校验值。这么换来的就是体积：Windows 免安装单文件 6 MB 上下，Linux 给了 AppImage 和 deb 。对比一下，Escrcpy 同样是 scrcpy 图形前端，Electron 打包，Windows 便携版 116 MB 起。 ## 截图 ![设备页]( https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2/blob/main/assets/screenshots/devices.png) ![参数页]( https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2/blob/main/assets/screenshots/video.png) ## 仓库 https://github.com/pdone/FreeControl2 ## 官网 https://freecontrol2.pages.dev/

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我做的 Oxynote，一个可以自托管的工程团队内部 Wiki，Apache-2.0 开源。 我做了 8 年多软件工程师，很长一段时间里，我工作中最可靠的"文档"其实是 Slack 上一个只有我自己的聊天：Grafana 链接、调用其他团队服务的 curl 命令、哪个版本部署在哪里的笔记。后来试过把这些搬到 Notion，但文档和它描述的监控图表分别放在两个工具里，各改各的，很快就对不上了。 所以在 Oxynote 里，页面可以直接插入实时图表块，图表自己去查询 Prometheus、PostgreSQL、MySQL 或 MariaDB，就放在解释它的那段文字旁边。Runbook 和值班文档里看到的是实时数据，而不是过时的截图。 重要页面可以开启审核：修改先进入草稿，以 Diff 的形式展示（包括图表的改动），审批之后再合并到主版本，就像代码的 Pull Request。 另外它也是一个普通的协同编辑器：多人实时编辑、评论、标签、全文搜索，还有 Stripe 风格的左右分栏 API 文档块。内置 MCP Server，Claude Code、Cursor 这类工具可以搜索和编辑页面，这部分是可选的。 部署是一个 Docker 容器，内置 PostgreSQL，支持 amd64 和 arm64： bash docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -v oxynotedata:/oxynote/data ghcr.io/oxynote/oxynote:latest 技术栈是 Go 后端、Nuxt 4 / Vue 前端（Tiptap + Yjs），目前界面只有英文。欢迎有类似需求的朋友试用、反馈。

projects.title: Show HN: Lightweight, self-hosted, web analytics app
projects.author: composer42
projects.summary: Hey everyone! I just wanted to share a little project I have been working on. It's a lightweight, minimal, self-hosted, web analytics app alternative to Google Analytics, Umami, GoatCounter etc. Tldr: Created a self hosted web analytics app that is one binary (docker image available). AI was used to assist. Check it out if you care. I wanted to self host a lightweight web analytics app to see if any of my pages had any visitors, but all of the self hosted apps I found were either way to heavy for what I was looking for, or simply didn’t have a UI/UX I liked. So I just made one myself. The app features a dashboard with multi-site and subdomain support, and some simple filtering on date and visitor details (all EU regulation friendly, so no PIs such as IPs etc). A bit about the process: As I wanted it simple and lightweight, a single executable was the goal. Deciding for the frontend was easy since it doesn’t need SEO or any server side rendering, therefore I chose React with plain CSR (thankfully the DX these days is nice with Vite). The backend was a bit more tricky, since I wanted to have it fast, but also be able to get an MVP out sooner rather than later. The plan was thus two folded; first to do it in Deno to keep everything TypeScript and to implement features fast (it is still my go-to language for prototypes), then to refactor everything to a compiled language (Go or Rust) once I considered the app feature complete. So I started the prototype, but just a couple of days later, the announcement of Deno being sunset came out. As I had already gotten to a point where the backend was mostly functional, I decided to pull the plug early and refactor! The tough decision was Rust vs Go, and Rust ultimately won as I like the DX and how the language looks and writes a wee bit more. So I did what most engineers do in 2026 (looking at you Bun), and I asked my AI for help. Although I consider myself pretty ok with Rust, there are still parts that I haven’t wrapped my head around fully, so as the intention was to get something out fast, I had to bite the bullet. Lastly for the database I wanted something embedded, so SQLite was the natural choice. The final app ended up with a decent ~10mb (down from ~250mb with Deno) which I don’t think is too shabby. Some quick benchmarking on 1 cpu and 2gb RAM told me it could handle ~16.000 incoming analytics requests per second. The bottleneck being the database writer lock (give it more CPU, and it can do better). As this is a hobby project, and I dont expect a peak load of more than maybe 10 a day, I am content with this. I consider this app mostly feature complete, and will use it for the next month before eventually releasing a v1 after fixing whatever bugs that may show themselves. If you think you can improve the app further and want to spend time on it, feel free to make a PR ^^ To sum up the stack: React+Vite+TanStack+Tailwind frontend, Rust+Axum backend and SQLite database; all compiled to one binary of about ~10mb. Disclaimer: Yes, AI has been used for parts of the development, docs and for commit messages, but the code has been reviewed and iterated over by me, a somewhat reasonably sentient human.

projects.title: Show HN: Chkit – Schema, migrations and backfills for ClickHouse (like Drizzle)
projects.author: keks0r

github.name: obsessiondb/chkit
github.description: ClickHouse schema and migration CLI for TypeScript projects

projects.summary: Hey HN, im Marc, co-founder of ObsessionDB. We are open sourcing ChKit, our tooling to manage schemas, migrations and backfills for clickhouse. I am a big fan of the type safety drizzle provides for the database. Manage the schema in typescript and generate migrations from it is a powerful workflow. I always wished something like it would exist for clickhouse, so we could manage our analytical workloads the same way. It didn't exist, so we build it. We build it after running ClickHouse at petabyte scale in our previous company, were we managed hundreds of tables, MVs and endpoints reading from them. The way it works: 1. You define your schema in typescript, with typed helpers for tables, mv, column types etc.. 2. You generate the migration, that contains the DDL, to get your clickhouse instance from status quo to what your current typescript schema defines 3. Your CI can check for drift 4. You run the generated migration against production 5. You use the defined types in your code, to ingest your data while making sure it has the correct type. Bonus: if your schema change was BC breaking, we generate the sequence on how to backfill the data, into the intermediate table to migrate (this is quite the hard problem with large tables and schema evolution) In case you have already a clickhouse instance with a schema, you can pull it down and start using ChKit from where you are. Run our generator to setup the boilerplate: npm create chkit@latest If you folks are running clickhouse in production, I am curious to hear what other challenges you are running into.

github.description: Per-step reasoning effort for coding agents, picked by a classifier, without breaking the prompt cache. OpenCode plugin, Pi extension, and a local proxy for Codex CLI.

projects.summary: 我一直把编程 Agent 的推理强度开在 high，连改名这种小事也是，用量消耗得很快。但降到 medium 又会出错：在一个较难的 pytest bug 上，GPT-6 Astra 用 medium 5 次只解决了 1 次。 所以我做了 reasoning-router。编程 Agent 每次请求模型之前，它先让一个小型分类器（默认是 TypeSafe 的 Jev，也可以换成 Cloudflare Clef、Laya 等）判断这一步需要多少推理强度，再把结果加到请求里。 切换推理强度通常会让 prompt cache 失效。它用 OpenAI 的 configurationupdate 和 Anthropic 的对话中 effort 消息来改强度，之前的上下文不变，所以缓存还能命中。 在 10 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上，路由和固定 high 都解决了 44/44，路由少用约 14% 的输出 token，耗时少约 9%。只测了一个模型和一组任务，结果仅供参考。 支持 OpenCode 插件、Pi 扩展，以及可接入 Codex CLI 的本地代理。目前是 alpha 版本，MIT 协议。

projects.title: 一张照片生成 Bulin 47 爆款 freestyle 视频：一个跑在 Cloudflare Workers 上的小项目复盘
projects.author: channelerh
projects.summary: 最近 TikTok 上 Bulin 47 那段 freestyle 很火，很多人想把自己放进去，但现有工具要么得自己剪，要么出来的东西不像。我就做了个只干这一件事的网站：上传一张照片，几分钟后得到一段 9:16 、带原声的视频，人换成你，场景、动作、镜头都和原片一样。 地址： https://bulin47ai.io ### 它是怎么做的 - 模型：fal 上的 Pixverse Swap 。原片固定，用户照片作为目标人物。指定第 96 帧（第 4 秒）作为"选人"的关键帧，因为第 1 帧画面太挤，模型会把旁边路人换掉。 - 前后端：TanStack Start （ Vite + nitro ），整站部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上；数据库用 D1 ，照片和成片存在 R2 。 - 支付：Stripe 一次性购买，没有订阅。1 次 $9.90 ，3 次 $19.90 ，5 次 $29.90 ，生成失败自动退次数。 ### 踩过的坑 1. Workers 上没有可写磁盘。照片上传原本落本地磁盘，上线后改成直接写 R2 绑定，再由同域路由读出来。 2. fal 的成片放在它自己的 CDN 上，默认保存多久文档里没写明。分享链接不能赌这个，所以生成完就转存一份到 R2 ，播放支持 Range 请求，否则 Safari 拖不了进度条。 3. 单条成本约 $0.40 （ 720p ，原片 6 秒超过 5 秒，价格翻倍），加上 Stripe 手续费，毛利大约 90%。我一开始给了免费预览，后来算了一下，批量注册能把预览薅穿，就关掉了。 4. Google 登录一度报"找不到 provider"：密钥放在 Worker 加密变量里，但认证路由只读数据库配置。改成合并读环境变量和数据库就好了。 ### 想听听大家的意见 - 没有免费试用，直接付费，转化会不会太差？ - 定价 $9.90 一条，对这种跟热点的视频是不是偏高？ - 单模板这个方向值得做下去吗？还是应该扩展成多个热门模板？ 欢迎拍砖。

projects.title: Show HN: PanamaKVM – direct-booting Linux from Java 25 via FFM/KVM
projects.author: rusanoph
projects.summary: Hi HN! PanamaKVM is an experimental miniVM containing the bare minimum components needed to boot an x86 Linux kernel and run an interactive terminal. Its key feature is that it is built on top of Java 25 without using JNI. Instead, it utilizes the Foreign Function & Memory API (FFM). I generally stick to Java LTS versions - having worked with Java 21 for a long time - so I recently decided to check if any new LTS releases had come out. It turns out I was a year late to the party regarding Java 25. While looking through the changelog, I noticed the new FFM for native code and decided to give it a try. As it turned out, I was a couple of years late to the FFM feature :D, since it had already been introduced as a full-fledged part of the language in Java 22. One interesting thing I discovered during implementation was a quirk in the ioctl ABI: there seemed to be a discrepancy between the KVM API documentation and the actual implementation. The very first call I attempted was KVM_GET_API_VERSION, but it unexpectedly returned EINVAL. After tracing the execution with strace, I managed to pinpoint the root cause (which was nearly impossible to debug at the Java level): the call was reaching the kernel without a third argument (whereas the documentation specified two). As it turns out, when the KVM documentation says an ioctl takes no arguments, it actually does require one... Due to KVM's implementation details, it implicitly expects a third parameter - it just has to be zero. This is likely to prevent reading garbage data from memory. Perhaps some readers have insights into the underlying reason for this difference - or maybe it was just human error and "things just turned out that way." In any case, by following the instructions in the repository's README, you can boot a functional Linux kernel and interact with it via the terminal. I’ve only tested the launch using Alpine 3.24.2 x86-64 on WSL2, so that might be a limitation. However, if you run it on a different setup or on bare-metal Linux, that would be great - please let me know. And if something breaks in the process - even better - let me know about that too. As for what I haven't finished yet in the current virtual machine implementation: networking and persistent storage are missing, and there is no virtio integration. Multi-vCPU startup mode isn't supported either; essentially, the creation of a single vCPU is currently hardcoded. I’d also love to hear your thoughts on the project. I would particularly value any feedback regarding the use of FFM and the KVM API itself. I’ll be happy to answer any questions you have.

projects.author: Kerw1n1209

github.description: USB switch triggered monitor input switching for macOS and Windows.

projects.summary: 一款运行在 macOS 和 Windows 上的显示器联动工具。它监听普通 USB 切换器的动作，通过 DDC/CI 协议自动向外接显示器发送切源指令，让键盘、鼠标和多台显示器一键切到另一台电脑。 为什么做这个项目？ 很多双机办公的开发者（比如一台 Mac 办公，一台 Windows 娱乐或跑编译），桌面通常是两台电脑连着一到两台显示器。 目前的切换方案普遍存在痛点： 1. 硬件 KVM：支持 4K/高刷的硬件 KVM 普遍在数百甚至上千元，而且桌面接线复杂、容易挑线。 2. 纯软件 KVM（如 Barrier/Synergy）：通过局域网传输键鼠，有输入延迟，且两台电脑处于不同网络或内网隔离时无法使用。 3. 低成本 USB 切换器：几十块的切换器只能切键鼠，每次切电脑都要伸手去摸显示器背后的 OSD 按键，如果是双屏更要按两次。 它是怎么工作的？ 键盘、鼠标插在普通的 USB 切换器上，显示器视频线各自直连两台电脑。 两端运行 KVMFlow。按一下 USB 切换器切走键鼠时，软件捕获到设备离开/接入事件，立即通过 DDC/CI 向显示器发送切源指令（如从 DP 1 切到 HDMI 1）。 视频信号和外设依然走物理直连，零延迟、不占网络带宽、纯本地运行。 功能与特点 支持平台：macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows x64，底层核心采用 Rust 实现，跨平台体验一致。 多显示器支持：支持分别记录每台屏幕对应的输入源通道。 纯本地运行：不收集键鼠输入，不转发画面，无需注册账号。 开源协议：MIT License。 界面预览

The AI plans and sets breakpoints, waits for hits, collects call stacks and local variables, evaluates expressions and single-steps. It then reports a root cause based only on runtime data it actually collected.

projects.summary: java-debug 是一个 Java 远程断点调试 Agent Skill（标准 SKILL.md 格式），Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等支持 Skills 的 Agent 都能用。它会连接开启了 JDWP 的远程 JVM，由 AI 自行规划断点、等待命中，采集调用栈和局部变量，执行表达式求值和单步，最后根据实际采集到的运行时数据给出根因结论，而不是对着日志猜。核心是自研的 JDI 客户端：只依赖 JDK 内置的 com.sun.jdi，零外部依赖，以常驻 HTTP 服务模式运行，每个操作都是一条 JSON 命令，用 curl 就能驱动。 亮点 为 AI 驱动重新设计：jdb 输出的是文本，要靠 tmux + sleep 抢时序，而且默认冻结整个 JVM。这里改为 SUSPENDEVENTTHREAD，只冻结命中的线程；请求和响应都是结构化 JSON，命中时自动带回调用栈和局部变量，等待命中是带超时的阻塞等待。 断点不漏装：类还没加载时自动转为延迟断点；重载方法、同一行的多个可执行位置（包括 lambda）都会装上；多 ClassLoader 和热部署场景下，同名类的每个副本都装断点，之后加载的副本也会自动补装。 安全边界写成硬约束：命令端口只绑定 127.0.0.1，会校验 Host 头并拒绝浏览器跨站请求；eval 内置拒绝名单（System.exit、Runtime.exec 等）；命中时从不自动调用 toString()；disconnect 后被冻结的线程全部恢复。工作流还要求断点计划先经用户确认，结束时必须 disconnect。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-mac 它是一个 macOS 悬浮窗：聊天应用里弹出一条消息，悬浮窗会告诉你这句话的真实意图（8 类，零样本 86.4%）、风险分级（0-9 分）和几条候选回复，点「填入」进输入框——发送键永远由你自己按。 技术上有几个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 感知层没有侵入任何聊天应用：要么对前台聊天窗口按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），再用 Apple Vision OCR 只扫聊天区，按气泡和左右对齐区分正文、昵称、固定公告和引用；要么直接走系统文本接口读，不截图不 OCR。 2. 判断层是个本地 2B 小模型，一次前向同时出 8 类意图的全分布和风险分级，下载后完全离线；也可以配 TypeSafe Jev 的 key 走云端。生成层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek、智谱、本地 Ollama 都实测过），14 种话术并发生成候选，再由本地模型重排。M1 Pro 上出意图约 1.5 秒。 3. 坚持只读不代发：不模拟任何按键——合成输入事件会被部分应用的账号风控识别；「填入」优先走辅助功能接口写入并读回确认，定位不到就复制到剪贴板让你自己粘贴。 用法：Releases 下载 .app 拖进应用程序，授予屏幕录制权限即可。仅支持 Apple Silicon（M 系列）+ macOS 13+，MIT 开源。 适合每天在微信/飞书/QQ 里打字很多、想先看懂对方再回复的人，以及研究屏幕感知 + 端侧小模型落地的同学。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】麦麦点餐最优解 - 用 Python 算清麦当劳优惠券的开源 Skill
projects.author: minxin88

github.name: minxin88/mcd-meal-optimizer
github.description: 麦麦点餐最优解 · WorkBuddy Skill × 麦当劳 MCP — 用本地组合优化引擎算出最省/最健康/性价比最高的点餐方案

projects.summary: 一个跑在 WorkBuddy 上的开源 Skill：接麦当劳中国官方 MCP，拉门店真实菜单、真实营养数据、真实可用优惠券，再用本地 Python 脚本穷举所有搭配，算出「最省 / 最健康 / 性价比最高」三套能直接下单的方案。 它只依赖 Python 标准库，不需要 pip install，也不需要 MCP Token 就能先跑一遍离线示例看效果。 为什么做这个项目？ 麦当劳的优惠券是满减、折扣、品类限定混着来的，单看每一张都懂，放在一起就不会算了。 举个真实的坑：手里有「满 40 减 10」和「汉堡 8.8 折」两张券。 买一个 25.5 元的汉堡：8.8 折省 3.06 元，满减用不了 → 折扣赢 买两个（51 元）：8.8 折省 6.12 元，满减省 10 元 → 满减赢 再加一份 12 元薯条凑到 63 元：薯条白买了 —— 券已经封顶在减 10，多花的 12 元一分没省 也就是说，哪张券最省、要不要凑单，完全取决于你这单的构成，没有标准答案。 再叠上「预算 45 元、热量不超 1100 kcal、蛋白质要 35 克以上」这类约束，满足条件的组合轻松上千套，人手不可能算完。 它是怎么工作的？ 核心设计是把「算」和「说」分开： 用户说人话 │ "两个人吃、50 块以内、别太油" ▼ 大模型理解意图 ──► 翻译成硬约束（预算/热量/蛋白质/忌口） │ ▼ 麦当劳 MCP 拉真实数据 ──► 门店菜单 / 营养 / 可用券 │ ▼ 本地 Python 脚本（无网络）──► 穷举全部组合 + 券最优匹配 │ ▼ 大模型组织成人话 ──► 三套方案 为什么不把枚举交给大模型？ 上千套组合的枚举是纯数学问题，不是语言问题。交给大模型：慢、贵、会算错钱；交给脚本：几毫秒出结果、可复现、零 token 消耗。 功能与特点 真实数据：菜单、价格、营养、优惠券全部来自麦当劳官方 MCP 实时接口，不内置任何硬编码数据表 券最优匹配：对每个组合遍历所有券，按「这一单实际能减多少」挑最省的那张（一张订单只能用一张券，不能简单挑面额大的） 三种口味排序：最省（实付升序）/ 最健康（热量蛋白质偏离度）/ 性价比（每 1 元换到的蛋白质克数） 零依赖：Python 3.9+，只用标准库，无网络请求 先试后配：内置离线示例数据，python scripts/optimizemeal.py --demo 无需 Token 即可跑出结果 有边界：不主动下单、不自动领券；涉及花钱的操作一律先让用户确认门店、取餐方式和商品清单 实测 2026-10-12 在深圳北站站内一店（早餐时段）真实跑过一次：约束为预算 ≤ 45 元、热量 ≤ 1100 kcal、蛋白质 ≥ 35 g，共枚举出 127 套可行组合，最省方案实付 29.4 元。

projects.summary: （我来自法国，不会中文，下面的内容借助 AI 翻译，如有不通顺的地方请见谅。） 租房、求职、开户时，经常要把身份证照片发给别人。发出去之后，这份复印件就不受自己控制了。在上面写明用途、接收方和日期，比如「仅供租房申请使用，XX房产，2026年10月11日」，就很难被挪作他用。 但我发现，大多数在线加水印工具都要先把身份证上传到它们的服务器。为了保护证件，反而要先把它交出去，这说不通，所以我做了 Cachety。 它是一个纯前端的网页工具，所有处理都在浏览器里完成：用 pdf.js 把每一页渲染成图片，把水印画进图片里，再生成一个全新的文件。网站没有接收文件的服务器，页面的 CSP 设置了 connect-src 'self'，浏览器本身就会拒绝向其他域名发送任何数据。可以自己验证：打开页面后开启飞行模式，照样能用。 其他功能： 遮盖身份证号、银行卡号等信息，内容会被真正删除，而不只是盖上一层。 自动清除文字层、元数据和照片的 GPS 位置。 每份副本可带日期和唯一编号；可为每个接收方各生成一份。 可选 AES-256 加密 PDF；支持 iPhone 的 HEIC 照片；手机上也能用。 界面支持简体中文等 7 种语言。 已知局限：水印只能是文字；输出的 PDF 是图片，文字不能再选中，文件可能比原来大。水印能防止复印件被挪用，但挡不住有人翻拍。 免费、无需注册、AGPL-3.0 开源。基于 Next.js 静态导出，部署在 Cloudflare Pages。

projects.summary: Jev 聊天助手是开源安卓 App：回复前先读当前聊天、判断对方意图和风险，再起草候选回复并一键填进输入框，发不发由你。国内版支持 QQ、飞书、X、WhatsApp；同仓库另有英文海外版。不 hook、不改包，模型接口用自己的 Key。 亮点 1. 先判断再写字：判断模型先给出对方意图和风险，再据此起草回复，不是直接让模型编一句。 2. 不动聊天软件：不 hook、不改包、不读数据库，只读屏幕上正在显示的对话；读不到时本机 OCR 兜底。 3. 只填不发：程序只把回复填进输入框，发送永远由你点。 4. 国内版支持 QQ、飞书、X、WhatsApp；同仓库另有英文海外版。 5. 接口自己配：判断 / 回复 / 视觉三路分别可填，支持 OpenRouter 及任意 OpenAI 兼容接口。
