projects.title: Show HN: Pulse Local, a Mac budgeting app whose AI models run on your machine
projects.author: niztk
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Niz. Pulse Local is a budgeting app for Mac (Apple Silicon, beta) that answers questions about your spending with models that run on your machine. Local mode needs no account. The ledger and your questions stay on the machine, and the app sends no analytics or crash logs. I felt there are not enough consumer apps that run locally with no calls to the outside world that help us manage sensitive corners of our lives. This app in its local variant only downloads a couple of models and occasional updates, it does not send any analytics nor data. Features-wise, Pulse local is a complete budgeting app that offers an assistant built on top of a fine-tuned model and thousands of rules embedded in the code itself. I'm sharing it for free with options to help me continue experimenting with fine-tuning and expanding along this direction. How it works: you import a CSV from any bank, in any currency. When you ask a question, a tuned Qwen3 0.6B model reads it into a structured query, and code, not the model, does the money math against the ledger. A 4B checker model double-checks each money answer; when the two readings disagree, the app says it is not sure instead of guessing. That change took wrong answers from about one in five to 5 in 494 questions across our last three tests. The write-up covers how we test, the designs that failed, and the limits of the claim: https://pulseos.finance/pulse-local/writing/agree-or-not-sur... The tuned weights are on Hugging Face (PulseOS/pulse-local-qwen3-0.6b). Limitations: the first start downloads about 2.9 GB of models. With the checker on, a money answer takes 12 to 14 seconds (you can turn the checker off). Small models can still misread an open-ended question. The app answers in English. Mac only for now; Windows is next. The app is free. An optional Connected mode (Sync Pass, $29/year) syncs US banks through Plaid; transactions pass through our server's memory and are not stored. Feedback welcome, especially on wrong answers and on questions it should handle but does not.

projects.title: Show HN: Lightweight, self-hosted, web analytics app
projects.author: composer42
projects.summary: Hey everyone! I just wanted to share a little project I have been working on. It's a lightweight, minimal, self-hosted, web analytics app alternative to Google Analytics, Umami, GoatCounter etc. Tldr: Created a self hosted web analytics app that is one binary (docker image available). AI was used to assist. Check it out if you care. I wanted to self host a lightweight web analytics app to see if any of my pages had any visitors, but all of the self hosted apps I found were either way to heavy for what I was looking for, or simply didn’t have a UI/UX I liked. So I just made one myself. The app features a dashboard with multi-site and subdomain support, and some simple filtering on date and visitor details (all EU regulation friendly, so no PIs such as IPs etc). A bit about the process: As I wanted it simple and lightweight, a single executable was the goal. Deciding for the frontend was easy since it doesn’t need SEO or any server side rendering, therefore I chose React with plain CSR (thankfully the DX these days is nice with Vite). The backend was a bit more tricky, since I wanted to have it fast, but also be able to get an MVP out sooner rather than later. The plan was thus two folded; first to do it in Deno to keep everything TypeScript and to implement features fast (it is still my go-to language for prototypes), then to refactor everything to a compiled language (Go or Rust) once I considered the app feature complete. So I started the prototype, but just a couple of days later, the announcement of Deno being sunset came out. As I had already gotten to a point where the backend was mostly functional, I decided to pull the plug early and refactor! The tough decision was Rust vs Go, and Rust ultimately won as I like the DX and how the language looks and writes a wee bit more. So I did what most engineers do in 2026 (looking at you Bun), and I asked my AI for help. Although I consider myself pretty ok with Rust, there are still parts that I haven’t wrapped my head around fully, so as the intention was to get something out fast, I had to bite the bullet. Lastly for the database I wanted something embedded, so SQLite was the natural choice. The final app ended up with a decent ~10mb (down from ~250mb with Deno) which I don’t think is too shabby. Some quick benchmarking on 1 cpu and 2gb RAM told me it could handle ~16.000 incoming analytics requests per second. The bottleneck being the database writer lock (give it more CPU, and it can do better). As this is a hobby project, and I dont expect a peak load of more than maybe 10 a day, I am content with this. I consider this app mostly feature complete, and will use it for the next month before eventually releasing a v1 after fixing whatever bugs that may show themselves. If you think you can improve the app further and want to spend time on it, feel free to make a PR ^^ To sum up the stack: React+Vite+TanStack+Tailwind frontend, Rust+Axum backend and SQLite database; all compiled to one binary of about ~10mb. Disclaimer: Yes, AI has been used for parts of the development, docs and for commit messages, but the code has been reviewed and iterated over by me, a somewhat reasonably sentient human.

projects.summary: （我来自法国，不会中文，下面的内容借助 AI 翻译，如有不通顺的地方请见谅。） 租房、求职、开户时，经常要把身份证照片发给别人。发出去之后，这份复印件就不受自己控制了。在上面写明用途、接收方和日期，比如「仅供租房申请使用，XX房产，2026年10月11日」，就很难被挪作他用。 但我发现，大多数在线加水印工具都要先把身份证上传到它们的服务器。为了保护证件，反而要先把它交出去，这说不通，所以我做了 Cachety。 它是一个纯前端的网页工具，所有处理都在浏览器里完成：用 pdf.js 把每一页渲染成图片，把水印画进图片里，再生成一个全新的文件。网站没有接收文件的服务器，页面的 CSP 设置了 connect-src 'self'，浏览器本身就会拒绝向其他域名发送任何数据。可以自己验证：打开页面后开启飞行模式，照样能用。 其他功能： 遮盖身份证号、银行卡号等信息，内容会被真正删除，而不只是盖上一层。 自动清除文字层、元数据和照片的 GPS 位置。 每份副本可带日期和唯一编号；可为每个接收方各生成一份。 可选 AES-256 加密 PDF；支持 iPhone 的 HEIC 照片；手机上也能用。 界面支持简体中文等 7 种语言。 已知局限：水印只能是文字；输出的 PDF 是图片，文字不能再选中，文件可能比原来大。水印能防止复印件被挪用，但挡不住有人翻拍。 免费、无需注册、AGPL-3.0 开源。基于 Next.js 静态导出，部署在 Cloudflare Pages。

projects.title: Show HN: Search for AI agents with usefulness score built in
projects.author: Ayobamiu
projects.summary: Hi HN. I partnered with Simon Kley to build this project at innovation intelligence hackathon (Berkeley). Simply, we’re building a usefulness score on top of search for ai-agents. Instead of agents reading 10 ranked relevant pages, we run a usefulness score first and give it only those that pass. We’re able to save token and cost with this and slightly better answers. During our research, we found out that the current search results already do justice when it comes to simple queries. The rankings work well. They struggle when the task requires deep research or recency matters. So, we decided to talk to devs building ai-agents that research companies for sales outreach. Deep research and recency matters a lot to them. And in their words “every so often, stale facts reach emails.” They catch them by someone responding to the email or human review. From our tests, When an agent got outdated alert for 7 companies, it pitched outdated news for 4 out of them. Talking to the engineers already building this agents, we learned that cost saving is not the real goal. They’re ready to pay premium for confident results. So we added another check to our score. We call it superseding score, it check for pages replaced by newer news. For example, if two recent pages were fetched for news on Humane ai pin. If the first talks about how groundbreaking the product is and the second did that + talked about the HP acquisition, then the second page supersedes the first. The first page gets a lower score. We’re looking for feedbacks here and also teams that are building agents that research companies for outreach. Thanks. Plus, we rank a page once and every agent reuses it, so the more the agents use us, the cheaper the search gets.

projects.title: Show HN: Kitaphone – Call mobile phones and landlines directly from the browser
projects.author: beardnetworks
projects.summary: Hi HN Folks, I have been building Kitaphone a web app that lets you call regular mobile and landline numbers directly from your browser. The idea is simple, there are still plenty of situations where apps like WhatsApp, facetime and other internet calling apps aren't an option. For example, when you are abroad and need to call your bank, an airline, or a government office or your son/daughter's school. I wanted to make those calls possible without requiring users to install another app or buy a sim card or even commit to a monthly subscription. I built Kitaphone using Next.js and Twilio, One of the more interesting challenges has been making browser based calling reliable, especially when it comes to dealing with microphone permissions, sending keypad inputs to automated phone systems, and preventing abuse of free calling credits. The product is live and supports international calls to regular phone numbers, users currently need an account to make calls partly because each call has a real telecom cost. I am still improving it and learning from the people using it by receiving feedback. Fun fact: "kita" means our in Bahasa Malaysia, since I am based in this beautiful country and their people are so warm and welcoming I was truly inspired by this place and decided to name it our phone. Interested to know or receive feedback from HN folks who worked with WebRTC or VoiP in the past.

projects.title: Show HN: Are interstellar visitors alien probes?
projects.author: Lucent
projects.summary: There was a lot of debate about whether the 3 interstellar objects found might not be natural. Most of it cherry-picked a few oddities and claimed decisively, for or against. I don't have a strong opinion, and don't trust my eye for coincidence or to spot astrology-like "planetary alignment", so I simulated millions of random paths through the solar system and counted how many came closer than the 3 known objects, either to the planets or to or from nearby stars. 1I and 2I look like chance. Loeb et al. put 3I's planetary passes at 1 in 20,000. Scored against all eight planets and random arrivals of its speed, it's about 1 in 300. I don't know how much more easily surveys spot objects along the ecliptic, which would explain some of 3I's coincidence. I welcome forking the project and adjusting the assumptions I made, like a Bracewell or von Neumann probe would take a traveling salesman path, or that it would need to fly near multiple planets.

projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个 AI 病毒短视频复刻工具： 很多创作者都有过这样的经历：刷到一条宠物半路变身南瓜犬的视频、或者那个橙色房间里两人对唱说唱的 Hotel Lobby 梗，想给自己（或自己的猫）也来一条，打开通用 AI 视频工具却无从下手——提示词写不出那个“梗”的结构，硬写出来的片子既不像爆款，里面的“你”也随时变成另一个人。ClickClips 想解决的就是这一步：从“我想要那个梗”到“我自己的版本”之间的鸿沟。 它的核心能力是模板复刻。站内有 多个从真实爆款拆解出来的模板——宠物变身、万圣节装死惊吓、门铃摄像头宠物保镖、冰封产品揭示、Hotel Lobby 对唱等，每个模板背后都是一份完整的创意蓝图：节拍骨架、机位契约、一致性规则。你要做的是选一个模板、上传自己的照片、点生成，三次点击。 比较特别的是身份保持。你上传的照片不是“参考一下气氛”，而是整条生成链路的视觉锚点：人、宠物、产品的脸、毛发、轮廓全程锁定——宠物变身变的是形态，不变的是“那是我家狗”。Hotel Lobby 模板还带逐句说唱词，两位表演者各念各的词，口型跟着词走；背景色由参考色板精确锚定，不再靠形容词碰运气。每次生成会沿三条不同的创意轴各写一版故事（比如“镜像同步 / 逐句对飙 / 一稳一炸”），你挑最对味的那条再出片。 技术上它是一条四段式工作流：视觉模型分析你上传的照片、故事模型沿创意轴成文、导演模型规划分镜、参考图锚定的视频模型出片——各司其职，而不是一个提示词框硬扛一切。产出 6-15 秒竖版，直接可发 TikTok / Reels / Shorts。 选模板、预览 AI 现场写的故事是免费的，首页不注册就能玩；出片按积分计费，没有订阅。链接再贴一次： ，有兴趣可以先用 Hotel Lobby 模板试试水。 它的定位很清晰：不做从零开始的通用生成，只做生成之前的那一步——使用当前流利的模板快速生成流利短视频

projects.title: 【开源自荐】F3-Win：Windows 原生 Direct I/O 扩容盘检测与自愈工具，自带法庭级维权存证报告与极简热力图
projects.author: Wenaixi

github.name: Wenaixi/f3-win
github.description: Fight Flash Fraud for Windows - Ultra-high-performance flash drive capacity and speed test GUI (Rust + Win32 Direct I/O + egui)

projects.summary: 📎 项目地址 🚀 官方发版 (v0.1.0 单文件绿色版) 💡 背景与痛点 很多数码玩家或普通消费者在电商平台购买低价 U 盘、SD 内存卡或移动固态硬盘时，经常遭遇扩容假盘（标称 512GB 实际仅 8GB 报废黑片，超出部分自动回绕覆盖或读全0）。 而现有检测工具存在明显短板： 1. H2testw：近十余年未更新，缺乏现代硬件快速探测算法，大容量全盘漫长等待动辄数小时，且无法图形化定位坏块； 2. 原版 F3 (Fight Flash Fraud)：基于 Linux 命令行开发，普通 Windows 用户难以直接上手，缺乏原生高效的 GUI 交互； 3. 恶意固件进化：新型假盘主控具备“算力回放 (Compute-on-Read)”能力，利用原版 F3/H2testw 的线性同余乘数模逆元在芯片内现场运算伪造随机数，实施 0 字节闪存欺诈。 为了彻底解决这些痛点，我们打造了 F3-Win —— 一个纯 Rust + Win32 原生 Direct I/O 的单文件绿色扩容盘真伪检测与自愈利器。 ✨ 核心技术亮点 1. Win32 Direct I/O 物理直通： 采用 FILEFLAGNOBUFFERING | FILEFLAGWRITETHROUGH 彻底绕过系统文件缓存，并利用 VirtualAlloc 4KB 扇区对齐双缓冲，物理级压榨硬件总线带宽，测出真实颗粒吞吐。 2. 数分钟快速跳跃探测 (f3probe)： 忠实还原原版 F3 核心跳跃探针算法，在磁盘高位冲刷 32MB 穿透 SLC Cache 缓存，数分钟内侦测出假盘真实物理容量与硬件回绕（Wrap-around）边界。 3. 独家单向雪崩置换防伪 (Anti-Fake PRF)： 引入非线性单向雪崩置换密钥派生算法，Salt 永不落盘，彻底击穿假盘主控模逆元算力回放作弊，信息论强制其实体写入真实物理介质。 4. 实时仪表盘与扇区健康热力矩阵： 1200 点自适应平滑跟焦测速折线图（基于 eguiplot，精准捕捉 SLC 缓存耗尽与主控 GC 垃圾回收卡顿）； 1000 块全盘百分比归一化的扇区健康可视化热力块矩阵（直观渲染 Good、Bad、Changed、Overwritten 状态）。 5. 法庭级维权存证报告中枢： 首创首发故障扇区微观 Hexdump 取证，精准记录故障物理偏移与数据现场； 自动生成符合我国《消费者权益保护法》第五十五条标准的“退一赔三”法律维权公文模板与防灭失 Markdown 存证案卷，方便买家直接截图用于电商投诉或维权诉讼。 6. 双轨分区自愈修复 (f3fix)： 针对假盘提供一键安全自愈重写真实容量分区（Win32 原生 API 直写与标准 diskpart 脚本双轨），让缩水假盘变回真实可用容量的安全盘。 7. 纯正单文件绿色与原生系统托盘： 纯 Rust + eframe/egui 构建，无任何 C++ 运行时依赖，单文件仅 ~3.3MB；内置 Win32 原生系统托盘驱动三级自愈加载架构（崩溃自动重载、关于版本号弹窗、最小化防误触中断）。 📸 运行效果截图 项目内嵌瑞士平面设计极简品牌图标与 Fluent 深色工业风仪表盘，欢迎在 Release 页面直接下载体验单文件绿色版二进制产物。

projects.title: Show HN: Gondwana, a code-first C#/.NET game engine with WebGL
projects.author: isthimius
projects.summary: Gondwana is a 2D/2.5D game engine for C#/.NET 8 that I’ve been building over the past 16 months, using SkiaSharp for rendering. I've spent my career creating web and distributed apps and that has influenced the engine's development, so it will feel very familiar to anyone with a similar background. The engine is deliberately code-first in its implementation but still includes visual authoring tools and a custom CLI. I started creating Gondwana to host my own RTS and SNES-style games, to offload the game ideas percolating in my brain. I wanted to focus more on creating gameplay systems and was less concerned with 3D graphics. The predictability and transparency of the old Win32/GDI era were the ideal for what I was shooting for, but I also wanted something faster and more portable than GDI32. To that end, I am not trying to emulate the bigger engines. Spot! became my primary dogfooding project that I’ve since pushed up to itch.io. Getting a game to that point really helped burn away the cruft that accumulates from trying to create something like this. I was able to get Spot! to render at a consistent 120 fps on my dev machine. I experienced the absolute ecstasy of getting WebGL to cooperate with the engine cycle. And I discovered that even if Gondwana is code-first, you don’t want to hand-code platformer levels, so I added Gondwana Studio to the repository. Studio uses the same file formats that are understood by the core engine. Asset handling was beefed up, UI widgets were added for things like game HUD elements and engine diagnostics, and I fleshed out the CI/release pipeline to keep it organized. As it stands currently, Gondwana supports GPU-backed OpenGL rendering with WinForms and Avalonia hosts, and a dedicated WebGL path with Blazor. Recently a good bit of effort has been put into optimizing the rendering hot-path, reducing contention between simulation and presentation, and into making the visual tooling easy to use by people other than just me. I even was able to get itch.io deployment down to a single command in the custom CLI. The engine is still actively evolving feature-wise, but the core rendering is pretty solid right now. I expect Gondwana will remain 2D/2.5D with parallax support, so I am not trying to supplant Unity, Godot, et al. Also worth noting, Gondwana intentionally does not have an explicit ECS framework built in, although one could absolutely work well with the engine if desired. The project is MIT licensed, the source is hosted on GitHub, the packages are on NuGet, and Spot! is playable in the browser at itch.io. I will include several links in the first comment under this. I’d love to see what other hobbyists or indie game devs think of the project. Feedback on usability, as well as praise and/or criticism of the architecture would be awesome.

projects.author: SinanWang
projects.summary: 我想做一个能陪大家写代码、也能在休息时进去逛逛的小世界，于是有了 Vibe 村：一款面向 Vibe Coding 爱好者的像素风村庄经营游戏。 第一次打开需要加载游戏素材，可能有些慢。 你从一片林地和一间木材厂开始，慢慢搭起生产线、建造住宅、种菜、布置小院，把森林里的小村庄经营起来。 🎮 可以玩些什么？ 🪵 经营木材厂 招募伐木工和种植工，安排采伐、补种和运输，再把原木一步步加工成木板与成品。升级设备、扩展林区，观察哪里缺料、哪里积压，把整条生产线运转起来。 🚚 接订单、做生意 根据客户需求备货、装车、配送，完成订单领取货款，再把收入投入下一轮建设。随着发展，还能解锁更多设备和经营内容。 👷 招募经理，逐步实现自动化 收集和培养不同经理，提高机器效率，解锁运输和接单等自动化能力，看着伙伴们在村里忙碌。 🏡 盖房子，建设自己的村庄 从第一栋住宅开始，收集木材、钉子、油漆和砖块，完成施工与升级，逐渐提高村庄繁荣度。 🥕 种菜、手作、逛小院 经营之外，也可以照料田园、参与小游戏、制作手作品、收集装饰，按自己的节奏安排村庄生活。 💎 把编程日常带进游戏 连接 Vibestead CLI 后，可以同步 AI 编程用量，回到游戏领取钻石，用于村庄建设和装饰。支持接入 Codex、Claude Code 等工具；上传的是每日用量汇总，不上传代码或聊天正文。 游戏内置了全球排行榜，可以跟全球玩家对比Token消耗量，也可以创建一个群组，跟自己的几个朋友一起做一个小榜单互相比比谁消耗的Token更多。 ✨ 我最想分享的几个亮点 写代码与养村庄连在一起：编程用量可以兑换游戏奖励，给每天的 coding 多一点看得见的仪式感。 经营过程看得见：工人采伐、车辆运输、机器加工，资源沿着生产线流转，小村庄会随着投入逐渐成长。 经营与田园生活都能玩：想研究效率就调整产线，想放松就种菜、盖房、布置小院。 打开浏览器就能玩：支持中文和英文，适合在写代码的间隙回来看看。 游戏还在持续打磨中，欢迎喜欢像素风、放置经营和 Vibe Coding 的朋友来试试。也很想听听大家的建议：哪里好玩、哪里卡住、还想在村里做些什么，都欢迎告诉我。

projects.title: Show HN: Sufuku – Sudoku, but Numbers Repeat
projects.author: matthorse
projects.summary: Sudoku is short for "the digits must be single". I wondered if inverting this would work: "the digits must be repeated". And so, by swapping "doku" for "fuku", Sufuku was born. In short, instead of using numbers 1-9 for a 9x9 board, you use 2 twice, 3 three times, and 4 four times (for a total of 9). It plays differently from sudoku than I expected. I assumed it would be simpler, since you have fewer digits. But once I settled on irregular region shapes, I discovered that it can also be quite difficult. In sudoku you eliminate a number by placing it; in sufuku a number is only eliminated once all its copies are placed. So you count lines instead of mostly scanning the board. As I want the game to be approachable, the daily boards are mostly 6x6 or 7x7 for now. Larger boards are more interesting because 6x6 has only one set of numbers: [1, 2, 3]. But for 9x9 you can go with [2, 3, 4], [1, 3, 5], or [1, 2, 6] (I skip pairs like [2, 7] because I consider them boring). 10x10 is the first one that offers a set of four numbers: [1, 2, 3, 4]. Of course it turns out the idea has been around for some time: 2-3-4 Sudoku (Uwe Wiedemann) and Sudoku Ripeto (Miguel Palomo). I'm curious what you make of it as a daily game. Today's Friday, so the board is on the harder side. You can play easier boards in this week's archive.

If you get any question wrong or let the timer expire you're out for that game. Let's also get this out of the way: I used Claude Code to build this game. The first version took a couple of hours and in total I've spent about 10 hours tweaking and improving it. Happy to talk about that! The stack is simple: one Cloudflare Worker and D1 (SQLite), plain JS, no framework If you're a Soundgarden fan you already know what inspired the name of the game, the song Outshined. What inspired me to create the game is I love trivia (even though I'm not great at it) and a friend of mine built a nearly impossible game completely different to this. That got me thinking what kind of nearly impossible trivia game I could make. So far 92% of players fail, which makes me think I should make question #7 more difficult because 8% are getting all 7 questions correct. Totals since launch (not including my own playing/testing): - 651 games played - 178 (26%) out on the first question - 54 (8%) got 7/7 correct I've had feedback that has run the gamut from "I hate time games" to "This is so fun!" so I don't even know what to think about feedback anymore. Happy to hear yours!

github.description: TwexAPI Skills, MCP, and developer tools for structured public social data. Independent third-party service.

projects.summary: 文档： 开源 SDK / MCP / CLI（MIT 协议）： 我是这个服务的开发者，自荐一个读取 X（Twitter）公开数据的 API。 X 官方 API 改为按量计费后，读取 1000 条帖子要 5 美元，读取 1000 个用户资料要 10 美元，个人开发者做点小工具、写个研究脚本，成本很高。TwexAPI 只用一个 API Key，不需要申请 X 开发者账号，也不需要绑定你自己的 X 账号。 主要特点： 1. 支持高级搜索（按关键词、用户、日期筛选）、用户资料、时间线、粉丝/关注列表、回复、引用、转推者、全球趋势、X 长文（Articles）。 2. 按量计费，读取一条帖子或用户资料约 5 Credits（1 美元 = 100,000 Credits），折合每 1000 条约 0.05 美元。新账号赠送 20,000 Credits，大约可以读 4000 条。 3. 提供远程 MCP 服务（ Claude、Cursor 等 AI 工具，让 AI 搜索和分析推文。 4. 开源 SDK 覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Go、Java、C#、PHP、Ruby、Kotlin，另有命令行工具、n8n 节点和 Terraform Provider。 5. 搜索、时间线、粉丝等列表接口统一用 cursor 翻页。 一个请求示例： bash curl -X POST ' \ H "Authorization: Bearer $XAPISCRAPERKEY" \ H 'content-type: application/json' \ d '{"searchTerms": ["from:elonmusk"], "sortBy": "Latest", "nextcursor": ""}' 使用场景：舆情监控、竞品追踪、学术研究收集推文样本，或者让 AI Agent 定时总结某个话题的最新讨论。 说明：TwexAPI 是独立的第三方服务，与 X Corp. 无关联，只读取公开数据。 欢迎试用和反馈。

projects.summary: 我是 Chinese Gender Predictor 的维护者，自荐其中一个可以独立使用的英文工具：Lunar Age Calculator。 输入公历生日和要查询的日期，就能比较传统虚岁与周岁。工具先把两个日期转换为农历年份，再按“目标农历年 − 出生农历年 + 1”计算，而不是一律给周岁加一；页面解释了春节前后、生日和闰日带来的差异，便于向不熟悉中国历法的朋友说明这种计龄方法。 日期计算在访客浏览器内完成，不需要账号，输入的生日、日期和计算结果不会发送给统计服务。网站有可选择的访问统计，不能将它描述成完全没有统计。 同站的传统性别表只是民俗娱乐，明确说明不能用于医学判断；另有免费 A4/US Letter 派对游戏 PDF。制作过程使用了 AI 辅助，历法换算使用 lunar-javascript，计算方法和来源说明见 How it works。

projects.title: 做了个让照片替你吵架的小网站 Bad Times AI，猫狗也能上场
projects.author: fusheng0304
projects.summary: 给 AI 安排了一个非常具体的工作：替照片里的主角吵架。 比如： - 猫粮碗明明还有一半，你的猫却觉得自己快饿死了。 - 你刚说完「今天不遛了」，狗已经开始跟你据理力争。 - 刚下班，又收到一句「有个小需求」。 这些场景，大概都适合配一段 BAD TIMES 。 如果没刷到过这个梗，可以把它理解成一段很有戏的「吵架式表演」：抱头、叉腰、抬手示意「你先听我说」，再冲着镜头输出。配上音乐，整个人都写着「我今天必须把这事说清楚」。宠物版尤其有意思，狗站起来挥着爪子，像是在认真争取家庭话语权。 我围绕这个梗做了个小网站，叫 **Bad Times AI**，是个专门做这个表演的 **AI video generator**：上传一张照片，让照片里的你、猫或狗接管这段表演。不用自己拍，也不用琢磨提示词和剪辑，整个流程就是 **photo to video**。 地址： https://badtimesai.app/ 现在可以玩的内容： - **人物版**：让照片里的自己上场。 - **宠物版（ pet video ）**：把猫狗平时那种「有话要说」的表情，升级成一整段表演。 - **宝宝版**：把照片里的人变成宝宝，再一本正经地据理力争。 可以选 10 秒片段或完整版，人物和宠物完整版是 30 秒，宝宝版是 26 秒。成片带模板原声，支持下载无水印的竖屏 MP4 。首页能先看原版和宠物示例，开声音更有感觉。 里面也做了两种复刻方式：一种根据照片、音频和动作描述生成，另一种用参考视频引导动作和运镜。AI 的发挥还是有随机性，快速动作时长相、爪子和口型可能会跑偏，不能保证每次都跟原片一样。 目前最想打磨的是：让大家一眼看懂怎么玩，以及让成片里的主角更像上传的那张照片。欢迎 V 友看看，也欢迎直接指出哪里别扭。真人照片请用自己的，或征得本人同意的。 如果给你家宠物的这段表演配一句字幕，它会在跟你争什么？

projects.author: ginzberg

One of the things I'm really curious about is understanding LLM performance on subjective domains like design. As an experiment I built this game which presents two designs of the same screen, one of which was generated by AI. First you pick which one you like better and then which one you think was made by AI. Most design work happens in an existing product, so we set up this game to test that. As context, the AI gets 4 screenshots from the existing product, the product's icons + fonts, and a written brief about the screen it is asked to build. It then writes HTML which is screenshotted identically to the real screen. To get the data, we signed up for the products with test accounts and added dummy data. All of the inputs were manually checked to make sure nothing about the target screen was leaked in the prompt. You can read more about the methodology at https://www.realdesignbenchmark.com/methodology . After a few thousand submissions, the surprising result is that people prefer the AI design - 57% prefer AI, 33% prefer the real design, 10% say they are about the same. People are also not great at identifying the AI design, only 59% get it right. The initial results were all generated with Opus 5.5 (medium effort). We just added GPT-6.1 Sol (medium effort) tonight. Give the game a try. Feedback on the approach is appreciated. Or any ideas on what we might improve or try next.

projects.title: Show HN: TowerPanic – a family party game on a small FastAPI realtime engine
projects.author: ms209495
projects.summary: I want to show you the game I created recently and tell you whole the story/experience - including backend/latency/scalability. You can try it quickly without an account - I created game demo rooms (EU/US/JP) - links below - just be aware that anyone with a link can access join the game. Let's start with short description of the game itself: This is the TowerPanic game - you are standing on one of four towers, during each round some of towers crack, and some of these lean, and finally one of these colapse - you need to watch out to not be on the failing one. It's a multiplayer game for whole family. This can be also used as an icebreaking game - for people in any age. The game is safe for children - no violence, no strangers, no chat, no ads. Parent creates an account (free 14-day trial, then a paid pass) and starts the game - others join using a QR code or a link. Behind the game there is an interesting backend engine - I willdescribe it in a moment. Let's start with the history of this whole project: - I was playing with asyncio and fastapi - As an exercise I created a reliable chat application (multiple rooms, in each room each user can reliably broadcast a message to all other users) - I extracted communication to separate layer - creating network/application layer interfaces - 'reliable client' interface for client and 'state machine' interface for the service on server. - With these interfaces - I was able to create other service - an 'sgame' (simple game). With verified interfaces and created services (chat, sgame) I was able to ask AI to generate other tools/games - I was impressed by these results - the games/tools worked well - I deployed them on a remote server - I was surprised that the latency was very good - almost everything worked smoothly I tested the tools and games with my children and one of the game was really great. I decided to make this game public - I chose 'TowerPanic' name for it. I prepared an account/payment server for this game (as a separate FastAPI application). This was very good choice: - the game servers keep rooms only in memory - nothing persistent (rooms have expiration date) - the account server keeps all persistent data (it uses database) Because of this split I was able to figure out how to upgrade and scale frontend and backend independently - without significantly impacting users. I optimized the communication layer - so that it works in finite memory - only finite number of recent messages is kept, and I sent a full service snapshot (full state) to the lagging clients. The backend process (FastAPI/python) is limited by python GIL (only one core can be utilized) - to utilize all server cores I used HAProxy with consistent hashing to distribute rooms - so that users can be redirected to proper backend process. I tested how many rooms a single server can handle - it handles hundreds of active rooms in parallel with no significant latency drop. Before making it public I noticed that latency in other region of world might be higher and this could influence UX - I confirmed this using artificial delay on my remote server. I decided to deploy the application in three regions - EU, US, JP - to ensure low latency (below 150ms) in most of the world. The room is created in region closest to the user (best latency from the browser to backend). I needed also to prepare some legal documents (terms, privacy, refunds) - thanks to AI this was much easier. I'm a backend engineer, frontend/UI/UX were designed by me but code was generated by AI. To summerize all this work: - I'm happy that I was able to deliver complete game/complete product - I think the whole work took me about 20 evenings - I'm impressed that it was so short - I think this is because the technology I used is popular and all fits well - AI was great as a peer (to discuss the options for distributing the load, discuss were to locate servers, or discuss how auth/payments work under the hood, ... - based on this I could choose the best option) - AI was great for doing the non work which I'm doing ineffectively (frontend/UI/legal docs). The game is available at https://towerpanic.com/?ref=hn I will appreciate your comments/feedback: Product: - did you meet any obstacles to play ? - how smoothly it worked ? - please specify your location if it didn't work well - most important thing/things to improve ? - anything else ... Solution/Engineering: - one thing you will change in the architecture / approach ? - anything else ... projects.title: 【开源自荐】YN：面向长篇翻译的 AI Harness，实战测试达千万字规模
projects.author: TohmaN233
projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个我开发的开源翻译工作台 YN Translation Workshop，主要面向长篇小说翻译与游戏本地化。 YN 支持 TXT、EPUB 和横排文字层 PDF，把 AI 初翻、校对、原译文对照编辑、术语与角色管理放在同一个项目中。可以让 AI 起草，也可以自己翻译，只让 AI 检查指定内容，最后逐行审阅和修改。 我重点打磨的是 YN Harness，也就是围绕 AI 翻译建立的一套任务约束、检查、修复和恢复机制。长篇翻译中，模型可能漏行、破坏控制符、混用译名，或在任务没做完时声称已经完成。YN 针对这些问题做了具体设计： 1. 限定写入范围，强制检查结构 程序分配互不重叠的行范围，限制模型修改的内容；提交时检查行数、空行、占位符、标签、控制码和自定义保留规则，校对建议也要通过结构检查。 2. 独立复审，按问题行修复 译文先进入暂存区，再由独立 AI 检查全部机械风险行和抽样普通行。发现问题后交回原翻译 Agent 精确修复，保留其他有效内容；修复停滞时停止并留下草稿和诊断。 3. 管理跨章节的一致性 术语表、角色称谓、代词和口吻作为项目资料复用，按当前文本命中情况提供给 AI。新发现的译名保留来源证据，冲突进入修复流程，避免多个 Agent 随意改写共享资料。 4. 中断后核验再续跑 分块草稿、任务范围和复审证据持久保存。恢复前核对文件内容与证据是否仍匹配，保留未变内容的有效检查结果，减少整篇重翻和重复审查。 5. 由程序核验是否真正完成 任务、待修复问题、产物和最终全文机械检查都满足条件后，流程才算结束，而不是仅凭模型一句“已完成”。 实战中，最大测试规模已达 1000 万字、54 万多行。围绕这类大量文本的持续处理，YN 做了分块调度、状态持久化、精确修复和断点恢复等稳定性设计。 机械检查负责可明确验证的结构约束；含义、文风和语境仍需要 AI 复审与人工判断。工作台保留逐行编辑以及接受、拒绝校对建议的入口，方便译者掌握最终成稿。 项目采用 MIT 协议，提供 Windows x64 安装版和便携版。AI 功能需自行配置模型供应商，相关文本会发送给所选供应商。 项目： 下载： 手册：

projects.summary: Hello HN! Wonderhop is a small browser game with no account needed to play, everyday there are 4 rounds of 7 quesitons like "Name a food that a lot of people hate" The goal depends on the mode: Either gives the answer most people would give, the one no one would give, the oldest answer or the most recent one and there's a leaderboard for the day. The most interesting part of the project was understanding answers that are typed freely and in 10 languages, there was some typos, plurals, nickname, or even duplicate way of sayign the same thing. We needed AI judge that checks it really existes conencted to some API like wikipedia to judge the veracity of each answer really quickly (less than 1s on average) The percentage starts from an estimate but move really fast with the answers of real players. If the list missed a good answer, it gets added as soon as a few different players give it. (There are also a lot of secrets and pop culture references added in the game :) ) A large part of the code was written with AI tools, but the artistic direction the concept and every choice design are human-made We'd love to know if the goal is clear from the very first question while playing and were any good answers rejected unfairly We are a couple of developers from Montreal that like guessing games so we built this in about two month. projects.title: Show HN: Factory DS, A Factorio-Like Game for the Nintendo DS
projects.author: j_leboulanger
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Ronan. I love the Nintendo DS but ran out of games that kept me hooked, so I tried porting the kind of game I play today: a factory game in the spirit of Factorio, on a 67 MHz ARM9 with 4 MB of RAM. I had never written code for the DS, and I built it with Claude Code. I wrote the specs, the design and the balancing, and Claude wrote most of the C. The post goes through how that worked, and through the technical parts I found the most fun: - a 2048x2048 world that is never stored: terrain is computed from (x, y), only the player's changes are kept in a hash table - night done by changing the 256-color palette instead of redrawing the screen - power grids and pipes computed per network with union-find (there is a small step-by-step animation in the post) - trains with schedules, block signals and pathfinding, plus redstone-like logic gates - a headless Mac build of the game with a text interface, so AI agents could play ~470 test sessions and even help balance the game You can download the ROM (English and French) and play it on a flashcart or in melonDS.

projects.title: Show HN: What are vector embeddings? An interactive guide
projects.author: afistfullof
projects.summary: Hey HN, I'm Abdur-Rahman Butler, a machine learning engineer at Isaacus. I made an interactive write-up that walks you through the A to Z of vector embeddings, inspired by Brendan Bycroft's incredible interactive LLM visualisation guide (see here - https://bbycroft.net/llm ). Most of my work is on encoder models, and I kept noticing how few good interactive resources there are on embeddings. The ones that do exist tend to either plot some embeddings in 3D or only explain a narrow applied technique like semantic search or RAG. So I wanted to make something that teaches how embeddings work by letting you play with them. In the write-up, there are interactive visualisations that allow you to explore the concepts of vectorisation, cosine similarity, semantic search, hierarchical retrieval, clustering, zero-shot classification and deduplication. The centrepiece of the post is a game I've dubbed 'SemanticGeussr'. It's inspired by Wordle and GeoGuessr, and the goal is to draw a loop around a random target word by triangulating guesses on a 2D map of 43,339 common English words. It's admittedly a bit intimidating at first, as semantic space does not perfectly match our intuition of meaning. But once you get the hang of it, the game becomes really addictive. I recently had the pleasure of demoing the game to some law students at the University of Melbourne, and we had a lot of fun throwing different vector equations at it to see where they'd land. Some fun ones to get started with: london - english + french running - land + water avg(breakfast, lunch, dinner) 0.4 * noodles + 0.6 * pasta Although the post uses our embedding model, Kanon 2 Embedder, everything is pre-embedded so it all runs statically in your browser. We reduced the dimensions and quantised the vectors to shrink the whole vocabulary from about 311 MB down to 12.3 MB. I've also included Python snippets alongside some of the visualisations if you want to follow along with the techniques later. It was great fun to make and I hope you have fun playing around with it. Happy to take any questions, and if there's enough interest I might set up a dedicated games page for some of the other encoder-based games I've been working on. Do let me know what highest score you get based on your target word and chosen path :)

projects.title: [送码]从好用到爽用， Mu3ic 重磅更新，现已支持 Navidrome/Jellyfin/Emby
projects.author: aslehx
projects.summary: [上一帖]( https://www.v2ex.com/t/1246531)发出来一周，Mu3ic 从 1.0 更新到了 1.5.1 。楼里提的桌面歌词、媒体库重复、WMA 播不了、登录要手填 `http://` 这些都改了。变化最大的一件：除了 Navidrome / Subsonic ，现在也能连 **Jellyfin 和 Emby** 了。 - 主页： https://mu3ic.xyz - 直接下载 APK： https://dl.robb3n.site/mu3ic/Mu3ic-stable.apk - 已经装了的，在 App 里检查更新就行 ## 送码 送 20 个激活码：**评论区前 20 位留下邮箱的朋友**，我把码发到邮箱，送完为止。 邮箱收到的激活码一机一码，**不能换绑**，**24 小时后失效，过期不补**，请收到后尽快兑换，谢谢🙏 。激活入口：设置 → 关于 → Pro → 输入激活码。 没抢到的，也可以在 App 里用推广期特价 ~~38~~ **18 元**买断（推广价到 11 月 5 日）。买了 Pro 的可以进官方讨论群（ https://t.me/+RFkD6vL_889iMjQ9 ），进群后私聊我，拉你进 Pro 资深用户群。资深用户群后面会发布「下歌 → 打标签 → 曲库管理」的自动化入库最佳实践，定制需求也优先响应，Agent 环境搭建（独家）和开发最佳实践也会作为增值服务陆续发布，下图为独家 Mac 端代理工具和跨 Agent 任务编排系统 ![Pro 增值服务]( https://i.imgur.com/0F17Y3N.jpeg) ## 接下来做什么 Mu3ic 一开始的定位是「只做流播」。但上一帖和群里问得最多的是：我的歌就放在 NAS 的共享目录里，没架 Navidrome ，能不能直接听？ 所以方向调整了一下，分两步： 1. **先把服务器兼容做完**：Navidrome / Subsonic 、Jellyfin 、Emby 已经接上； Plex 看需要的人多不多 2. **再做文件来源**：手机本地的音乐，以及直连 NAS 上的文件（ WebDAV / SMB ），不用另外架媒体服务器。这次改架构时已经把位置留好了 你的歌放在哪、怎么连，欢迎在楼里说一声，我按需求排先后。 ## 一、能连的服务器更多了 ### 连 Jellyfin 和 Emby Jellyfin 10.9 及以上、Emby 4.8 及以上都能连。整个曲库同步到手机上，翻、搜、排序都读本地，下载、播放缓存、离线模式、歌词、歌单、收藏，用起来和连 Navidrome 时一样。 - 密码只用来换一个登录凭证，**不存在手机上**。服务器上改了密码、或者把这台设备退出了，首页会提示「要重新登录」，再输一次密码就行，界面和正在播的不会重来 - 服务器本身没有的功能直接不出：Jellyfin 、Emby 没有智能歌单，Emby 不存评分。设置 → 服务器的曲库卡上有一行「 Jellyfin / Emby 上有什么不一样」，所有差别都写在那里 - 这两种服务器不记每一次播放，所以听歌统计、听歌分析读的是这台手机自己记下的播放，卡片上会写「这台手机」 ### 登录不用再填 `http://` 和端口 @noming 提的。现在登录分两步：先填 IP 或域名，App 自己去试 Navidrome 的 4533 和 Jellyfin / Emby 的 8096 ，认出是哪种服务器；同一个地址上找到不止一种，就列出来让你选。第二步再输账号密码。 ### 外面连不上家里，自动换地址（ Pro ） 一个曲库可以存好几个地址，比如家里的局域网 IP 加外网域名。以前只在打开 App 登录时挑一个连得上的；现在用着用着当前地址断了，也会自动换到连得上的那个，**正在放的歌不停，队列还在**。 ![连接服务器]( https://i.imgur.com/Wt4vaVJ.jpeg) ## 二、声音：均衡器、歌曲切换、音质 ### 自带的均衡器（免费） 以前用的是手机系统的均衡器，段数和预设因机型而异，有的手机干脆没有。现在换成 Mu3ic 自己处理声音： - 10 段、±12 dB ，10 个预设加一格「自定义」，**每台手机上都一样** - 面板上画的是实际的频响曲线：曲线正好穿过每个滑杆，看到的就是听到的 - 自动防破音：曲线最高抬了几 dB ，就整体降几 dB ，面板上写的和实际降的是同一个数；关掉均衡器时声音原样通过，一个比特都不动 - 以前调过的，会换算进「自定义」 均衡器对所有人免费。 ### 每个耳机记住自己的那一套（ Pro ） 平时所有输出共用一套。哪个耳机想不一样，就在面板「当前输出」里给它单独一套：扬声器、有线耳机各一份，蓝牙和 USB 按设备名分。以后一接上就自动换，不弹提示。 ### 歌曲切换：交叉淡化 / 淡出淡入（ Pro ） 设置「播放」里选交叉淡化或淡出淡入，2–12 秒。 - **同一张专辑按顺序播时不淡**：现场专辑、无缝衔接的概念专辑不会被切碎 - 手动切歌可以单独开一个 0.5 秒的短淡化，点下一首不再是生硬的一刀 - 实现上是两个播放器轮流上场：这首快结束前，就把下一首在另一个播放器里准备好，到点交接 ### Wi-Fi 和流量分开设音质 @ershiwo 提的。设置「播放」里分成「 Wi-Fi 音质」「流量音质」两组（原画 / 320k / 192k ），流量那组没设过就跟 Wi-Fi 一样。出门从 Wi-Fi 切到流量，正在播的这首不打断，从下一首起换档。缓存里同一首如果已经有更高档的完整一份，低档的那份会自动删掉。 ![均衡器与歌曲切换]( https://i.imgur.com/W3G0YW1.jpeg) ## 三、听歌数据 ### 听歌分析（免费） 首页听歌统计卡下面点进去，用最近 60 天的播放记录和你的曲库算： - **什么时候听**：24 小时柱状图，可以分工作日 / 周末看 - **最近在听谁**：上期前 5 和本期前 5 的名次变化 - **新歌还是老歌**、**一次听多久** - **口味偏向**：哪个流派你听得比它在曲库里的占比多几倍 - **曲库用到了多少** - 最后是几件能一键去做的事：常听却没收藏的、入库了还没听过的新歌、冷落了很久的收藏、好久没听的老歌 全部在手机上算，不多发一个请求。 ![听歌分析]( https://i.imgur.com/untGRXZ.jpeg) ### Scrobble 门槛自己定 设置「播放 → Scrobble 上报」：播到 25 / 50 / 75 / 90%，或者满 30 秒 / 1 / 2 / 4 分钟，先到哪个算哪个（默认 50% 或 4 分钟）。按实际听的时间算，拖动跳过去的不算；单曲循环、按上一首回到开头，算新的一遍。 ## 四、曲库：几十万首也翻得动 ### 排序、筛选、跳转 曲目、专辑、歌手三页现在是同一套操作：次行「排序 · 筛选 · 跳转 · 计数」。 - 排序每项可以选正序 / 倒序，列表按排序分段，段头吸顶 - 按名字排时按首字母分段，**中文按拼音**，在手机上算，不用在服务器上填排序标签 - 筛选可以叠好几组，每个选项后面带计数 - 每页各自记住排序和筛选；点一首就在筛选结果里接着播，开着随机就在整个筛选结果里随机 ### 几十万首不再闪退 有位朋友的曲库 27 万首，同步到 9 万多首时 App 直接闪退。原因是整库一次性读进内存。现在整库的计算改成紧凑的内存表，只取用得到的那几首，几十万首也能正常打开、正常出混音。 ![曲库排序筛选]( https://i.imgur.com/lqCqpSp.jpeg) ## 五、细节 - **应用说明**：设置「关于 → 应用说明」，37 篇，写在 App 里，能搜，断网也能看。功能弹层里的「怎么回事？」直接打开对应那篇 - **更新下载更稳**：两条线路（国内、首尔），慢了自动换下一条，断了接着下、不从头来；弹层里看得到线路、速度和剩余时间。下完照旧校验 sha256 和签名再装 - **更新完告诉你更新了什么**：装好后发一条「已更新」通知，第一次打开时弹出这一版的更新内容，设置「关于」里随时能回看 - **恢复购买**：同一台手机重装后，在解锁页一键找回 Pro ；已激活的能查看、复制激活码，并说明怎样换到新手机 ![应用说明与更新内容]( https://i.imgur.com/WRlvmnK.jpeg) ## 两处调整 - **Pro 范围**：播放缓存、倍速与音调、定时关闭、深色与跟随系统改为 Pro ，均衡器改为对所有人开放。基础版固定浅色；已经缓存完整的曲目照常能播 - **隐私**：上一帖写过「检查更新不带任何标识」，1.5 起改了：检查更新、下载更新包、激活与购买这几类发给 Mu3ic 服务器的请求，会带一个随机生成的安装编号（存在这台手机上，重装就换），用来统计安装量和更新有没有装上。**发给你自己音乐服务器的请求不带**，曲库和播放记录照旧只在你的服务器和手机上 ## 最后 Mu3ic 是播放器，连的是你自己的服务器，不提供任何音乐。有问题、想要的功能，在楼里回我，或者来群里说。

projects.summary: Daybot is ranked number two in Canada, after Shopify, for making e-commerce stores. I've also seen that race conditions often happen on the client side and are never caught in test cases, because they aren't tested under load, or because clients sometimes do actions that are just random. With AI-generated code becoming more popular, we thought that an AI agent that runs in the browser at runtime, is very lightweight, catches bugs like race conditions, stops unintended behavior, and gets better the more users use it would completely change the game. projects.author: AmyangXYZ
projects.summary: 引擎： （npm: reze-engine） MMD（MikuMikuDance）发布于 2008 年，是基于 DirectX 9 的 Windows 桌面软件，至今仍是二次元舞蹈视频的主要制作工具。它需要本地安装，仅支持 Windows，画面效果依赖第三方 MME 插件。另一条路线是导入 Blender 渲染，画质上限更高，但学习门槛高，出片也慢。 Reze Design 在浏览器中重新实现了 MMD，并把它带到现代、面向未来的技术栈上：原生 WebGPU，不依赖 Three.js 等第三方框架；纯 TypeScript 实现 Bullet 物理；在线实时编辑渲染节点图；WGSL 特效系统。它兼容 PMX 模型与 VMD 动作，支持 IK、表情变形和头发衣物的刚体物理，打开网页即可使用，画面实时渲染，所见即所得。 渲染方面，材质以节点图描述，编辑时实时编译为 WGSL，光照模型参照 Unity URP。深空之眼、鸣潮、绝区零、星穹铁道等游戏的画风已移植为节点图，可一键应用。渲染管线为全程 HDR，包含级联阴影、bloom、景深、HDRI 环境光与 ASC CDL 调色，并通过 GPU 视锥剔除与 render bundle 降低 CPU 开销。 场景特效以 WGSL 编写，支持 GPU 粒子、骨骼拖尾和模拟网格，可读取骨骼运动、音频与歌词数据，也可向场景发射光源。粒子参与深度测试，因此能与角色正确遮挡。 动画方面，编辑器提供时间轴与曲线编辑器，在视口中直接拖动骨骼即可打关键帧，结果保存为 VMD，可在任何 MMD 工具中使用。导入 .lrc 歌词可一键生成口型动画，支持日名、韩文、汉字、罗马音、拼音和英文。 编辑器内置 AI 美术指导，可根据文字描述或参考图调整灯光、调色、镜头、着色器参数与特效，必要时生成新的 WGSL 特效和材质节点。AI 使用用户自己的 API Key，请求由浏览器直接发往服务商。 所有渲染基于场景时钟，离线导出与实时预览逐帧一致，支持 4K 60 帧视频及透明通道输出。 作品可以发布到场景画廊，获得一个永久链接。链接打开的是实时运行的 3D 场景，观众可以自由旋转视角观看，也可以一键复刻到自己的编辑器里继续创作。 自七月底上线以来，已有 32 位 B 站创作者使用 Reze Design 发布了 332 个视频，累计播放 65 万次、点赞 10 万+。统计数据每日更新，公开于

projects.title: Show HN: Train with Pasta. Workouts Powered by Apple Intelligence
projects.author: timshim
projects.summary: Hi Hacker News! I'm Tim, and I made y'all some Pasta. :) Others have New Year's resolutions to get fit, mine's to build an app in hopes of getting fit. Fun fact, I built something like this over 10 years ago but never released it. Co-founder issues, if you must know. I called it Träna Fit, träna being the Swedish word for train. I remember hiring a voice actor on Fiverr to record every rep count. Fast forward to today and the models are good enough to do much of this, and more. Pasta is a personal trainer app for iPhone. You ask for a workout by voice or text, Apple's Foundation Models build it, and a small voice model running on the phone (Kokoro-82M) guides you as you train. When it comes to planning and generation, I have to admit it still has plenty of room for improvement. I grade what it writes with evals. My favorite catch so far: I asked for a 500 kg deadlift for 100 reps, and the model built it, no questions asked. I'm hoping to make the evals better as I get more feedback on what's working and what's not. Over time, I'd like it to come as close as possible to what a certified personal trainer would build for you based on your goals and needs. I also realize that getting fit and working out isn't solely about knowing what to do. There's also the motivation + accountability part, and I do have some ideas on the roadmap that I'll share later. And I swear, it's not gamifying your health and fitness results. You'll need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27, and it's free for 7 days. Give it a try. I'd love to know what you ask it for first, and whether you'd do the workout it builds.

projects.author: EstanislaoStan
projects.summary: Hi Hacker News, I present to you "Lunchtime Broadcast", a walkaround-game (in the vein of Homestuck) where the mechanics are primarily walking your character around and talking to people in order to advance the plot. It's set in a fictional Korean high school, where you learn part of the vocabulary used in the webtoon "Sora & Haena!". I am a big believer in comprehensible input, and so I had Claude come up with its own original story that teaches vocab from the webtoon's first 4 episodes, but is targeted to my intermediate-ish level. The hope is that after playing through "Lunchtime Broadcast", reading the webtoon should be much easier for me. Notable Features : - Built for phones but playable on desktop - Every word in the dialogue is tappable and gives a definition Claude wrote in simpler Korean. English definitions are hidden behind a "?" icon - There is a dictionary that shows words by how often or how recently you have tapped them - Words that have been taught come up as multiple choice cloze review questions when you talk to characters. Many scenes have unique questions that use and quiz the taught vocabulary, even vocab from previous chapters - As players progress, they unlock some culture and grammar notes (which I had Claude generate and then fact-check against online sources) The development process (ongoing) involves me having Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT 6.1 Sol play through the chapters multiple times as a player in polishing passes, as well as feedback from me as I played through. I have currently only played completely through chapters 1 and 2, but there are 4 game chapters. The Korean lines were generated by Claude, not by native speakers, so there may be mistakes. Repo: https://github.com/Stan-Stani/jeomsim-bangsong Live Game: https://stan-stani.github.io/jeomsim-bangsong/

projects.title: Show HN: Forkcast, a meal planner and tracker with focus on weekly planning
projects.author: tizzyapunkt
projects.summary: Hej HN, I’m Tizzy. I built forkcast, a meal planner and calorie tracker that is built around planning the week ahead instead of ad hoc tracking Demo (runs fully in your browser, no sign-up): https://check-forkcast.tizzy.dev/demo/ Repo: https://github.com/tizzyapunkt/forkcast After signing up for a 90-day challenge to lose weight and get fitter, meal planning and meal prepping have been the most important things, next to exercising oc. The apps that have been suggested for planning and tracking (yazio, fddb, MyFitnessPal), were nice for logging what I just ate but annoying to use as a planning tool so this is where forkcast comes from and how it works differently: - You plan the week against your calorie and macro goals and see which days goals are met. Recipes are logged as their ingredients, not as one entity, which makes swapping ingredients or changing amounts a lot easier eg changing 100g of pasta for 75g of rice. - Recipes serve two purposes. Logging them (leaving out ingredients that do not make sense to log, like herbs) and cooking them (seeing steps and all ingredients). - The grocery list comes straight out of the weekly plan (and can go to Bring! if supported where you live). Packaged food comes from Open Food Facts, generic food from a local, editable catalog which is seeded with common foods. - AI only where it saved me time which was importing recipes from photos and reading nutrition labels. It’s optional and uses your own Anthropic key. Full disclosure at this point: I decided to build something that works for me, a dad of two (when I started they were two under two), full-time job, but still ready to get in shape! I would have loved to code this myself, since I am a software engineer and techie by heart, but my time was limited to reading specs, reviewing code and steering Claude Code. Without that, I would not have anything usable. The stack is Hono + React PWA and deliberately kept without a real DB, multi-user or the like. Self-hosting is possible with docker and under AGPL. I am posting to find out if anyone besides me finds this useful, and if so, whether a hosted version would be worth building besides the self-hosting option. There is a one click vote on https://check-forkcast.tizzy.dev Any feedback is welcome, even if it's just 'wow, yet another calorie tracker'. Oh, and in the meantime, I found out that the clever and creative name I thought I came up with was chosen several times already. Meh. Ideas welcome. :)

projects.summary: 大家好，分享一下我做的一个小工具 Tellcut 。 用 AI 做视频，最头疼的是改。哪怕只想换一个字、把某个镜头放慢一点，也得整条重新生成，生成完别的地方又变了。 前段时间 Claude Opus 5.5 出来，它写代码做动效很强，文字进场、画面切换、数字跳动这些，说清楚就能做出来。用代码做出来的视频还有个好处：哪里不对，改那几行就行，别的不用动。 于是我把它做成了一个网页：上传一张截图，或者写一句话，就能生成一段 10 ～ 30 秒的动效视频。 不满意哪里，在时间线上点一下那一段，说要怎么改，就只改那一段，其他地方不动 每改一次都会留一个版本，可以前后对比，改坏了随时退回去。 截图里的字和按钮不会糊 视频是 Opus 用代码一帧一帧写出来的，你的界面、文字、颜色都是原样动起来的。 比较适合做 App 上线宣传、产品演示、游戏广告、促销广告。有现成的模板可以套，也有一个特效库，看中哪个直接点。横屏、竖屏、方形都能出，导出 1080p MP4 。 打开 Studio 不用登录，就能先玩一个转盘广告的例子，点几下看看它是怎么改的。 现在是网页版，iOS 版后面也会上。 一个人做的，还有很多要打磨，欢迎大家试用、提意见。 地址： https://tellcut.app

projects.title: Show HN: Syncopate – free sheet music with piano play-along
projects.author: orcustblech
projects.summary: It’s my website where I host my arrangements of public domain music completely for free. Right now there are only arrangements for my instrument, tuba, but I’d love to add more instruments like ocarina or bassoon in the future. I started this because over the 10 years I have played tuba, I probably went through all free tuba resources on the internet multiple times and many pieces I wanted to play I did not even find for tuba. I’m working completely alone on this, so to be honest with you: I got a lot of AI help. Basically the pipeline for getting a public domain piece onto my website is downloading a well scanned score from a library like IMSLP, then a couple of Claude subagents read through it bar by bar and write the tuba part from it. A script checks for clashes with the piano accompaniment and a separate Claude session proofreads the result against the scan. Then I play it through myself, look through the sheet music and double check weird passages with other sources on the internet. Most of the time there are maybe 2 errors left in a big piece like the Can-Can, so the subagents already do a great job! The sheet music player is rendered by alphaTab. It had some bugs that I patched, at some point I want to send them the fixes so they can fix them in alphaTab itself too. I also got a recording feature, there I had a big problem with the piano accompaniment coming through the speaker and tried to subtract it from the recording, but it still doesn’t work too well sadly. Lately I rewrote my page turn logic to do half page turns, cause every musician knows how frustrating it is to not see the next notes until the page turns. My big vision is a bit unrealistic, but I want to somehow host all public domain pieces there are for free for all instruments, so people don’t have to pay $20 anymore for some Danse macabre euphonium arrangement for example... Would love to know from the musicians here whether you like my current arrangements and if you have ideas for other pain points I can try to fix for free with my website? Thanks!

github.description: USB switch triggered monitor input switching for macOS and Windows.

projects.summary: 一款运行在 macOS 和 Windows 上的显示器联动工具。它监听普通 USB 切换器的动作，通过 DDC/CI 协议自动向外接显示器发送切源指令，让键盘、鼠标和多台显示器一键切到另一台电脑。 为什么做这个项目？ 很多双机办公的开发者（比如一台 Mac 办公，一台 Windows 娱乐或跑编译），桌面通常是两台电脑连着一到两台显示器。 目前的切换方案普遍存在痛点： 1. 硬件 KVM：支持 4K/高刷的硬件 KVM 普遍在数百甚至上千元，而且桌面接线复杂、容易挑线。 2. 纯软件 KVM（如 Barrier/Synergy）：通过局域网传输键鼠，有输入延迟，且两台电脑处于不同网络或内网隔离时无法使用。 3. 低成本 USB 切换器：几十块的切换器只能切键鼠，每次切电脑都要伸手去摸显示器背后的 OSD 按键，如果是双屏更要按两次。 它是怎么工作的？ 键盘、鼠标插在普通的 USB 切换器上，显示器视频线各自直连两台电脑。 两端运行 KVMFlow。按一下 USB 切换器切走键鼠时，软件捕获到设备离开/接入事件，立即通过 DDC/CI 向显示器发送切源指令（如从 DP 1 切到 HDMI 1）。 视频信号和外设依然走物理直连，零延迟、不占网络带宽、纯本地运行。 功能与特点 支持平台：macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows x64，底层核心采用 Rust 实现，跨平台体验一致。 多显示器支持：支持分别记录每台屏幕对应的输入源通道。 纯本地运行：不收集键鼠输入，不转发画面，无需注册账号。 开源协议：MIT License。 界面预览

projects.title: Show HN: Tilefinch – a from-scratch* web browser for the PSP (333Mhz, 64MB RAM)
projects.author: stjanovitz
projects.summary: I picked up my PSP for the first time in about a decade and wanted to find out three things: how far the hardware could be pushed, how much of the modern web fits on it, and what today’s coding agents can do. A web browser tests all three. Tilefinch runs entirely on a PSP-3000: networking, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, layout and rendering, over Wi-Fi, with no proxy or companion computer. The style, layout, paint, media and UI layers are new C code and a patched QuickJS runs the JavaScript. Each page gets a single 32 MB budget covering DOM, JavaScript, CSS, images, layout and tiles. A few things that work: logged-out ChatGPT rendering a response; YouTube and HTML video through the PSP’s hardware decoder, at up to 360p; Canvas 2D and WebGL 1 on the PSP’s graphics chip (the repo includes a new 3D tank game as a demo). There's also modern browser features like Reader mode, dark mode, an ad blocker, language packs and in-app updates. However, some sites are too large (in which the browser offers a "Basic" mode) and most are slow to render.

projects.summary: 一个跑在 WorkBuddy 上的开源 Skill：接麦当劳中国官方 MCP，拉门店真实菜单、真实营养数据、真实可用优惠券，再用本地 Python 脚本穷举所有搭配，算出「最省 / 最健康 / 性价比最高」三套能直接下单的方案。 它只依赖 Python 标准库，不需要 pip install，也不需要 MCP Token 就能先跑一遍离线示例看效果。 为什么做这个项目？ 麦当劳的优惠券是满减、折扣、品类限定混着来的，单看每一张都懂，放在一起就不会算了。 举个真实的坑：手里有「满 40 减 10」和「汉堡 8.8 折」两张券。 买一个 25.5 元的汉堡：8.8 折省 3.06 元，满减用不了 → 折扣赢 买两个（51 元）：8.8 折省 6.12 元，满减省 10 元 → 满减赢 再加一份 12 元薯条凑到 63 元：薯条白买了 —— 券已经封顶在减 10，多花的 12 元一分没省 也就是说，哪张券最省、要不要凑单，完全取决于你这单的构成，没有标准答案。 再叠上「预算 45 元、热量不超 1100 kcal、蛋白质要 35 克以上」这类约束，满足条件的组合轻松上千套，人手不可能算完。 它是怎么工作的？ 核心设计是把「算」和「说」分开： 用户说人话 │ "两个人吃、50 块以内、别太油" ▼ 大模型理解意图 ──► 翻译成硬约束（预算/热量/蛋白质/忌口） │ ▼ 麦当劳 MCP 拉真实数据 ──► 门店菜单 / 营养 / 可用券 │ ▼ 本地 Python 脚本（无网络）──► 穷举全部组合 + 券最优匹配 │ ▼ 大模型组织成人话 ──► 三套方案 为什么不把枚举交给大模型？ 上千套组合的枚举是纯数学问题，不是语言问题。交给大模型：慢、贵、会算错钱；交给脚本：几毫秒出结果、可复现、零 token 消耗。 功能与特点 真实数据：菜单、价格、营养、优惠券全部来自麦当劳官方 MCP 实时接口，不内置任何硬编码数据表 券最优匹配：对每个组合遍历所有券，按「这一单实际能减多少」挑最省的那张（一张订单只能用一张券，不能简单挑面额大的） 三种口味排序：最省（实付升序）/ 最健康（热量蛋白质偏离度）/ 性价比（每 1 元换到的蛋白质克数） 零依赖：Python 3.9+，只用标准库，无网络请求 先试后配：内置离线示例数据，python scripts/optimizemeal.py --demo 无需 Token 即可跑出结果 有边界：不主动下单、不自动领券；涉及花钱的操作一律先让用户确认门店、取餐方式和商品清单 实测 2026-10-12 在深圳北站站内一店（早餐时段）真实跑过一次：约束为预算 ≤ 45 元、热量 ≤ 1100 kcal、蛋白质 ≥ 35 g，共枚举出 127 套可行组合，最省方案实付 29.4 元。

Around 2010-2012, at the peak of the Vocaloid boom, I made music videos for a Vocaloid producer. I skipped university for days to edit videos, and it was honestly the most fulfilling time of my life. As of October 2026 there are about 30,000 songs, 800 producers, and 700 singers, and I add more every week. It's completely free. If a song you're looking for is missing, let me know. English isn't my first language, so I wrote this in Japanese and used AI to translate it.

projects.title: Show HN: Tracon (air traffic control for subagents)
projects.author: allocate
projects.summary: My Claude Code workflow usually involves... a lot of subagents. I make one Opus model coordinate work as my tech lead, it dispatches subagents using models appropriate for the task into their own git worktrees, and then I try to multitask and do something else while they run. I'd been finding lately (particularly with Opus 5.5) that there was a ton of drift and instances of subagents not doing anything and it was evading the attention of the TL despite the instructions I gave it to have them report in at a regular cadence. Running tracon in a split terminal is my new personal workflow. It gives me early indicators when things start going off the rails (ex. blocked on a prompt, idle, looping on a failing command, simultaneous edits to files other subagents are editing, drifting off the brief, etc.) and I can interrogate the subagent's workflow and by pressing n the main agent gets a note to make a call on how and if to correct it. Read-only and runs on your machine: it tails transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/ and checks each worktree with ps, lsof, and git -- only thing that leaves your machine is what the Haiku judge reads for classification (or optionally you can turn that off with --no-judge). I've found it super useful for the game I'm building and figured others in the community might also find it useful. If you just want to give it a spin without committing: uvx tracon --demo macOS and Linux, Python 3.12+, MIT. (Not affiliated with Anthropic.)

projects.title: Show HN: Stoke Money – Personal finance app built around a cash flow forecast
projects.author: _wesley
projects.summary: Hi HN, I've been through many finance tracking apps, starting with Personal Capital, then Monarch, and most recently Copilot. None of them have worked perfectly for my needs. All of these apps tend to model “cash flow” as the net sum of your transactions during a month, yet while credit card charges are reported immediately, they are typically deducted from checking (cash) accounts the following month when the bill is due. As a result, I've always had to maintain a separate spreadsheet to track my actual cash flow. These apps also have a huge focus on managing budgets, which has never been for me. My spending is rarely consistent month-to-month, so every month I'm comparing my fully justified spending against my budget, and tweaking my budget until I “pass”. So I built yet another finance tracking app. It has the usual components - accounts, transactions, categories - but the core is a cash flow projection engine, and everything else is built around it. Budgets are gone. Instead, each income/spending category is projected forward from your historical activity, but not as a flat monthly number. They land in whatever account you historically use (e.g. checking account for paychecks/rent/bills, credit/debit cards for daily spending). Credit card payments are modeled automatically based on your projected credit card balance. You can set up your own recurring transfers between accounts as well, to model savings, for example. The end result is that the app can forecast how your cash moves, and you can see in advance when any account might run low. If all of your accounts look good for the next 12 months, maybe you don't have a budgeting problem. What’s made the biggest difference for me has been the MCP integration, which I have connected to Claude (but can be connected to any AI agent of your choice). I have asked it to import historical transactions by uploading PDF account statements, categorize/tag all transactions that took place while I was on vacation, and plan transfers across my accounts to cover expected payments. I hope some people that share my frustrations will find this app useful.

projects.title: Show HN: OutClocked, a nearly impossible daily trivia game
projects.author: karolgajda
projects.summary: I really wanted to use an em dash in that title, but now I feel like I can't. This is a time-based trivia game with a bit of a twist. 7 questions. 60 seconds to answer the first. 0.94 seconds to answer the last. If you get any question wrong or let the timer expire you're out for that game. Let's also get this out of the way: I used Claude Code to build this game. The first version took a couple of hours and in total I've spent about 10 hours tweaking and improving it. Happy to talk about that! The stack is simple: one Cloudflare Worker and D1 (SQLite), plain JS, no framework If you're a Soundgarden fan you already know what inspired the name of the game, the song Outshined. What inspired me to create the game is I love trivia (even though I'm not great at it) and a friend of mine built a nearly impossible game completely different to this. That got me thinking what kind of nearly impossible trivia game I could make. So far 92% of players fail, which makes me think I should make question #7 more difficult because 8% are getting all 7 questions correct. Totals since launch (not including my own playing/testing): - 651 games played - 178 (26%) out on the first question - 54 (8%) got 7/7 correct I've had feedback that has run the gamut from "I hate time games" to "This is so fun!" so I don't even know what to think about feedback anymore. Happy to hear yours!

projects.summary: 今年想开一家实体店，需要经常找位置、查看周边情况。用高德有时候有点麻烦，记录自己的想法和实地照片也不太方便，所以自己写了一套选址工具。 注册即可体验： https://wash.ailibrary.space/ 基于高德 API 做的，侧重于快速查询周边情况，同时接入 Agent 来找位置和做评估。整体系统分为下面四个部分： ### 1. 地图选址 核心功能，可以定位查看周边 1 、3 、5 km 范围内的小区、商超等数据。 另外，基于 WorldPop 人口模型数据做了人口热力图，还能查看 20–54 岁人群的性别比例。AI 选址会根据业态偏好，拉取对应的周边信息，再结合交通条件和人口数据进行分析。 ### 2. 点位记录 选中点位后，可以快速加入记录，主要用来保存看中这个位置时的一些想法，以及实地考察时拍的照片。 ### 3. 选址评估 Agent 会根据内置的一些选址策略评估点位，最后通过绘图模型绘制一张直观的评估报告图。 ### 4. AI 能力 AI 助手在各个页面都可以调出，也能调用系统里的功能。整体希望往 AI Native 的方向发展一些。 目前内置了多种实体店类型的选址 Skill ，也接入了一个商业博主的商业分析 Skill ，可以一键使用。 这是一次把一些日常需求流快速用 ai 完成的尝试，整体使用 image2.5 做 ui 设计，gpt6.1-sol 做实现，后续会结合更多的软硬件+ai ，对实体比较有兴趣 下面是系统的一些图片： [![地图选址与人口热力图]( https://i.postimg.cc/05Xtyf1t/image.png)]( https://postimg.cc/yW9hf0d9) [![选址评估报告]( https://i.postimg.cc/pLWycDyF/image.png)]( https://postimg.cc/GHfcHTFL) [![AI 对话]( https://i.postimg.cc/C5CLm1gt/image.png)]( https://postimg.cc/8f5SCTsB)

projects.title: Show HN: Mac Markdown reader for your AI agents
projects.author: kirillzubovsky
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Kirill. A dozen coding agents running in parallel, producing walls of suggestions, comments and ideas, all at once, all crammed into 88 columns of terminal scrollback, all gone the moment you run the next command. Does this sound familiar? FolderMd ( https://foldermd.com ) might be for you. It's free, and it's fast, and your agents can use it. I made it because I just couldn't handle it anymore. It's a small Mac app that gives those documents a home. Agents read our explainer and then learn to write markdown into a .foldermd/, instead of writing it into the terminal. FolderMD then opens each one instantly and renders it like a book: real typography, syntax-highlighted code, Mermaid diagrams, light and dark mode. You can edit a doc and save it, you can then add comments just like you would in Google Doc, and pass those comments to the agent. Let me know what you think, and if you want to see any features, and improvements. Thanks! -K.

projects.title: Show HN: Forkcast, a meal planner and tracker with focus on weekly planning
projects.author: tizzyapunkt
projects.summary: Hej HN, I’m Tizzy. I built forkcast, a meal planner and calorie tracker that is built around planning the week ahead instead of ad hoc tracking Demo (runs fully in your browser, no sign-up): https://check-forkcast.tizzy.dev/demo/ Repo: https://github.com/tizzyapunkt/forkcast After signing up for a 90-day challenge to lose weight and get fitter, meal planning and meal prepping have been the most important things, next to exercising oc. The apps that have been suggested for planning and tracking (yazio, fddb, MyFitnessPal), were nice for logging what I just ate but annoying to use as a planning tool so this is where forkcast comes from and how it works differently: - You plan the week against your calorie and macro goals and see which days goals are met. Recipes are logged as their ingredients, not as one entity, which makes swapping ingredients or changing amounts a lot easier eg changing 100g of pasta for 75g of rice. - Recipes serve two purposes. Logging them (leaving out ingredients that do not make sense to log, like herbs) and cooking them (seeing steps and all ingredients). - The grocery list comes straight out of the weekly plan (and can go to Bring! if supported where you live). Packaged food comes from Open Food Facts, generic food from a local, editable catalog which is seeded with common foods. - AI only where it saved me time which was importing recipes from photos and reading nutrition labels. It’s optional and uses your own Anthropic key. Full disclosure at this point: I decided to build something that works for me, a dad of two (when I started they were two under two), full-time job, but still ready to get in shape! I would have loved to code this myself, since I am a software engineer and techie by heart, but my time was limited to reading specs, reviewing code and steering Claude Code. Without that, I would not have anything usable. The stack is Hono + React PWA and deliberately kept without a real DB, multi-user or the like. Self-hosting is possible with docker and under AGPL. I am posting to find out if anyone besides me finds this useful, and if so, whether a hosted version would be worth building besides the self-hosting option. There is a one click vote on https://check-forkcast.tizzy.dev Any feedback is welcome, even if it's just 'wow, yet another calorie tracker'. Oh, and in the meantime, I found out that the clever and creative name I thought I came up with was chosen several times already. Meh. Ideas welcome. :)

projects.title: Show HN: I found a new planetary candidate in Kepler Data with AI
projects.author: kuberwastaken
projects.summary: Hey HN! I was playing around with the Kepler and TESS data last weekend when I hacked around a way to pixel-peep stars dimming periodically to potentially find new exoplanets with Codex. I ended up running the engine to find an interesting signal in Kepler data that was uncatalogued with a dip repeating every 13.77 days around KIC 5689121, a red dwarf in Lyra about 970 light-years away. If it's a planet, it'd be roughly 2.5–3 times Earth's radius ! Funnily enough, this candidate is just 7.1 arcseconds from a much brighter neighbour (KIC 5689116) and is very hard to see because of how much brighter it is (probably why it went unnoticed for so long) Of course, there's work to do before calling it confirmed - my TRICERATOPS analysis is about 6.9% and we have to get IR/AO / Keck observations to prove it's out there ! (which I'm honestly intimidated by but cautiously optimistic about because I've never worked in non-CS adjacent research) but I found the activity of making cool tools to potentially discover things about our universe quite fun ! Would love feedback, especially from anyone who's worked with Kepler data or exoplanet validation :) https://x.com/kuberwastaken/status/2109240782368751834

projects.title: Show HN: Lemma, an IDE for reading mathematics (macOS, open source)
projects.author: fus3r
projects.summary: I built Lemma while working through The Elements of Statistical Learning (using the Preview app). Kept running into references like "(3.41)" or "by Theorem 2.3" forcing me to scroll back through the entire book. And whenever a proof wasn’t detailed enough, I'd screenshot it, ask ChatGPT to explain, then go back to the PDF to add manual notes. Got pretty annoying. That led me to Lemma: it reads a PDF once (locally), lets you jump around between equations, theorems, etc. without constantly scrolling. I gave it a VS Code look because yes, I'm addicted to VS Code (there are other themes for normal people). A non-exhaustive list of things it can do (right now): - References to theorems, equations, figures, citations and index entries are all clickable (you can peek at them without leaving the page) - You can ask an agent or ChatGPT Web for explanations, longer proofs with one click, save the output in Lemma - When the pdf says “it is easy to show” or “proof left to the reader”, you can write the missing steps in LaTeX, and Lemma checks it on random numerical inputs and gives counterexamples if it’s wrong. You can also fold proofs to try them yourself first, and keep notes attached to specific passages (with exports to Markdown, Anki and Jupyter). Built in Swift/SwiftUI using PDFKit. The analysis runs in a helper process at low priority. No account, no telemetry, and it's GPL. It’s for macOS 15+ only for now (unless a lot of people find it useful, then I’ll probably do it for other OSes). It still struggles with some PDFs (scanned ones, other languages, different numbering, etc.) If you try it on whatever you're reading and encounter some problems, feel free to open an issue!

As of October 2026 there are about 30,000 songs, 800 producers, and 700 singers, and I add more every week. It's completely free. If a song you're looking for is missing, let me know. projects.title: Show HN: Tracon (air traffic control for subagents)
projects.author: allocate
projects.summary: My Claude Code workflow usually involves... a lot of subagents. I make one Opus model coordinate work as my tech lead, it dispatches subagents using models appropriate for the task into their own git worktrees, and then I try to multitask and do something else while they run. I'd been finding lately (particularly with Opus 5.5) that there was a ton of drift and instances of subagents not doing anything and it was evading the attention of the TL despite the instructions I gave it to have them report in at a regular cadence. Running tracon in a split terminal is my new personal workflow. It gives me early indicators when things start going off the rails (ex. blocked on a prompt, idle, looping on a failing command, simultaneous edits to files other subagents are editing, drifting off the brief, etc.) and I can interrogate the subagent's workflow and by pressing n the main agent gets a note to make a call on how and if to correct it. Read-only and runs on your machine: it tails transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/ and checks each worktree with ps, lsof, and git -- only thing that leaves your machine is what the Haiku judge reads for classification (or optionally you can turn that off with --no-judge). I've found it super useful for the game I'm building and figured others in the community might also find it useful. If you just want to give it a spin without committing: uvx tracon --demo macOS and Linux, Python 3.12+, MIT. (Not affiliated with Anthropic.)

github.description: 用代码逐帧做视频：HTML / Canvas 动画 → MP4 / GIF / 透明层 · Deterministic HTML-to-MP4 renderer: seek to t, screenshot, encode. No framework, no build step, no GPU.

projects.summary: 一个把 HTML / Canvas 动画逐帧渲染成 MP4 的命令行工具。 不是录屏，也不是 AI 文生视频。做法是：把画面在 HTML 里写成 frame(t) 纯函数，用无头浏览器逐帧 seek 到指定时刻截图，再用 ffmpeg 编成 H.264。因为是逐帧推的，所以帧率是真的（60fps 不用插帧），每一帧都精确对齐，同样的输入永远得到同样的输出。 它解决的问题 现在想用代码做视频，主流选择是 Remotion（React）或 Motion Canvas（场景式）。两者都好，但要先把内容组织成它们的世界观。而很多真实场景是：手上已经有一屏 HTML（常常是 AI 刚生成的），只想把它变成 mp4。为一屏画面建一个 React 工程，代价过大。 这个工具刻意不做框架 —— 输入是一个能跑的 HTML 文件，输出是 mp4： bash bash assets/render.sh my-video.html --duration=6 --fps=60 几个不太常见的点 确定性：冻结 wall-clock rAF，由外部逐帧推进，同一份代码重跑逐帧一致。可版本管理、可做视觉回归 自带验收：qa.js 检查六维（确定性 / 最长连续静止 / 跳变 / 文字框景 / 字体回退 / 控制台报错）。为了让验收本身可信，仓库里放了一个塞满六类真实缺陷的对照样本，测试要求它必须被判失败 横竖屏自适应：--width=1080 --height=1920 就是竖屏，模板跟视口重排而不是拉伸。1920×1080 下与旧版逐像素一致（PSNR 逐帧回归，average:inf） 断点续渲：--resume，长片子跑到 80% 崩了不用从零开始。帧先写 .part 再改名，参数变了直接拒绝，编码前逐个核帧号 —— 实测续渲出来的 mp4 与一次渲完的 MD5 完全相同 MIT，纯本地运行，不调任何 API，不按次计费。

projects.summary: 你好，我是 Vexilo Code 的开发者，自荐一个我做的 Mac App（闭源、付费，详见下方价格说明）。 App Store： 测量过程（英文长文）： Claude Code 每一轮都会把已安装的每个 skill、agent 的名字和描述放进上下文，不管这一轮用不用得到。我在自己 Mac 上新开会话、还没打字就跑了一次 /context all：已经加载 39.6k token，其中 skill 9.9k（300 多条，大部分每条不到 20 token）、48 个 agent 3.3k。单看哪条都不重，加起来却每轮都要带着，手动很难挑出该删哪些。 Vexilo Code 做的事： 我的配置：只读扫描本机 ~/.claude，估算每个 skill 和 agent 每轮占多少 token，从重到轻排序 清理提示词：一键复制一段指令交给 Claude Code，让它带你逐条过最重的那些，你确认的才归档；Vexilo 自己从不改 ~/.claude 工具目录：295 个工具（31 个 agent、128 个命令、123 个 skill、13 条规则），中英双语说明，每条带可直接粘贴的提示词，⌘⇧K 在任何 App 里都能搜 端侧 AI：用 Apple Intelligence 在本机运行，不需要 API key；描述任务后只从关键词筛出的候选里挑一个工具，匹配度不够就直接说没有合适的 说明： token 数是估算（字符数 ÷ 4），用来比较轻重，和 /context 不一致时以 /context 为准；目前只统计 skill 和 agent，不统计 CLAUDE.md 和 rules 价格：免费下载，目录、搜索和指南永久免费；完整功能 7 天试用，之后 $19.99 一次性买断，无订阅。需要 macOS 14.6+ 中国区 App Store 暂未上架。另有中文网页版 （工具目录和中文工具书，¥39 买断），配置开销诊断只在 Mac App 里 独立开发，与 Anthropic 无关联 如果觉得适合周刊，谢谢收录。

projects.title: Show HN: Cosplay as a tech lead, using gVisor to sandbox agents
projects.author: SftwareRenderer
projects.summary: Hi everyone, This started as an exploration into harnesses and locally hostable LLMs (the kind that uses less power than a small electric heater), and I used it as an opportunity to retool. I've tried popular ones like Cline, Claude Code, and Pi, but wanted a different UX and integrated sandboxes. The solution that I've landed on is a responsive web interface where I can quickly drive progress. It feels like a microcosm of my day job: define and delegate tasks, organize using kanban, then review deliverables. And it also feels like the time I used to spend coding is now spent in code review with the agent, so I tried to optimize the UX to make review feel nicer. One of my (maybe a bit niche) benchmark use-cases is how pleasant it is to make progress on hobby software projects while also out on a hike. This meant specifying low bandwidth usage and offline mode. Now I can jot down an idea, start the task, and at some point down the trail: get a notification* that either clarification is needed, a decision needs to be made, or the code is ready for review. I've been having a good time with this. To build MIKE, I exclusively used locally hostable LLMs (from Google, Meta, Qwen, Poolside, and DeepSeek) hosted with llama.cpp on my machines at home (Strix Halo and a 5090) to "compile" the code. The experience has gotten substantially better ever since DeepSeek’s release in July. Side note: I have a soft spot for llama.cpp since it was one of the first that made it possible to run this new tech at home, and its maintainers accepted a tiny improvement I made to error reporting. Oh the joys of having a PR get approved. I plan on maintaining this, at least until similar features are supported by better tools. Until then, hope you find this useful! 5 minute demo: https://youtu.be/jexzLkZ50FU p.s. I didn't mention details about the sandbox earlier since most people seem to find this a bit boring. It was one of my critical requirements, and I opted to use an existing battle-tested sandbox. I'm not an expert on how the Linux kernel works, but seeing all the VM escape exploits recently is a bit scary, and I liked gVisor’s approach to the problem. I'm also using Git worktrees to provision the agent’s workspace, as well as a read-only repository mount to provide relevant context when the agent looks for it. *off by default

github.name: stevyhacker/LokalBot
github.description: Your personal context engine for macOS: on-device meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, and autocomplete that you and your AI agents can search. Free and open source (GPLv3).

projects.summary: LokalBot 是一款免费开源的 macOS 应用，用本地 AI 记住你在工作中说过和看过的内容。它不需要机器人进会，直接录制麦克风和会议软件的声音，在本机完成转写，生成要点、决策和待办；还提供工作回顾、语音输入和系统级自动补全。所有模型都在 Mac 上运行，不需要账号，没有遥测。 亮点 隐私优先： 录音、转写和纪要默认都在本机完成，没有账号系统，也没有遥测，GPLv3 开源。 支持中文： 默认的 Qwen3-ASR 1.7B 支持 30 种语言和 22 种中文方言（包括粤语、吴语、闽南语、四川话等），中英混说也能识别；中文会议会生成中文纪要，每条要点和待办都能跳回原话的时间戳。 不止会议： Quick Recall 一次搜索会议转写和屏幕文字；按住快捷键即可语音输入；在任何应用里打字时，都有灰色的自动补全建议，按 Tab 接受。 开箱即用： 内置 llama.cpp 和 MLX 运行时，模型自动下载，不用配置模型服务器或 API Key；也支持 Ollama、OpenAI 兼容服务器和 Apple Intelligence。 面向开发者： 自带只读的 lokalbot-cli 和 MCP 服务器，Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手可以查询你的会议记录（默认关闭，需要手动开启）。

projects.summary: 我是项目维护者，想自荐 FSB（Full Self Browsing）：一个 MIT 开源的 Chrome 扩展，加上一个本地 MCP 服务（npm 包，包名见 README）。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf 等 MCP 客户端接入后，可以在你日常使用的 Chrome 里完成打开页面、点击、输入、上传文件、读取内容等操作。 和同类工具相比，FSB 的几个不同点： 读取页面实时 DOM（元素、选择器、ARIA、表单），不依赖截图，每步操作后会检查页面状态。 推理交给 MCP 客户端自己的模型，使用 FSB 本身不需要 API Key。 密码和支付信息放在扩展的加密保管库里，由扩展负责填写，审计日志不记录敏感内容。 共 69 个 MCP 工具，包括元素监听触发、会话记录与回放。 当前扩展版本 0.9.92，MCP 服务版本 0.11.2。安装方式见 README，用 npx 运行 MCP 服务包的 install 命令即可写入对应客户端的配置。

Since it needs a top level ./well-known url, I either had to run a docker with redirects but that meant building the applications again and again which took time or adding a redirect and making UI application a server redirecting the URLs. Instead, I built Connectio which allowed me to create a config and save that as JSON in my machine. connect both servers and having route config similar to what it will run in AWS LB to redirect the traffic, then seeing the errors I was not sure if something was hitting the server or not so also added the capability to see the details and what was happening, how claude / openai will request some resources, tools or other details and how the server was sending this, having issues etc. Would love to get some feedback on this and see what you guys think!

projects.title: Show HN: CoastMath: (Open Source) Personal Finance and Retirement Planner
projects.author: jfrbfbreudh
projects.summary: Self-hosting instructions in the README. Hosted version: https://coastmath.com/ iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809539979 This post is partially inspired by this thread: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50048344 ``` > Somewhere around 20M people (0.2%) see first-hand that large, complex projects that used to take them weeks/months can now be completed by agents with a prompt. >> No, they can't, at least not any semblance of quality. The cases we're seeing where this does kinda work is in ports and translation where all the rules are already documented in the best specification language possible with a way for the LLM to verify itself: code. We saw this close to a year ago now with Cloudflare and NextJS ``` This post mostly outlines how I am personally building with agents, as I am almost entirely hands-off. Desired feature-set determined by having agents research existing products and feedback / feature requests on FIRE subreddits. Features built using Opus 5.5 (xhigh) / Fable 5.1 (med/high) as orchestrator and Opus-5-5 low/medium as worker subagents. Quality is attempted by running Opus-5-5 agents in a perpetual audit + fixer loop on the calculation / compliance engine until no medium+ severity can be found. The origin of each rule / logic must be backed up and documented in the codebase with a source. Sonnet subagents run UX / QA audit on iOS simulators within the Claude Code desktop app, and Opus agents resolve all medium+ sev issues; also run on a perpetual loop. I have not manually tested or used the app(s) for more than 30 minutes. For UX quality, agents' screenshots + associated context are fed to a combination of GPT / Gemini / Claude agents until consensus is achieved on quality (7/10+). Early feedback from beta testers report extremely close results to Boldin / Projection Lab. There is also a feature to import your data from Boldin and Projection Lab into CoastMath if you wish to compare the results yourself. There is also a SimpleFIN integration, if you wish to pull in your own transaction data and see how your financial future changes based on your monthly spending habits (e.g. when I will get to retire if I spend like I did in June vs. July?). I'm sure there are other features I don't yet know about. Again, I've barely used the app. Anyway, feel free to use / roast / steal. I don't think that any moat can exist in this class of products in the future (where the rules are laws that are visible to everyone) and I don't expect to turn a profit. Estimated cost: maybe $2000 if done over the API? I did most of this using the $200 Max subscription.

projects.summary: 我想做一个能陪大家写代码、也能在休息时进去逛逛的小世界，于是有了 Vibe 村：一款面向 Vibe Coding 爱好者的像素风村庄经营游戏。 第一次打开需要加载游戏素材，可能有些慢。 你从一片林地和一间木材厂开始，慢慢搭起生产线、建造住宅、种菜、布置小院，把森林里的小村庄经营起来。 🎮 可以玩些什么？ 🪵 经营木材厂 招募伐木工和种植工，安排采伐、补种和运输，再把原木一步步加工成木板与成品。升级设备、扩展林区，观察哪里缺料、哪里积压，把整条生产线运转起来。 🚚 接订单、做生意 根据客户需求备货、装车、配送，完成订单领取货款，再把收入投入下一轮建设。随着发展，还能解锁更多设备和经营内容。 👷 招募经理，逐步实现自动化 收集和培养不同经理，提高机器效率，解锁运输和接单等自动化能力，看着伙伴们在村里忙碌。 🏡 盖房子，建设自己的村庄 从第一栋住宅开始，收集木材、钉子、油漆和砖块，完成施工与升级，逐渐提高村庄繁荣度。 🥕 种菜、手作、逛小院 经营之外，也可以照料田园、参与小游戏、制作手作品、收集装饰，按自己的节奏安排村庄生活。 💎 把编程日常带进游戏 连接 Vibestead CLI 后，可以同步 AI 编程用量，回到游戏领取钻石，用于村庄建设和装饰。支持接入 Codex、Claude Code 等工具；上传的是每日用量汇总，不上传代码或聊天正文。 游戏内置了全球排行榜，可以跟全球玩家对比Token消耗量，也可以创建一个群组，跟自己的几个朋友一起做一个小榜单互相比比谁消耗的Token更多。 ✨ 我最想分享的几个亮点 写代码与养村庄连在一起：编程用量可以兑换游戏奖励，给每天的 coding 多一点看得见的仪式感。 经营过程看得见：工人采伐、车辆运输、机器加工，资源沿着生产线流转，小村庄会随着投入逐渐成长。 经营与田园生活都能玩：想研究效率就调整产线，想放松就种菜、盖房、布置小院。 打开浏览器就能玩：支持中文和英文，适合在写代码的间隙回来看看。 游戏还在持续打磨中，欢迎喜欢像素风、放置经营和 Vibe Coding 的朋友来试试。也很想听听大家的建议：哪里好玩、哪里卡住、还想在村里做些什么，都欢迎告诉我。
