projects.summary: ![Imgur]( https://i.imgur.com/GmbZb9J.png) ![Imgur]( https://i.imgur.com/KfxENID.png) # Transel 跨平台划词翻译工具。选中文字后按下热键，译文显示在鼠标附近的浮窗中。 支持 macOS 、Windows 、Linux 。可同时对照多个翻译接口，并提供截图 OCR 、静默替换、历史与收藏。日常以系统托盘常驻。 ## 介绍 Transel 面向阅读与写作时的即时翻译：在浏览器、编辑器或其它应用中划词，用全局热键唤出结果，而不必切换到翻译网站。 - 划词翻译：读取当前选区（文本、图片或文本文件） - 多通道对照：多家接口并行出结果 - 截图识别：框选屏幕区域后 OCR ，可选翻译或只复制文字 - 静默替换：将译文写回选区或当前输入框 - 密钥保存在系统钥匙串，配置文件不保存明文 默认目标语言为简体中文，可在设置中修改。新安装默认仅启用系统翻译（ macOS 为 Apple 翻译，其它平台为 Google 免费）；其它接口在设置中点「添加」后再配置。 ## 功能 | | | |---|---| | 划词翻译 | 默认 `Alt+D`（ macOS 为 Option+D ），浮窗显示原文与译文 | | 输入翻译 | 弹出输入框，回车翻译 | | 截图 OCR | RapidOCR ，以及火山 / 腾讯 / 百度 / 有道 / Google 云识别；腾讯图片翻译 | | 原图翻译 | 在截图上标出识别区域并翻译 | | 静默替换 | 译文写回选区或输入框全文；指针旁可停止当前任务 | | 翻译接口 | 机器翻译（ Apple 系统翻译、DeepL 、Google 、微软、Amazon 、百度、有道、阿里、火山、彩云、小牛 Flash / Pro 等）与 LLM 通道（ OpenAI / Azure / Claude / Gemini / 智谱 / DeepSeek / 通义 / 豆包 / Kimi / Ollama 等） | | 词典 | 英语单词：音标、词性、例句 | | 朗读 | 系统 TTS ，以及火山 / 腾讯 / Google / Microsoft 云语音 | | 历史 / 收藏 | 应用内搜索 | | 托盘 | 设置、历史、输入翻译、截图 OCR 、固定浮窗、退出 | ### 默认快捷键 Windows / Linux 上 `Cmd` 对应 **Ctrl**。可在设置中修改；将按键留空即取消注册。 | 功能 | 快捷键 | |---|---| | 翻译选区 | Alt+D | | 截图翻译 | Alt+F | | 截图 OCR （不翻译） | Shift+Alt+S | | 静默 OCR （只写入剪贴板） | Alt+C | | 输入翻译 | Cmd+Shift+I | | 朗读选区 | Cmd+Shift+R | | 历史 | Cmd+Shift+H | | 设置 | Cmd+, | | 固定 / 取消固定浮窗 | Cmd+Shift+P | | 原图翻译 | Alt+Shift+O | | 收藏夹 | Cmd+Shift+F | | 静默划词替换 | Alt+S | | 静默输入框替换 | Alt+A | 关闭当前窗口：`Esc` 或 `Cmd+W`。macOS 退出应用：`Cmd+Q`。 ## 安装 从 [Releases]( https://github.com/pannanxu/transel/releases) 下载对应平台的安装包。 ### macOS 1. 下载 `Transel- -aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg`（ Apple 芯片）或 `Transel- -x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg`（ Intel ）。 2. 打开磁盘映像，将 Transel 拖入「应用程序」。之后可用聚焦（ Spotlight ）或启动台搜索「 Transel 」。 3. 打开 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能**，启用 Transel 。若从终端启动，请授权「终端」或 iTerm ，然后完全退出并重新打开。未授权时无法读取选区。 若提示「已损坏，无法打开」或无法打开未验证的开发者应用：这是 Gatekeeper 拦截未公证的下载包，不是文件真的坏了。在终端执行： ```bash xattr -cr /Applications/Transel.app ``` 然后再次打开。从浏览器下载的 DMG 也会带隔离属性，可先对磁盘映像执行 `xattr -cr ~/Downloads/Transel-*.dmg` 再打开。 ### Windows 安装 `Transel- -x86_64.msi`，或解压 zip 后运行 `transel.exe`。 以管理员身份运行的窗口，需以相同权限运行 Transel ，否则可能无法读取选区。 ### Linux Debian / Ubuntu： ```bash sudo dpkg -i transel_ _amd64.deb ``` 或使用 AppImage： ```bash chmod +x Transel- -x86_64.AppImage ./Transel- -x86_64.AppImage ``` 建议： - 安装托盘支持（ GNOME 需 AppIndicator 扩展） - Wayland 下全局热键通常仅对 XWayland 窗口有效；划词依赖 `wl-clipboard`，交互截图依赖 `grim` 与 `slurp` - 需要稳定热键时，优先使用 X11 会话 ### 配置翻译接口 启动后通过托盘打开「设置」，启用所需接口并填写 API Key 。OpenAI 兼容通道（智谱、硅基流动、Groq 、Ollama 等）已预置地址与默认模型。密钥写入系统钥匙串（ macOS Keychain 、Windows 凭据管理器、Linux Secret Service ）。云 OCR / TTS 也可使用环境变量，例如 `TENCENT_SECRET_ID`、`VOLCANO_ACCESS_KEY`、`GOOGLE_OCR_API_KEY`、`VOLCANO_TTS_TOKEN`。 配置文件位置： | 平台 | 路径 | |---|---| | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/dev.transel/config.json` | | Windows | `%APPDATA%\dev.transel\config.json` | | Linux | `~/.config/dev.transel/config.json` | 命令行工具 `transel-cli`： ```text transel-cli config show transel-cli config set target zh-CN transel-cli history search transel-cli backend list ``` 临时覆盖 OpenAI 兼容接口（明文，仅建议调试使用）： ```bash export TRANSLATE_API_BASE=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 export TRANSLATE_API_KEY=sk-xxx export TRANSLATE_MODEL=deepseek-chat ``` ### 从源码构建 需要 Rust 1.88 或更高版本。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/pannanxu/transel cd transel cargo run --release ``` **macOS**：安装 Xcode Command Line Tools （`xcode-select --install`）。 **Windows**：安装 Visual Studio Build Tools ，并勾选「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」。 **Linux**（ Debian / Ubuntu ）： ```bash sudo apt install build-essential pkg-config cmake clang \ libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers \ libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libxcb-randr0-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev libxcb-shape0-dev \ libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev libssl-dev libzstd-dev \ libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev libxdo-dev libxi-dev libxtst-dev \ espeak-ng wl-clipboard grim slurp maim gnome-screenshot ``` 在本机生成安装包： ```bash # macOS / Linux bash packaging/package.sh --build # Windows （ PowerShell 7+） pwsh packaging/package.ps1 -Build ``` 产物位于 `dist/`。推送 `v*` 标签时，CI 会构建 macOS （ arm64 / x86_64 ）、Windows x86_64 与 Linux x86_64 并发布到 Releases 。 ## 许可 本项目采用 [MIT]( https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) 许可证。

projects.title: DevFeed
projects.summary: DevFeed turns your new tab into a home for developer news. Combine daily.dev recommendations, RSS feeds, and your favorite tech blogs in one clean reading experience. Enjoy a built-in reader, keyboard shortcuts, unread tracking, favourites, customizable themes, and weather. Switch between a three-column reader and a full-width grid. Free, open source, and privacy-first: your settings and reading history stay in your browser. No custom backend or tracking analytics.

projects.title: Docktopus
projects.summary: Docktopus brings window previews, clipboard history, and widgets to your Mac’s dock. Add a Dynamic Island (no notch needed), track your day with Time Spent, search past screen captures with Remembrance, and control each app’s volume with the audio mixer. Includes dev server tools, a color picker, Coffee, and more, with Liquid Glass, CDE, and Windows 95 themes. Activity history and text recognition stay on your Mac.

projects.title: cornercase
projects.summary: A fast terminal multiplexer for coding agents. Turn GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Plane or Shortcut issues into running Claude Code, Codex or Gemini agents in a click. Each agent gets its own git worktree and tab. See which agent needs you, review the diff as it's written, and close the window: they keep running Away from your desk? Continue from your phone or on Telegram. Everything works with clicks. Really fast: 34 ms launch, 53 MB RAM. Free and open source. Linux and macOS.

projects.title: CopyTap - [CMD] [C] like never before.
projects.summary: CopyTap gives your Mac three clipboard slots using the copy and paste shortcuts you already know. Undo your last 'copy' if you accidentally copied over something important. It's not just another 'clipboard'. No long history. No need to open a separate UI. Windows version is also available - I'm not a monster. Lifetime purchase, No subscriptions! Currently on launch offer! Support me so I can feed my dog and buy some fuel to drive to the pet store.

projects.title: ClipBook 2
projects.summary: ClipBook 2 is a keyboard-first clipboard manager for Mac, rebuilt from scratch in Swift. Copy several things, then paste them in the same order without ever opening the history window. Native, fast, private: everything stays on your Mac.

projects.title: Atticus
projects.summary: Hold a shortcut, say what you want, let go. Atticus opens apps, shops for you, fills out forms and answers questions about what's on your screen. It asks before it buys or sends anything. Simple asks run instantly with no AI, and the rest run on your own Claude plan. Free and open source.

projects.title: DraftKey
projects.summary: DraftKey is a native Mac app that brings private, on-device AI autocomplete and instruction-based rewriting into most Mac apps: tap ⌘+⌥, review the change, then insert it. The model runs locally and works offline after setup, so your text is never sent to a cloud AI. It also includes ⌘⌥V clipboard history saved only on your Mac and optional mechanical keyboard sounds (requires Apple Silicon, macOS 14+, 8 GB RAM).

projects.title: MyPhotoCraft
projects.summary: MyPhotoCraft is an independent, unofficial resource hub for the open-source PhotoCraft editor. It brings official GitHub downloads, platform-specific installation steps, a searchable Windows/Linux and macOS shortcut guide, and a practical PhotoCraft vs. Photoshop comparison into one place. Every download points directly to the official release—we do not mirror or repackage installers.

projects.title: GoodsTracker
projects.summary: GoodsTracker is the all-in-one inbound logistics platform for warehouse teams. Replace clipboards and Excel sheets with real-time audio/visual alerts, Dock-to-Stock SLA tracking, automated damage claim PDFs, and an internal PO lookup portal.

projects.title: Fubble VPN
projects.summary: Fubble VPN is a freemium VPN from LUNEXLAB OÜ with a free tier that actually works — not a teaser that dies on day one. Key features: • One-tap connect and server picker • Bring-your-own config (QR, clipboard, or manual) • Flexible sign-in • Free tier for everyday privacy on public Wi‑Fi • Premium for more locations and capacity ($6/mo or $30/6 mo) • iOS, Android, and Windows Built for people who want a clear Free → Premium path without dark patterns.

projects.title: Whipback
projects.summary: Mac menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. Ignore your agent and a whip cracks across your screen. Slap an idle agent and it types “Continue.” First 100 free.

projects.title: YT1S.video — YouTube Video Downloader
projects.summary: YT1S.video is an online YouTube downloader and creator toolkit designed to make everyday video tasks easier. It offers video and audio download options, thumbnail retrieval, and useful creator tools for tags, metadata, transcripts, subtitles, and content research. With a browser-based workflow, YT1S.video brings multiple YouTube-related utilities together in one convenient place, without requiring a traditional desktop application.

projects.title: Festival Lights · Holiday lights for Mac
projects.summary: A string of glowing lights under your Mac’s menu bar. Pumpkins, ghosts and bats for Halloween, twinkle lights for Christmas, lanterns for Lunar New Year, even fruit. Click-through, near-zero CPU, every display. Free.

projects.title: Deskthaw
projects.summary: A free Mac menu bar app in public beta. It waits while your camera or mic is on, a meeting app is in front, or something is fullscreen, then offers one move for your neck, shoulders or lower back, done sitting, a minute or less.

projects.title: Wisp
projects.summary: Wisp turns your MacBook notch (or the top, left or right edge of any screen) into a live Dynamic Island. Now Playing for Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube, each glowing in its own color, with the actual YouTube video inside the island. Telegram messages drop in as Liquid Glass bubbles. Official prayer times with reminders, timer, clipboard history, file shelf, volume/brightness HUD. Follows your external monitor. Mac + Windows. One-time purchase, no account.

projects.title: Desk Goblin
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that reminds you to stand up, stretch and move. Ignore it and a tiny goblin comes looking for you. $4.99 launch price, paid once.

projects.title: Clip'M
projects.summary: Clip’M is a free, open-source clipboard manager for Apple silicon Macs. Open history with ⌥⌘V, search text or filter images, preview clips, organize snippets, and transform text before pasting. Built on ClipMenu. Requires macOS 14+.

projects.title: Tasklo
projects.summary: Tasklo is a fast, clean interface for your Apple Reminders on iPhone and Mac. Type a natural sentence and it detects date, time and list on-device. Includes a weekly view with drag & drop, subtasks, repeats, widgets, Siri & Shortcuts and a morning summary. No account, no server, no ads, no tracking: your data stays with Apple. One-time €2.99, no subscription.

projects.title: Show HN: I think Apple should have built this a long time ago
projects.author: zacattackjuice
projects.summary: Built this little tool a while ago and shared it with a few friends. The feedback I got was great that I decided to release it publicly. It's not just another 'clipboard'... Honestly, would love you guys to try it out! This is my first public release of a product with a price tag! I have 0 expectations for it... but I genuinely love using it myself.

projects.title: [开源自荐] TokenFlow：统计 AI 编程用量，生成自动更新的 README／博客卡片
projects.author: caopulan

github.name: Renaissance-Mind/TokenFlow
github.description: Track Token Flow. Record AI usage at the source, then turn token flow into cost, rhythm, and role insight.

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 TokenFlow 的作者，想自荐一个面向 AI 编程用户的用量统计与展示工具。 同时使用 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等工具，又在几台电脑之间切换，用量记录往往很分散。TokenFlow 在本机读取 Agent 日志，按工具、模型和时间汇总 token 与估算费用，再把多设备统计放到同一个看板中。 其中一个核心功能是生成自动更新的 AI 用量卡片。复制 Markdown 图片或 HTML 嵌入代码，就可以把用量总览、趋势或热力图放进 GitHub README、个人主页或博客。新增用量同步后，同一个卡片链接会呈现更新后的数据，省去手动截图和替换图片的过程，适合展示个人 AI 编程活动和使用习惯。 TokenFlow 提供桌面端、CLI 和网页看板。桌面端可在菜单栏／系统托盘查看当天用量，未登录也能查看本地统计；需要多设备汇总时可以开启同步。提示词、回复正文、会话 ID 和源文件路径保留在本地，上传的是使用量元数据。未知价格的模型仍统计 token，并标记未计价。费用按模型定价估算，可用于观察使用趋势。

projects.title: Vemoir
projects.summary: Vemoir records meetings from your Mac's menu bar. No bot joins the call. It transcribes on-device, groups meetings into projects that share context, and turns each call into minutes, decisions, action items and follow-ups from export-ready templates. Ask Vemoir answers questions and links back to the transcript. Nothing is uploaded by default. Launch price: $22.99 one-time for the first 200 buyers on the Mac App Store. No subscription.

projects.title: S3 Explorer
projects.summary: The S3 browser desktop client for S3-compatible storage. Browse, edit and navigate millions of objects across all your buckets. Windows, macOS, Linux.

projects.title: Walk Mate
projects.summary: Walk Mate now works with iPhone Duo and Siri AI, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and Apple Intelligence (App Intents). Save a walk once - then start a new loop or reopen a favorite without hunting through the app. Ask Siri • "Generate a route in Walk Mate" or "Make me a walk in Walk Mat ' creates fresh walking loops near you. In Shortcuts you can also set a distance first. • "List my walks in Walk Mate" - Siri names your saved favorites and shows tappable cards.

projects.title: MemStats
projects.summary: Free, open-source menu bar app for macOS that splits RAM by user account, groups helper processes into their apps, and shows memory pressure, swap, and a short history. Built for shared Macs, light enough for any Mac. No network, no tracking

projects.title: NotchMind
projects.summary: NotchMind turns your Mac notch into a home for everyday tools. New since launch: live Claude Code and Codex activity, a shake-to-open file Basket, customizable Home pages, searchable clipboard history, global shortcuts, call controls and a floating music player. Works on notchless displays too. Native macOS app for Apple silicon, macOS 15+. Pay once: $7.99 for 1 Mac, $12.99 for 2, or $19.99 for 5. All 1.x updates included. No subscription.

projects.title: 请旨：给AI用的密钥管家
projects.author: sudohg

github.name: sudoHG/AskKey
github.description: Ask Key: the Mac key manager for AI agents. API keys stay encrypted on your Mac; Claude Code, Codex and Cursor find them over MCP, you approve each use, and the value goes only to the program, never to the AI. | 请旨：给 AI 用的 Mac 密钥管家。AI 自己找得到密钥，普通密钥直接放行，敏感密钥由你审批，密钥只交给目标程序，AI 看不到明文。

projects.summary: 给 AI 用的 Mac 密钥管家。 密钥加密存在你的 Mac 上，AI 只能通过请旨来用： 密钥在哪： AI 自己就找得到，不用再频繁给它指路。 权限你定： 普通密钥直接放行，敏感密钥由你审批，不想让 AI 碰的可以隐藏。 安全加固： 密钥只会交给目标程序，AI 看不到明文。

projects.title: SweepKit
projects.summary: SweepKit is a free, native Mac menu bar app that helps you clean up messy Downloads and Desktop folders. It previews files and lets you sort or trash them in seconds using quick number keys.

projects.title: Show HN: Impetus – I turned my MPE keyboard into a DAW control surface
projects.author: gregsmith4000
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm a sound editor and composer. I had an MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression) keyboard sitting on the desk in front of me and not enough space for a DAW control surface. The MPE keys to me were about the same size as a mixing board fader, and operated on the same y-axis gesture, so I decided to see if I could make the translation. About a year later, I have an 8-channel control surface running on HUI or Mackie Control with all major functions, including a system wide keyboard shortcut and macro engine. The crucial part was getting the keys to respond like a real fader, starting in the right position when touched and not introducing jumps or jitters into the mix. The result is really smooth control though, and it works better than I originally imagined it would. It's macOS only for now, and works with ROLI Seaboard models and KMI K-board Pro. It should also work with Haken Continuum, but is not tested. DAWs tested and confirmed: Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Ableton Live and Digital Performer, plus video editors using the same protocols, such as DaVinci Resolve's Fairlight page. I would love any feedback, especially if you own any of these devices and can try it out. There's a free trial. Thanks!

projects.title: 【开源自荐】StockBar：把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具
projects.author: Garretqaq

github.name: Garretqaq/stock-bar
github.description: 把行情放在菜单栏，随时掌握市场动态。macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 悬浮行情条的 A 股盯盘小工具：实时价格、涨跌幅、分时图抬眼就能看，不占 Dock。Tauri 2 + 原生 TypeScript

projects.summary: 项目：StockBar | 平台：macOS / Windows / Linux | 许可：MIT | 最新版本：v0.0.6 它是什么 一个把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具，Tauri 2 + Rust + 原生 TypeScript。 盘中想瞄一眼自选，又不想一直开着完整的行情软件 —— 那类软件占地方、还显眼。StockBar 把常看的几只留在菜单栏，点一下展开指数、自选和分时图，看完就收起。macOS 上不占 Dock；Windows 托盘放不下文字，就另外给一条可拖动的悬浮行情条。 界面是真的轻：不用 UI 框架、不用图表库，列表是原生 DOM 拼的，分时图是 canvas 一笔一笔画的。数据走东方财富的公开接口，失败时自动切到腾讯，所以不用注册、不用 API Key。 功能详解 📌 抬眼就能看见 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两张一行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 📊 分时图与成交额 点指数卡片或自选行就展开当天的分时，再点一次收起。内置上证、深证成指、创业板指；大盘指数的分时多取一天，用来算「与上一日同期」的成交额对比，个股则是单日。 🗂️ 自选与分组 搜索支持代码、名称和拼音；置顶、拖动排序、自定义分组都在。分组多了筛选条会横向滑动，末尾的 ☰ 把全部分组摊成一片标签，带每组的自选数量，点一下就切过去。加入菜单栏、移入分组、删除都支持批量。 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 自带零依赖的 MCP 服务（11 个工具），支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端可以按你的话操作： 「新建一个『持仓』分组，把宁德时代加进去并置顶。」 「把苹果和英伟达移到『观察』分组。」 命令通过本机 127.0.0.1 上的随机端口交给应用执行，走的是和手点界面完全相同的校验与同步规则，界面会立刻跟着变。这一步默认关闭，需要时到设置里拨开。 ⚙️ 按自己的习惯来 跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色主题，红涨绿跌 / 绿涨红跌，3 / 5 / 10 / 30 秒刷新，报价与分时可固定用东方财富或腾讯。安装后能在「关于」页检查更新、一键升级。 两个平台各长什么样 macOS 是自绘窗口控件的菜单栏小窗（360×560），Windows 走平台布局：托盘 + 桌面悬浮行情条，托盘图标随任务栏深浅自动着色。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Tauri 2、Rust | | 界面 | 原生 TypeScript、Vite、canvas（无 UI 框架、无图表库） | | 数据 | 东方财富公开接口，失败时自动切腾讯 | | MCP | 零依赖 stdio JSON-RPC 服务 + Rust 侧本地 HTTP 桥 | | 测试 | Vitest（前端纯逻辑 + MCP 脚本，含一条起进程的端到端用例） | 快速开始 macOS 与 Windows 都有现成安装包（Linux 暂无官方预编译包，可从源码运行）： 下载： 从源码跑，需要 Node.js 22+、pnpm、Rust stable 和对应平台的 Tauri 2 开发依赖： bash git clone cd stock-bar pnpm install pnpm app:dev 只想看界面的话 pnpm dev 即可，浏览器里 Tauri 调用会降级为空操作。 需要说清楚的几件事 macOS 安装包暂未签名与公证，首次打开请右键「打开」，或 xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/StockBar.app。 交易状态按市场时区和报价里的最后成交时间推断，没有节假日日历，开盘前无法提前判定当天是否休市。 行情来自公开接口，刷新频率不代表交易所级实时性；覆盖范围以数据源返回为准。 项目还很年轻（v0.0.6），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。觉得有用的话，点一颗 Star 就是最大的鼓励 ⭐️

projects.title: Fuzio
projects.summary: Fuzio is a Chromium-based browser component for Java and Kotlin desktop apps, adapted for China’s Linux-based operating systems and local CPUs, including LoongArch, Kunpeng, Phytium, and Hygon. It lets you embed web applications into desktop software, provides control over browser networking and SSL/TLS certificate handling, and comes with built-in communication with Google services removed.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】1Capture：面向高频反馈者的 Mac 原生精美截图录屏工具
projects.author: macing
projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个我们开发的面向高频反馈者的 Mac 原生精美截图录屏工具 1Capture。

projects.title: Klip
projects.summary: Your Mac clipboard forgets everything the moment you copy something else. Klip doesn't. It keeps a searchable local history of text, images, links, and files in your menu bar. Fully offline. Zero creepy permissions. Free on the Mac App Store.

projects.title: PasteZen
projects.summary: PasteZen is a Mac menu bar app that cleans text the moment you copy it: strips formatting, removes tracking params from links (utm, fbclid, gclid), rejoins broken PDF lines, and masks API keys, emails & card numbers before you paste. It has zero network permission — no account, no analytics, clipboard never written to disk. Core features free forever; Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

projects.title: TaskTicklet
projects.summary: TaskTicklet is a native macOS menu bar app that tracks your work and coding agents together. See Claude Code and Codex sessions, token usage, estimated costs, and task contributions. Automatically detect and log calls, meetings, and interruptions, keeping them separate from focused task time. Understand where time and effort go and compare activity across models. Agent logs are read locally, it never leaves your machine. TaskTicklet never starts, stops, or controls your agents.

projects.title: PaneScale
projects.summary: PaneScale is a desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and seven more coding agents side by side in one resizable grid. You see at a glance which agent is working, which one is done and which one is waiting for you. Every agent can get its own Git worktree, one prompt can go to every pane, and Claude Code, Codex and Kimi sessions switch to a chat view where approvals are buttons. Plan limits and reset times stay in view. Runs locally, no account. Free in early access.

projects.title: Back To Top
projects.summary: Skip the scroll back up. Back To Top adds a floating button and a toolbar shortcut to Safari on Mac. Choose from 10 styles, drag the button into place, and control when it appears. Paid app on the Mac App Store.

projects.title: Meowslim
projects.summary: Meowslim is a Quran and prayer companion with no ads. Read the full 30-juz Quran with tafsir and verse-by-verse murottal, get prayer times and adhan alarms for your location, find the qibla, and count dhikr on a digital tasbih. A worship tracker with daily streaks and XP helps you keep a routine, and Musa the cat keeps you company. Free on Android, with desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux. In English and Indonesian.

projects.title: Show HN: Mac equivalent of Nvidia ShadowPlay. Recording missed moments on Mac
projects.author: itzadetunji
projects.summary: (TLDR at the end) Hello everyone, I've been a gamer all my life, and ever since I got a Mac, I've noticed that I am unable to save recordings of gaming sessions the way NVIDIA ShadowPlay or other related software does on PC, but now it's possible. The idea of how it works came from my PS4, which let me save clips, and I didn't know how it worked. I later looked into it and figured it out using a rolling buffer so you don't store everything, but just enough to capture the moment The first version of this was built on iOS, and it's live on the App Store for you to check out. I am sure those who play Fortnite or Call of Duty: Mobile will want to check this out and share their clips with their friends. The macOS version was built back in April but I've slept on it for a while and decided to look into it and make it much faster, better and with much more customizability. I'd really love your feedback, and I do appreciate contributions to the repo so we can make it better TLDR: When gaming on Mac, you can now save moments you missed using a shortcut ;)

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Codex Deck，轻松管理 Codex 多账号与额度
projects.author: Sanjeever
projects.summary: 我做了一个开源桌面工具 Codex Deck，把 Codex CLI 多账号、额度和历史会话放在一个窗口里。一眼查看各账号剩余额度和恢复时间，快速切换账号，也能搜索、阅读本地历史会话。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，提供后台额度刷新、低额度提醒与 WebDAV 备份，让日常使用 Codex 更省心。

projects.title: [开源自荐] Grove：给多仓库项目建 git worktree 工作区，并行跑多个 Claude Code 会话
projects.author: efim0v

github.name: efim0v/grove
github.description: Run parallel Claude Code sessions on a multi-repo project. Feature workspaces built from git worktrees, session management, and moving a session between Claude accounts. macOS menu-bar app and CLI for AI coding agents.

projects.summary: Grove 是一个 macOS 菜单栏应用加命令行工具，面向拆分在多个 Git 仓库里的项目（比如客户端、服务端、配置各在一个仓库）。它为每个功能建一个“工作区”：一个目录里放着你选的各个仓库的 git worktree，都在同一个分支上。Claude Code 从这个目录启动，看到的是这几个仓库的同一个分支；同时开好几个会话，也不会互相把分支切走。它还能集中查看各项目、各账号的 Claude Code 会话，并把会话转到另一个 Claude 账号继续。 亮点 一个分支贯穿多个仓库：建工作区时，Grove 在你选的每个仓库里执行 git worktree add，分支名按模板生成（默认 feat/{name}），你指定的共享文件（比如 CLAUDE.md）会链接或复制进新工作区，各仓库还可以运行自己的创建后钩子。每个仓库可以从各自的基础分支开始；新工作区也能基于另一个工作区的分支来建，Grove 直接从 git 推导出它们之间的关系。 和 Claude Code 自带的 --worktree 不同：claude --worktree 只在当前这一个仓库里建 worktree，Grove 把多个仓库的 worktree 放在同一个目录、同一个分支上。如果产品只有一个仓库，Claude Code 自带的功能可能就够用了。 会话集中查看，还能换账号：列出各个项目、各个 Claude 账号下的 Claude Code 会话。一个账号的限额用完时，可以把会话交给另一个账号：Resume as… 用另一个账号直接接着跑，什么都不用复制；Migrate to… 把会话记录、记忆、文件历史和任务完整复制过去；Share 把会话放进共享存储，所有关联的账号都能看到。 另外还有提交图（分支、远程、标签）和代码行数统计；命令行工具 grove 提供 scan、workspaces、sessions、create、graph、doctor 命令，都能输出 JSON。 可以当学习材料：怎样为多个仓库批量创建 git worktree，并确认它们都切到了同一个分支；菜单栏为什么用 NSStatusItem + NSPanel，而不用 SwiftUI 的 MenuBarExtra，也不用 NSPopover（GroveMenuBarApp.swift 的注释里写了原因）。 纯 Swift 编写（SwiftUI + AppKit），没有第三方依赖，有九百多个测试；免费，GPL-3.0 开源；仓库附有简体中文 README。

projects.title: [开源推荐] 可任意缩放的 Mac 浮动系统监视器
projects.author: Nongfsq

github.name: Nongfsq/ftop
github.description: A small, quiet system monitor for Apple Silicon Macs: one floating glass panel that works at any size.

projects.summary: 给 Apple Silicon Mac 做的原生系统监视器。整个界面是一块浮在桌面上的面板，拖动边缘时自动换成合适的布局并贴合窗口，从菜单栏大小的小条到完整面板都不会裁切或留空。每个核心单独一根柱子并显示当前频率，另有 GPU、内存压力、网络、功耗、温度和最忙的应用。适合跑本地模型、编译时随手看一眼机器状态。 亮点 1. 任意尺寸都有对应布局：内容按优先级取舍，从不裁切，窗口自动贴合布局，不留空白。 2. 不用 sudo 读出每个核心和 GPU 的实时频率：性能核、能效核分组显示，柱高是占用，横线是频率。 3. 几乎不占资源：没有用 SwiftUI，面板由 Core Text 绘制、动画只用 Core Animation 图层，占用不到一个核心的 1%，被遮住时几乎为 0。 4. 诚实的读数：硬件读不到的数值显示为不可用而不是 0，温度标明来自哪一级传感器。 5. 免费开源（MIT），签名并经过苹果公证，可自动更新。

projects.title: Clipboard Manager - ClipBox
projects.summary: ClipBox brings your clipboard history together across Mac, iPhone and iPad. Save text, links, images and snippets; find them with advanced search; restore deleted clips for 30 days; and sync with iCloud. On Mac, queue clips and paste them in order.

projects.title: TailcatBox
projects.summary: Tailcat Box is a desktop app that links two computers directly. Share a short code to chat, call, share screens, send big files, publish ports from your machine or LAN, or open a shell. No account, no public IP, no router setup. Windows, macOS, Linux.

projects.title: Paperwing
projects.summary: Paperwing is a free, open-source PDF app for Windows and macOS with Acrobat's layout and shortcuts. Edit, sign, convert, organize, compress and protect PDFs with 100+ tools. No account, no subscription, no upsells, and your files never leave your computer.

projects.title: Jarvis Live
projects.summary: Jarvis is a realtime voice AI you talk to like a person. It answers out loud in about a second, searches the web and shows live cards. When a task needs a computer, it says so and hands it to Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Hermes on your own machine, then reads you the result. Talk face to face with a live avatar. Self-host the open-source app (MIT), or link the free desktop app to Jarvis Cloud and use it from iPhone, Apple Watch, Android and the web.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MastraWork：把 Agent 运行组织成任务的开源桌面 AI 工作台
projects.author: movclantian

github.name: movclantian/mastra-desktop
github.description: Local-first multi-agent coding workbench built on Electron, React and the Mastra framework. 本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，基于 Mastra + Electron，把一次 Agent 运行组织成可暂停、可回溯、可交接的任务。

projects.summary: 项目：MastraWork | 平台：Windows / macOS / Linux | 许可：Apache-2.0 | 最新版本：v0.0.7 它是什么 一个本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，底层是 Mastra 框架 + Electron。 它想解决的事情很具体：现在多数 AI 工具给你一段回答，事情就停在那儿；代码改到一半让它继续，它常常重新把文件读一遍，从接不上的地方往下编。前面聊过的上下文，像是没发生过。 MastraWork 的做法是把一次 Agent 运行组织成一个任务。任务落在具体的工作区里，长在线程上，每一步都留下痕迹。它能暂停，能回头检查，也能交给团队里的其他成员接着看。断掉之后不是从头再来，而是接着往下走。 它面向软件工程和知识工作：Agent、团队、工作区、终端、浏览器、MCP、技能和资料库收在同一个应用里，围着同一个任务转。 功能详解 🧭 工程任务 读取代码、全局搜索、编辑与 AST 修改、运行命令、查看差异、调用 LSP 都在里面。关键是读、写、执行分开授权，每一步都有记录，不是开一个大权限就全放开。 🛡️ 受控执行 计划、构建、复查三种模式，切的是「Agent 现在能碰什么」。人工询问和批准留在流程里，高风险动作停下来等人确认，不靠模型自觉。 👥 Agent 团队 主 Agent 可以带一群专家成员，支持委派、交接、并行、分支、循环和审批工作流。复杂任务拆给合适的人，而不是一个 Agent 硬扛。 🧩 开放扩展 模型 Provider、MCP Server、技能与插件、浏览器、资料库、记忆和网页检索，按需接入，不绑定任何一家模型服务。今天用这家，明天想换，配置改一下就行。 🖥️ 桌面集成 Electron 主进程、原生浏览器视图、PTY 终端、系统通知、凭据保险库。API Key、OAuth token 和 Cookie 由桌面主进程的凭据保险库保管。 📚 记忆与资料库 记忆跨会话保留；资料库统一收文档、表格和网页；用量、费用和历史数据随时可查。 一个任务是怎么走完的 一个任务从开工到验收，Agent 手里的权限是变的，分三个阶段： 1. 计划 —— 先把事情想清楚，读代码、查资料、出方案。 2. 构建 —— 方案定了再动手，改代码、跑命令、推进任务，每一步都留下记录，随时可以停下来回头看。 3. 复查 —— 对照差异和工作记录验收，高风险的操作在这一步需要人批准。 读、编辑、执行和外部工具在三阶段各有一套策略，图的入口在应用内设置里，实际安全性以服务端权限检查和测试记录为准。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Electron 44、electron-vite、electron-builder | | 界面 | React 19、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 4、CodeMirror 6、xterm | | Agent 框架 | Mastra 1.77（core、memory、rag、mcp、observability） | | 数据与检索 | libsql、DuckDB、fastembed 本地向量 | | 代码与文档 | Shiki 高亮、Mermaid、KaTeX、PDF 与 Office 解析 | | 工具链 | Biome、Knip、pnpm workspace | 快速开始 三个平台都有现成安装包，也可以从源码跑（需要 Node.js >=22.19.0 <23、pnpm 12.11.2）： sh corepack enable corepack prepare pnpm@12.11.2 --activate pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev 首次启动后配一个可用的模型 Provider、选一个工作区目录即可。需要网页检索、浏览器、MCP 或技能时，再按实际服务分别配置凭据。默认本地数据目录是 ~/.mastrawork，Mastra 服务跑在本机 4111 端口。 下载： 关于「本地优先」 需要说清楚一点：「本地优先」说的是桌面宿主、默认工作区和本地数据边界优先留在本机，不表示所有推理都在本地完成。模型推理走哪个服务由使用者自己配置，模型服务会收到你发过去的提示词和选定的上下文。 项目还在很早期（v0.0.7），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。

projects.title: PasteSpace Clipboard Manager PRO 3.0
projects.summary: PasteSpace 3.0 is a big update to the private clipboard manager for Mac. Find a screenshot by any word in it, with text recognition in up to 30 languages. With Pro, search inside PDFs, Word and Excel files, scans included, and you can edit their text. New filters and sorting find anything in seconds, the Vault now hides passwords and card numbers even from search, and a redesigned window shows more of what you copy. Everything stays on your Mac: no account, no cloud. Free; Pro is $19.99 once.

projects.title: [开源自荐] Bulchimbeon：只在 AI 编程代理工作时阻止 Mac 休眠的菜单栏工具
projects.author: s3onghyun

github.name: s3onghyun/bulchimbeon
github.description: 🪖 불침번 — Your Mac's night-watch soldier. Keeps your Mac awake only while AI agents work. No hooks, no daemon, macOS 13+.

projects.summary: 一个 macOS 菜单栏工具：只在 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编程代理真正在干活时阻止 Mac 休眠，代理安静下来后自动"换岗"，让 Mac 恢复正常睡眠。适合让代理通宵跑任务、又不想忘记关 caffeinate 的开发者。 亮点 1. 只看"真正在工作"的代理：从外部观察代理进程（caffeinate 子进程和 CPU 占用），仅打开的空闲会话不算，不用改任何代理配置、不装 hook 2. 合盖也能保持唤醒：看门狗保证即使应用被强制退出，5 秒内也会恢复原来的休眠设置 3. 过热自动"战斗休息"：温度过高时暂停值守，降温后自动恢复；低电量时自动撤岗 4. 无守护进程、无 root 辅助程序：一个应用，macOS 13 起可用，支持中文界面；另有 Linux 版命令行守护程序（Go） 5. 像素风小兵在菜单栏下巡逻，MIT 开源

projects.title: CleanPause
projects.summary: CleanPause pauses keyboard input and trackpad gestures and darkens your Mac displays while you clean. No countdown: return with a corner hold, by typing done, or with a keyboard shortcut. Free for macOS 13+. Accessibility permission required.

projects.title: Qualitify, record, review WhatsApp calls
projects.summary: Qualitify records your team's WhatsApp calls from a desktop app, so the conversations nobody could review finally can be. A fair sampling policy picks which calls reach review, so coverage spreads across everyone. Score them against your own criteria and weighting, flag mistakes that fail a call outright, and pin notes to the second. Set daily call goals per agent, then attach coaching plans and compare before-and-after scores with sample sizes shown. Free 14-day trial, no card.

projects.title: Agent Radar

Lowlight is a small menu bar app that adds extra steps under the macOS minimum, plus the normal range above it. You choose how many extra steps you want. projects.title: Show HN: Merlin, Run Your Claude Code and Codex from Slack, Linear and GitHub
projects.author: dottchen
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built Merlin to let you use your own Claude Code and Codex subscription from Slack, Linear, and GitHub. There is a desktop app for macOS and Windows, and a CLI daemon for Linux. When someone mentions Merlin in a Slack thread or Linear issue comment, the task runs on that team member's machine, using their own Claude Code or Codex runtime, and progress and results come back to the original thread. Teammates can steer the agent mid-run. Merlin also has schedules, shared skills, and memory. I know you've probably heard about Claude Tag. Merlin is similar to that but also different. The model usage goes to the Claude Code or Codex subscription instead of API bill, and you can use Merlin across different surfaces to streamline workflow instead of just in Slack (Linear's agent session works particularly well with Merlin. You can just leverage Linear as your control panel for agentic work using Merlin). Merlin also runs on your local machines, which means that you can use your local context including MCPs, skills and local files instead of in a cloud sandbox. Merlin does not upload your working directory, and provider credentials stay on the device. The request and the context it needs pass through Merlin. Runtimes start private, and an owner can make one public so teammates, including non-engineers, can use it. But there're also some limits, and we'll probably deal with them in future updates: - An offline or sleeping machine can't take work. The same issue as OpenClaw. But if you have a mac mini or ec2 setup it should be fine. - Linux is CLI only. We may later add desktop for Linux. - While runtime delegation isn't a problem for now, we're still working on how to make the best use of each team member's local runtime and let them work together cohesively. We've been internally using Merlin for quite some time. It really helps when you're trying to add some AI juice to the conversation or just delegate things to your agents. I think it reduces the friction of having to do the copying & pasting and switch to another app to ask for AI's input when you're having a discussion in a collaborative environment like Slack or Linear. It's really the fastest way from intent to execution. Pricing: free for up to 5 active users and 1,000 requests/month. We think this should get small teams started and get real value from it. Team is $59/mo and Scale is $99/mo, with a 14-day Team trial and no credit card required. I'm here all day to answer questions, and I'd especially like to hear whether non-engineers on your team would actually use this.

projects.title: Show HN: BScaff - A CLI tool for project scaffolding and snippets
projects.author: akashnagcs
projects.summary: I built BScaff, a CLI tool for saving and reusing project structures, templates, files, and text snippets. It can serve as a URL bookmark tool as well. It started with project scaffolding, but I wanted something more general-purpose: a tool that could save almost any reusable starting point and bring it back whenever needed. For each language, I had a specific way of structuring projects that I have refined over years, but I could not find any tool which can quickly help to generate such scaffolding quickly. Copier and Cookiecutter exists but they depend on templates, and I didn't want to create templates for such tasks. One more use-case I had was when I used AI chatbots who suggest some project structure, and I want to quickly create that. So I wanted something offline which can quickly help me save and recreate file trees. Then I added snippets to it too, but I mostly use it for notes taking personally. Some things you can do with it: * Save Git repository templates locally and use them offline whenever you need to create a new project * Create reusable templates from existing directories * Save and recreate directory structures by copying ASCII file trees and the tool will read it from clipboard and recreate it (or save it for later) * Save collections of files and generate them again in another directory * Save text snippets and either copy them to the clipboard or generate files from them The idea is to avoid repeatedly recreating the same boilerplate, directory structures, configuration files, etc. And you can use it as a note-taking app as well with snippets. It has templates support as well with Jinja-based variable replacement. Template updates are supported, but project updates are not yet implemented, have planned it for future. It is written in TypeScript, runs on Node.js, and is available on npm. GitHub: https://github.com/akashnag/bscaff Install: npm install -g @akashnag/bscaff Feedback, feature suggestions ( I already have a big backlog though :P ), and contributions are welcome!

projects.title: Show HN: Helicon – Desktop App for Meta's Muse Code CLI (Linux, Windows, macOS)
projects.author: harjjotsinghh
projects.summary: Hi Hacker News, I'm Harjot. I've been using Meta's Muse Code CLI daily for a few weeks now. One thing that I found difficult to handle was managing or controlling multiple sessions across multiple projects, while using the terminal for the muse CLI. Initially, I used cmux to create workspaces/groups for my different projects to group them, and then created 4 split terminals in each of those projects, that ran muse code sessions in each of them. It worked, but it was ugly. I didn't like using that. It could be because I'm not really a terminal person and would much rather prefer a proper dedicated GUI or desktop/app interface, and I would prefer it any time over a terminal screen or CLI. So it might be personal preference but yeah. So, I started building a desktop app around it, mainly to scratch my own itch. Helicon is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus a VS Code extension that also works in Cursor and Devin. It doesn't replace the CLI. It runs `muse serve` and talks to it, and it reuses your existing `muse login`, so you don't have to get an API key and you don't pay an extra bill. You can use your existing Muse Code subscription plans. Some things that I use the most: 1. Resuming sessions that I started in the terminal. I don't start many sessions in the terminal now that Helicon exists, but initially I wanted to access all the sessions that were running in a terminal to be accessible from Helicon, when it was created initially. 2. Inline diffs that I can approve, similar to how Cursor works. 3. I can clearly see my 5-hour and weekly plan limits directly from the app itself and don't have to manually keep going to Meta's Muse Code billing page and manually keep refreshing the page to see my current usage/limits. I built it using Tauri 2 and React. It is MIT licensed. I built a lot of it with AI coding agents, especially Opus 5.5 (I really like using this model). It's at v0.21.9 now, and 9 people have contributed so far. Some issues: the Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so you'll see a SmartScreen warning. And the macOS build isn't notarized, so you need to click "Open Anyway" once. You can try it in the browser with mock data, no install needed: https://helicon.sh/try It's unofficial and not affiliated with Meta. If you use a coding CLI every day, what would you want from a GUI for it? And what would make you go back to the terminal?

projects.title: Show HN: Atticus – Hold-to-talk voice assistant for macOS that runs on Claude -p
projects.author: SaarthRanka

github.name: SaarthurR/atticus-mac
github.description: Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.

projects.summary: Hi HN! I'm Saarth. I'm in 9th grade, and I built Atticus. Atticus is a fast and cheap Mac assistant that can do tasks for you. You hold down Control-Option-Space, speak or type your task, be it complex or a simple browser search, and Atticus will get on it. The interesting part is that simple tasks, like opening apps, playing a Spotify playlist, or web queries, don't touch AI, and instead are processed locally and typically finish in under a second. For example, prompting Atticus to open apps takes around 0.08 seconds, sometimes even finishing before you finish your sentence, sort of like Jev. Any tasks that are more complicated will be sent to Claude via claude -p, meaning you never need an API key and Atticus will run on your existing Claude Pro or Max plan. By using this approach, costs are also cut down immensely, with, on average, tasks costing a fraction of a cent. To achieve Atticus' speed, it remembers shortcuts from each task it completes. When it does a task right for the first time, it saves its steps and replays them the next time without AI. For example, a workflow of creating a new meeting took about 30 seconds the first time around. Atticus then logs the exact steps to memory and takes 5-8 seconds on the next pass. To add to this, Atticus also learns about you as you use it more and from what's on your computer, including your name, your apps, and things you want it to remember, personalizing its answers to you. To combat the safety concerns over giving an AI unrestricted access to your device, Atticus has toggleable restrictions, so before anything is deleted, sent, bought, or written to a file, the user is prompted before that action. Some features I'm currently working on include a meeting copilot that capitalizes on Atticus' speed, allowing Atticus to listen in on meetings and answer questions in real time as they come in, personalized to the context of the meeting and what it knows about you. To run Atticus, macOS 26 or higher is required for its voice transcription features. The voice transcription is also done locally by macOS. Atticus is free, open source, and also very fresh, and I'm completely aware of its many rough edges, which is why I'd love to hear from everyone about what breaks and what you guys would like to see Atticus do!

projects.summary: 一款运行在 macOS 和 Windows 上的显示器联动工具。它监听普通 USB 切换器的动作，通过 DDC/CI 协议自动向外接显示器发送切源指令，让键盘、鼠标和多台显示器一键切到另一台电脑。 为什么做这个项目？ 很多双机办公的开发者（比如一台 Mac 办公，一台 Windows 娱乐或跑编译），桌面通常是两台电脑连着一到两台显示器。 目前的切换方案普遍存在痛点： 1. 硬件 KVM：支持 4K/高刷的硬件 KVM 普遍在数百甚至上千元，而且桌面接线复杂、容易挑线。 2. 纯软件 KVM（如 Barrier/Synergy）：通过局域网传输键鼠，有输入延迟，且两台电脑处于不同网络或内网隔离时无法使用。 3. 低成本 USB 切换器：几十块的切换器只能切键鼠，每次切电脑都要伸手去摸显示器背后的 OSD 按键，如果是双屏更要按两次。 它是怎么工作的？ 键盘、鼠标插在普通的 USB 切换器上，显示器视频线各自直连两台电脑。 两端运行 KVMFlow。按一下 USB 切换器切走键鼠时，软件捕获到设备离开/接入事件，立即通过 DDC/CI 向显示器发送切源指令（如从 DP 1 切到 HDMI 1）。 视频信号和外设依然走物理直连，零延迟、不占网络带宽、纯本地运行。 功能与特点 支持平台：macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows x64，底层核心采用 Rust 实现，跨平台体验一致。 多显示器支持：支持分别记录每台屏幕对应的输入源通道。 纯本地运行：不收集键鼠输入，不转发画面，无需注册账号。 开源协议：MIT License。 界面预览

projects.summary: 在 VS Code / Cursor 里提供类似 Eclipse 的底部 Javadoc 面板：源码留在编辑器里读，当前光标处类 / 方法 / 字段的 / … / 渲染到面板里；工程源码和 jar / jdt 依赖源都可用。可选通过 LLM 翻译成中文，原文与译文对照。 为什么做 从 Eclipse 转到 VS Code / Cursor 写 Java 时，最怀念的就是底部那个随光标刷新的 Javadoc 视图。悬停提示一闪而过、不够沉浸；打开完整 HTML 站点又太重。于是做了这个轻量面板：只渲染已有注释，不生成骨架，也不跑 JDK javadoc 导出站点。 核心功能 底部 Javadoc 面板随光标刷新（默认 Panel，可拖到侧栏） 渲染签名与 @param、@return、@see、@since 等标签 解析 {@code}、{@link}、{@linkplain}、{@literal}、{@value} 及常见 HTML 实体 链接可点击：{@link} / @see 在编辑器内跳转，外链用系统浏览器打开 明确支持 jar / jdt 依赖源，不只是工作区文件 可选 LLM 翻译：任意 OpenAI 兼容接口（OpenAI、DeepSeek、通义兼容端、本地 Ollama 等），译文缓存，API Key 存 Secret Storage 快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+Q，以及状态栏 / 标题栏入口 快速开始 1. 从 Marketplace 或 Open VSX 安装 JavaDoc Rendered View 2. 打开任意 .java（工作区或 jar 附加源码均可） 3. Ctrl+Alt+Q 打开面板，光标移到带 Javadoc 的成员上即可 4. （可选）执行 JavaDoc: Set Translation API Key，在面板点「译此块」做中英对照 欢迎试用和提意见。

projects.title: [开源自荐] 小喷 1.1.0： Mac 菜单栏语音伙伴，支持 ChatGPT 订阅和本机 Ollama
projects.author: AvalonKing
projects.summary: 我是小喷作者。这是我业余维护的原生 macOS 菜单栏语音助手，刚发布 1.1.0 ，代码采用 MIT 协议。想解决一个小需求：手在键盘上时，顺口查天气、定计时器或调音量，不用先找聊天窗口。 叫一声“小喷小喷”就能开始，回答后可以继续追问。提醒保存在本机；提醒和音量指令由本机解析执行，不依赖模型工具调用。普通问答使用你选择的大模型，并流式朗读。 技术上使用 Swift 6 / SwiftUI 。唤醒词用 macOS 本机语音识别；模型入口按服务商、通用接口、本机三组管理，各自保存配置，密钥和登录令牌放钥匙串。可以接自己的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容 API 、已有的 ChatGPT 订阅，或本机 Ollama 。应用免费下载，第三方模型和云端识别可能收费，ChatGPT 订阅受账户额度限制。 服务商目录集中定义协议、地址与模型预设，方便扩展；与模型有关的特殊参数单独处理。对本机技能，我更在意执行后能确认实际结果，例如调音量后重新读取设备状态，设备不支持时直接提示。 1.1.0 加了回声消除和直接开口打断，也能设成唤醒词打断。蓝牙耳机暂不支持语音打断，可用 ⌥⌘K 。朗读可选系统声音，或下载约 3.1 GB 的 Qwen3-TTS 在本机 GPU 运行。 隐私边界：默认叫醒后，含唤醒前约 2.5 秒的录音会发到千问做识别；直接说话打断时，也会发送约 1 秒预录及后续插话确认人声。可以切换本机识别。识别出的聊天文字发给所选模型，对话只留在内存；天气查询会向 Open-Meteo 发送城市或粗略坐标。 需要 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon 。当前安装包尚未经过苹果公证，首次安装有额外门槛，请先看安装说明。 [代码与安装说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac#安装) · [1.1.0 下载]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/releases/tag/v1.1.0) · [隐私说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md) 欢迎试用和提 Issue ，尤其想听听唤醒、断句和连续对话在哪些场景还不自然。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】LightGitPad：AI 写代码时，用来看项目和 Git 改动的轻量查看器

projects.summary: 这是我做的开源桌面工具 LightGitPad，适合在 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手修改代码后，检查工程和 Git 改动。 在一个窗口里可以查看： 工程文件树和带语法高亮的代码。 Git 改动及左右对照 diff、提交历史和分支列表。 Markdown 渲染预览，方便阅读助手生成的计划和报告。 支持 Windows 10/11 x64 和 macOS 12 及以上（Apple Silicon、Intel）。源码采用 C++ / Qt 6，MIT 协议；v0.2.18 已提供两平台安装包及 SHA256 校验文件。 它不调用任何 AI 服务，不需要账号或 API Key；Git 的提交、推送、拉取和切换分支仍由用户或编程助手完成。需要本机安装 Git 2.23 或以上。当前为 0.x 早期版本，安装包尚未用付费证书签名，首次启动需按 README 的说明确认。 项目： 下载： 中文说明： 欢迎试用，并通过项目 Issues 反馈问题或建议。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】jev-chat-jarvis-mac —— macOS 聊天悬浮窗：先看懂对方，再回复
projects.author: eatmoreduck

github.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis-mac
github.description: 聊天悬浮窗助手（macOS）：屏幕感知 + 本地小模型判断意图与风险，按话术生成回复候选。纯只读。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-mac 它是一个 macOS 悬浮窗：聊天应用里弹出一条消息，悬浮窗会告诉你这句话的真实意图（8 类，零样本 86.4%）、风险分级（0-9 分）和几条候选回复，点「填入」进输入框——发送键永远由你自己按。 技术上有几个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 感知层没有侵入任何聊天应用：要么对前台聊天窗口按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），再用 Apple Vision OCR 只扫聊天区，按气泡和左右对齐区分正文、昵称、固定公告和引用；要么直接走系统文本接口读，不截图不 OCR。 2. 判断层是个本地 2B 小模型，一次前向同时出 8 类意图的全分布和风险分级，下载后完全离线；也可以配 TypeSafe Jev 的 key 走云端。生成层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek、智谱、本地 Ollama 都实测过），14 种话术并发生成候选，再由本地模型重排。M1 Pro 上出意图约 1.5 秒。 3. 坚持只读不代发：不模拟任何按键——合成输入事件会被部分应用的账号风控识别；「填入」优先走辅助功能接口写入并读回确认，定位不到就复制到剪贴板让你自己粘贴。 用法：Releases 下载 .app 拖进应用程序，授予屏幕录制权限即可。仅支持 Apple Silicon（M 系列）+ macOS 13+，MIT 开源。 适合每天在微信/飞书/QQ 里打字很多、想先看懂对方再回复的人，以及研究屏幕感知 + 端侧小模型落地的同学。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】jev-chat-jarvis-ios —— 一个键盘打通所有聊天 App：先看懂对方再回复
projects.author: eatmoreduck

github.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis-ios
github.description: iOS 键盘：在任何聊天 App 里直接出意图、风险与候选回复——复制消息，键盘上见分晓。Swift / SwiftUI，中英双语。An iOS keyboard that drafts replies inside any chat app.

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-ios（iOS 键盘版） 它是一个 iOS 自定义键盘：在任何聊天 App 里，长按复制对方那条消息，切到 Jev 键盘点「分析剪贴板」，键盘上直接给出这句话的意图（8 类概率分布）、风险分级（0-9）、行动建议和候选回复，点一下候选文字就进输入框。不跳 App、不切后台、不申请录屏权限——一个键盘打通所有聊天软件。 技术上有两个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 判断层走 TypeSafe Jev 的 systemone 接口，一次调用同时拿到 8 类意图的概率分布和 0-9 风险分布，还给候选回复排序；没配 key 也不会挂，自动退化成只起草的"盲起草"。生成层是标准 OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic 兼容接口，智谱、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 都有预设，12 种话术并发各出 2 条（前稳后放）。 2. 键盘扩展有 60MB 内存上限，整个键盘是在这个约束下用纯系统控件搭的；App 和键盘共用的判断口径（意图集、风险量表、话术库、prompt）收在 Shared/ 目录单一实现里，用 swiftc 就能在 Mac 上跑口径回归，不需要 iPhone。 隐私边界：文字只在你点「分析」那一刻发往你自己配置的接口，无自建服务器、不落盘、不进日志；Key 存本机 App Group 私有容器；键盘不监听、不上传按键。发送永远由你手动完成。 Swift 5 + SwiftUI，iOS 16+，MIT 开源，Xcode 免费个人账号就能真机跑。

projects.title: Show HN: Stoke Money – Personal finance app built around a cash flow forecast
projects.author: _wesley
projects.summary: Hi HN, I've been through many finance tracking apps, starting with Personal Capital, then Monarch, and most recently Copilot. None of them have worked perfectly for my needs. All of these apps tend to model “cash flow” as the net sum of your transactions during a month, yet while credit card charges are reported immediately, they are typically deducted from checking (cash) accounts the following month when the bill is due. As a result, I've always had to maintain a separate spreadsheet to track my actual cash flow. These apps also have a huge focus on managing budgets, which has never been for me. My spending is rarely consistent month-to-month, so every month I'm comparing my fully justified spending against my budget, and tweaking my budget until I “pass”. So I built yet another finance tracking app. It has the usual components - accounts, transactions, categories - but the core is a cash flow projection engine, and everything else is built around it. Budgets are gone. Instead, each income/spending category is projected forward from your historical activity, but not as a flat monthly number. They land in whatever account you historically use (e.g. checking account for paychecks/rent/bills, credit/debit cards for daily spending). Credit card payments are modeled automatically based on your projected credit card balance. You can set up your own recurring transfers between accounts as well, to model savings, for example. The end result is that the app can forecast how your cash moves, and you can see in advance when any account might run low. If all of your accounts look good for the next 12 months, maybe you don't have a budgeting problem. What’s made the biggest difference for me has been the MCP integration, which I have connected to Claude (but can be connected to any AI agent of your choice). I have asked it to import historical transactions by uploading PDF account statements, categorize/tag all transactions that took place while I was on vacation, and plan transfers across my accounts to cover expected payments. I hope some people that share my frustrations will find this app useful.

projects.summary: Zenance 是一款由个人利用业余时间开发、专为追求效率与隐私的极客打造的纯客户端记账 PWA 应用程序。 作为多年的记账用户，市面上主流记账软件日益臃肿的开屏广告、强制手机号绑定、将私人财务明细上传至集中商业服务器的做法，让我感到疲惫。因此，我开发了 Zenance —— 致力于打造一款不喧宾夺主、把数据主权彻底还给用户的纯粹工具。 核心特性 1. 回归工具本质的极简美学： 采用类似 Vercel / Linear 的纯黑白单色与等宽字体设计，摒弃浮夸的渐变与多余阴影。 不喧宾夺主：确立软件作为「纯粹工具」的属性，让界面彻底退居幕后，将 100% 的视觉焦点留给用户的收支状况与资产明细。 2. 本地优先与绝对隐私（Zero Telemetry）： 数据 100% 存储于本机浏览器的 IndexedDB (Dexie.js)，支持完全断网离线使用。 全站零分析追踪、零遥测代码，无任何后端服务器收集用户财务隐私。 3. 零知识 AES-GCM 端到端加密同步（E2EE）： 支持通过个人 Dropbox API 实现多端双向数据同步。 数据在离开浏览器前均由 Web Crypto API (AES-GCM + PBKDF2) 在本地加密完成，云端仅存放密文，实现零知识隐私保护。 4. 解耦人际往来的「对象 (Contacts)」管理： 将流水明细与人情账目彻底解耦，顶部直观汇总「谁欠我（应收）」、「我欠谁（应还）」与「往来净额」。 清晰划分个人往来与机构/商户账目，从容应对聚餐代付分账、人情借贷对账等复杂场景。 5. 多币种与自由备份： 支持多币种账户管理与资金调配。 提供分类预算滚动追踪、支出可视化报表。 支持一键导出/导入标准 JSON 数据快照，无任何厂商锁定；内置 PIN 码闲置防窥锁定。 技术栈 前端：React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 样式：Tailwind CSS v4 + Shadcn UI / Base UI + Lucide Icons 存储与状态：Dexie.js (IndexedDB) + Zustand 加密与同步：Web Crypto API + Dropbox API PWA 引擎：vite-plugin-pwa (Service Worker 完整离线缓存) 国际化：原生支持 11 种语言界面 欢迎阮老师与周刊读者把玩、体验并提出宝贵的改进建议！

projects.title: 第一个独立上线的 Web 站：用 3 天做了个 Rumpelstiltskin 踮脚舞 AI 视频生成器，记录一下踩过的坑
projects.author: komazhao
projects.summary: 做了很多年数据和产品，一直想自己从零上线一个能收钱的站。这次赶上一个梗，终于把第一个站发出去了，记录一下。 站点： https://rumpelstiltskinaivideo.app ## 它是干嘛的 10 月初 TikTok 和 X 上火了一个 AI 生成的片段：一个像 80 年代奇幻电影里的小矮人（ Rumpelstiltskin ），在堆满稻草的谷仓里，配着 Riff Raff 的 "Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz" 踮脚跳舞。很多人想把自己放进这个片段里。 这个站做的就是这件事：上传一张照片，生成一段由你来跳舞的同款视频。 - 输入：1 张单人照片，不用写提示词 - 输出：约 11 秒、720p ，可选 16:9 （和原片同构图）或 9:16 （适合 TikTok/Reels ） - 文件：带原片配乐的 MP4 + 无声 GIF ，无水印 - 耗时：4 ～ 7 分钟，关掉页面也会继续生成 ## 技术栈 - 前端/全栈：TanStack Start - 部署：Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 ，Cron Trigger 补查超时任务 - 生成流程：Nano Banana 2 把照片转成彩铅风参考图 → 火山方舟 Seedance 2.0 mini 参考视频模式逐镜头重演原片 → 服务端用 Mediabunny 合入原片配乐 → 存 R2 - 支付：Waffo Pancake （ Merchant of Record ） ## 定价和成本 不做免费试用，单条 $4.99 ，3 条 $11.99 ，10 条 $29.99 ，一次性付费，不订阅，生成失败自动退积分。 没给免费额度，是因为每条都实打实烧 GPU ，新站扛不住白嫖流量。这个决定对不对，欢迎拍砖。 ## 踩过的坑 1. **照片太小直接被模型拒**：用户传了 260×626 的图，接口报 "invalid file"。后来在浏览器端先规整照片：短边小于 720 放大，长边超过 2048 缩小，极端长宽比补模糊边。 2. **用户关页面导致任务卡死**：提交模型后、写回任务 ID 前，请求被中断。改成 Workers 的 `waitUntil` 跑完后续步骤，Cron 兜底超时退款。 3. **PayPal 在日本一直登不上开发者后台**：最后换成 Waffo ，自己按文档手写 RSA 签名和 webhook 验签。 4. **Cloudflare 部署报 "compatibility date in the future"**：nitro 用本机日期写兼容日期，北京时间凌晨 Cloudflare 那边还是前一天。加 `TZ=UTC` 解决。 5. **Workers Builds 推送后一直"已加入队列"**：最后改成本地 wrangler 部署。 ## 关于 GEO 这次也在实践让 ChatGPT 这类 AI 搜索能收录、推荐我的站：写 llms.txt ，每个问题做一个答案页（第一句直接给答案、数字写死），加 FAQ/Article Schema ，接 IndexNow 和 Bing Webmaster 。效果怎么样还在观察，有结果了再来更新。 ## 求反馈 第一次独立上线，产品、定价、落地页、SEO 有什么问题都欢迎直说。也想听听大家做"热点梗站"的经验：热度一般能撑多久，热度过了之后怎么办？

projects.title: 花了不到 200 元用 vibe coding 做的 ffee 在线工具小站，大家看看还可以吧
projects.author: lssvip
projects.summary: 前阵子，花了不到 20 元做了一个小站后，有点上瘾了，vibe coding 简直太爽了，我以前一直想成为一名程序员的，每当看到电视或者视频里程序员坐在电脑前敲着键盘，屏幕上闪烁的代码，就觉着特别的酷，特别的神秘。 现在有了这个 AI 的 agent,让我也可以这么酷酷的了，不过不是敲代码，而是和 AI 对话，这不重要啦，反正结果都是一样的。都是写程序嘛。 这次还是用的 deepseek 桌面 agent,有了上次的经验，对 AI 有一个放心了，感觉靠谱，于是前前后后花了不到 200 元。做了一个在线工具箱的小站。ffee.me 灵感来源就是我做第一个小站的时候，需要做个 logo 啊，需要 favicon 图标啊，png 转 ico,等接触到了一些小工具，觉着非常方便。于是就想着做个免费的在线小工具。（ vibe coding 火了，像我这样有需求的应该不少） 整个过程用了 3 天，后面陆续又更新维护，搞 SEO,啥的用了两天，才上线。全程没用我动手写一行代码，我只是用语言去描述。 说说我做这个小站遇到的一些问题吧。 这个在线小工具网站目前有 1000 个小工具了，都是免费使用的，有英语版，中文版，德语版，法语版。遇到的第一个坑就是语言翻译太相信 AI 了，没想到它翻译的时候把我代码中的对象名，函数啥的都翻译了， 压根无法做到很好去区分哪些需要翻译，哪些不能翻译。得亏做了备份，不然又要从头来了，它是真的瞎给你写啊，导致现在小站除了英语版是完整的，其他语言内容还没有翻译出来。 由于 token 消耗特别快，有点心疼，就把 DeepSeek Harness 由原来的 V41pro 改成了 v41flash 版本，写代码足够用了。费用确实节省了不少，根据自己要做的事情选择合适的 AI 版本真的可以省不少钱。 好了，就先聊到这里，有想问的，可以一起沟通哦。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】StockBar：把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具
projects.author: Garretqaq

github.name: Garretqaq/stock-bar
github.description: 把行情放在菜单栏，随时掌握市场动态。macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 悬浮行情条的 A 股盯盘小工具：实时价格、涨跌幅、分时图抬眼就能看，不占 Dock。Tauri 2 + 原生 TypeScript

projects.summary: 项目：StockBar | 平台：macOS / Windows / Linux | 许可：MIT | 最新版本：v0.0.6 它是什么 一个把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具，Tauri 2 + Rust + 原生 TypeScript。 盘中想瞄一眼自选，又不想一直开着完整的行情软件 —— 那类软件占地方、还显眼。StockBar 把常看的几只留在菜单栏，点一下展开指数、自选和分时图，看完就收起。macOS 上不占 Dock；Windows 托盘放不下文字，就另外给一条可拖动的悬浮行情条。 界面是真的轻：不用 UI 框架、不用图表库，列表是原生 DOM 拼的，分时图是 canvas 一笔一笔画的。数据走东方财富的公开接口，失败时自动切到腾讯，所以不用注册、不用 API Key。 功能详解 📌 抬眼就能看见 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两张一行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 📊 分时图与成交额 点指数卡片或自选行就展开当天的分时，再点一次收起。内置上证、深证成指、创业板指；大盘指数的分时多取一天，用来算「与上一日同期」的成交额对比，个股则是单日。 🗂️ 自选与分组 搜索支持代码、名称和拼音；置顶、拖动排序、自定义分组都在。分组多了筛选条会横向滑动，末尾的 ☰ 把全部分组摊成一片标签，带每组的自选数量，点一下就切过去。加入菜单栏、移入分组、删除都支持批量。 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 自带零依赖的 MCP 服务（11 个工具），支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端可以按你的话操作： 「新建一个『持仓』分组，把宁德时代加进去并置顶。」 「把苹果和英伟达移到『观察』分组。」 命令通过本机 127.0.0.1 上的随机端口交给应用执行，走的是和手点界面完全相同的校验与同步规则，界面会立刻跟着变。这一步默认关闭，需要时到设置里拨开。 ⚙️ 按自己的习惯来 跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色主题，红涨绿跌 / 绿涨红跌，3 / 5 / 10 / 30 秒刷新，报价与分时可固定用东方财富或腾讯。安装后能在「关于」页检查更新、一键升级。 两个平台各长什么样 macOS 是自绘窗口控件的菜单栏小窗（360×560），Windows 走平台布局：托盘 + 桌面悬浮行情条，托盘图标随任务栏深浅自动着色。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Tauri 2、Rust | | 界面 | 原生 TypeScript、Vite、canvas（无 UI 框架、无图表库） | | 数据 | 东方财富公开接口，失败时自动切腾讯 | | MCP | 零依赖 stdio JSON-RPC 服务 + Rust 侧本地 HTTP 桥 | | 测试 | Vitest（前端纯逻辑 + MCP 脚本，含一条起进程的端到端用例） | 快速开始 macOS 与 Windows 都有现成安装包（Linux 暂无官方预编译包，可从源码运行）： 下载： 从源码跑，需要 Node.js 22+、pnpm、Rust stable 和对应平台的 Tauri 2 开发依赖： bash git clone cd stock-bar pnpm install pnpm app:dev 只想看界面的话 pnpm dev 即可，浏览器里 Tauri 调用会降级为空操作。 需要说清楚的几件事 macOS 安装包暂未签名与公证，首次打开请右键「打开」，或 xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/StockBar.app。 交易状态按市场时区和报价里的最后成交时间推断，没有节假日日历，开盘前无法提前判定当天是否休市。 行情来自公开接口，刷新频率不代表交易所级实时性；覆盖范围以数据源返回为准。 项目还很年轻（v0.0.6），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。觉得有用的话，点一颗 Star 就是最大的鼓励 ⭐️

github.description: 🧙‍♂️ 独立开发者与顾问的商业对账神器：终结月末手搓 Excel 噩梦，开会扯皮/Git成果自动变凭据，内置削峰填谷等4大合同引擎。Local-first timesheet & smart contract billing platform for devs. Turn parallel work & meetings into auditable man-days. (Rust + Tauri 2.0)

projects.summary: 在全面进入 AI 编程时代后，开发者的工作流发生了颠覆：敲代码更快了，多任务并发更多了，但客户依然按“人天合同”结算。单纯记录敲键盘工时会直接惩罚高效率工程师；同时，大量核心时间耗费在开会扯皮等“0 代码提交”的场景上，月底对账缺乏凭证，全靠肉身手搓 Excel。 MythManDay 专为独立开发者、技术顾问与外包团队打造： 1. 终结手搓 Excel 噩梦：一键导出按月分 Sheet 的多维标准 .xlsx 商业对账单，带规范公式与排版，财务秒过； 2. 开会即存证：本地安全录制音频，结合本地 Whisper 离线提取 AI 结构化会议纪要，让没有 Git 提交的沟通也能变成无可辩驳的合法交付证据； 3. 4 大合同人天引擎：支持合规削峰填谷（单日 8h 封顶、平摊回填）、顾问保底（1.0 人天起步）等复杂商业结算规则； 4. 100% 本地优先与隐私脱敏：数据仅存本地 SQLite，断网可用；支持一键金额隐身模式，屏幕共享时不泄露商业底牌。 技术栈 Rust 1.80+ + Tauri 2.0 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS + SQLite，目前已在 Linux / Windows / macOS 支持打包运行，未来规划原生支持 MCP (Model Context Protocol)。 欢迎 HelloGitHub 推荐收录！ 亮点 1. 终结手搓 Excel 噩梦：告别月末痛苦翻聊天记录凑假账，一键批量导出按月分 Sheet 的多维标准 .xlsx 商业对账单，带规范公式与排版，财务秒过； 2. 开会扯皮变合法凭据：针对“开会 3 小时在 Git 呈 0 提交容易被砍工时”的痛点，支持开会即打卡，配合本地 Whisper 离线提取 AI 结构化决议与待办，绝不上云泄密； 3. 独创 4 大商业合同人天引擎：彻底解耦“原始物理流水”与“商业合同推演”，内置削峰填谷（单日 8h 封顶/跨日平摊回填）、顾问保底（1.0 人天起步）等合同规则； 4. 100% 本地优先与商业底牌脱敏：基于 Rust + Tauri 2.0 构建，数据完全存在本地 SQLite；顶栏支持一键金额隐身，屏幕共享时绝不泄露时薪单价。

projects.title: Show HN: Pulse Local, a Mac budgeting app whose AI models run on your machine
projects.author: niztk
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Niz. Pulse Local is a budgeting app for Mac (Apple Silicon, beta) that answers questions about your spending with models that run on your machine. Local mode needs no account. The ledger and your questions stay on the machine, and the app sends no analytics or crash logs. I felt there are not enough consumer apps that run locally with no calls to the outside world that help us manage sensitive corners of our lives. This app in its local variant only downloads a couple of models and occasional updates, it does not send any analytics nor data. Features-wise, Pulse local is a complete budgeting app that offers an assistant built on top of a fine-tuned model and thousands of rules embedded in the code itself. I'm sharing it for free with options to help me continue experimenting with fine-tuning and expanding along this direction. How it works: you import a CSV from any bank, in any currency. When you ask a question, a tuned Qwen3 0.6B model reads it into a structured query, and code, not the model, does the money math against the ledger. A 4B checker model double-checks each money answer; when the two readings disagree, the app says it is not sure instead of guessing. That change took wrong answers from about one in five to 5 in 494 questions across our last three tests. The write-up covers how we test, the designs that failed, and the limits of the claim: https://pulseos.finance/pulse-local/writing/agree-or-not-sur... The tuned weights are on Hugging Face (PulseOS/pulse-local-qwen3-0.6b). Limitations: the first start downloads about 2.9 GB of models. With the checker on, a money answer takes 12 to 14 seconds (you can turn the checker off). Small models can still misread an open-ended question. The app answers in English. Mac only for now; Windows is next. The app is free. An optional Connected mode (Sync Pass, $29/year) syncs US banks through Plaid; transactions pass through our server's memory and are not stored. Feedback welcome, especially on wrong answers and on questions it should handle but does not.

projects.title: Show HN: Lightweight, self-hosted, web analytics app
projects.author: composer42
projects.summary: Hey everyone! I just wanted to share a little project I have been working on. It's a lightweight, minimal, self-hosted, web analytics app alternative to Google Analytics, Umami, GoatCounter etc. Tldr: Created a self hosted web analytics app that is one binary (docker image available). AI was used to assist. Check it out if you care. I wanted to self host a lightweight web analytics app to see if any of my pages had any visitors, but all of the self hosted apps I found were either way to heavy for what I was looking for, or simply didn’t have a UI/UX I liked. So I just made one myself. The app features a dashboard with multi-site and subdomain support, and some simple filtering on date and visitor details (all EU regulation friendly, so no PIs such as IPs etc). A bit about the process: As I wanted it simple and lightweight, a single executable was the goal. Deciding for the frontend was easy since it doesn’t need SEO or any server side rendering, therefore I chose React with plain CSR (thankfully the DX these days is nice with Vite). The backend was a bit more tricky, since I wanted to have it fast, but also be able to get an MVP out sooner rather than later. The plan was thus two folded; first to do it in Deno to keep everything TypeScript and to implement features fast (it is still my go-to language for prototypes), then to refactor everything to a compiled language (Go or Rust) once I considered the app feature complete. So I started the prototype, but just a couple of days later, the announcement of Deno being sunset came out. As I had already gotten to a point where the backend was mostly functional, I decided to pull the plug early and refactor! The tough decision was Rust vs Go, and Rust ultimately won as I like the DX and how the language looks and writes a wee bit more. So I did what most engineers do in 2026 (looking at you Bun), and I asked my AI for help. Although I consider myself pretty ok with Rust, there are still parts that I haven’t wrapped my head around fully, so as the intention was to get something out fast, I had to bite the bullet. Lastly for the database I wanted something embedded, so SQLite was the natural choice. The final app ended up with a decent ~10mb (down from ~250mb with Deno) which I don’t think is too shabby. Some quick benchmarking on 1 cpu and 2gb RAM told me it could handle ~16.000 incoming analytics requests per second. The bottleneck being the database writer lock (give it more CPU, and it can do better). As this is a hobby project, and I dont expect a peak load of more than maybe 10 a day, I am content with this. I consider this app mostly feature complete, and will use it for the next month before eventually releasing a v1 after fixing whatever bugs that may show themselves. If you think you can improve the app further and want to spend time on it, feel free to make a PR ^^ To sum up the stack: React+Vite+TanStack+Tailwind frontend, Rust+Axum backend and SQLite database; all compiled to one binary of about ~10mb. Disclaimer: Yes, AI has been used for parts of the development, docs and for commit messages, but the code has been reviewed and iterated over by me, a somewhat reasonably sentient human.

projects.summary: （我来自法国，不会中文，下面的内容借助 AI 翻译，如有不通顺的地方请见谅。） 租房、求职、开户时，经常要把身份证照片发给别人。发出去之后，这份复印件就不受自己控制了。在上面写明用途、接收方和日期，比如「仅供租房申请使用，XX房产，2026年10月11日」，就很难被挪作他用。 但我发现，大多数在线加水印工具都要先把身份证上传到它们的服务器。为了保护证件，反而要先把它交出去，这说不通，所以我做了 Cachety。 它是一个纯前端的网页工具，所有处理都在浏览器里完成：用 pdf.js 把每一页渲染成图片，把水印画进图片里，再生成一个全新的文件。网站没有接收文件的服务器，页面的 CSP 设置了 connect-src 'self'，浏览器本身就会拒绝向其他域名发送任何数据。可以自己验证：打开页面后开启飞行模式，照样能用。 其他功能： 遮盖身份证号、银行卡号等信息，内容会被真正删除，而不只是盖上一层。 自动清除文字层、元数据和照片的 GPS 位置。 每份副本可带日期和唯一编号；可为每个接收方各生成一份。 可选 AES-256 加密 PDF；支持 iPhone 的 HEIC 照片；手机上也能用。 界面支持简体中文等 7 种语言。 已知局限：水印只能是文字；输出的 PDF 是图片，文字不能再选中，文件可能比原来大。水印能防止复印件被挪用，但挡不住有人翻拍。 免费、无需注册、AGPL-3.0 开源。基于 Next.js 静态导出，部署在 Cloudflare Pages。

projects.title: Show HN: Search for AI agents with usefulness score built in
projects.author: Ayobamiu
projects.summary: Hi HN. I partnered with Simon Kley to build this project at innovation intelligence hackathon (Berkeley). Simply, we’re building a usefulness score on top of search for ai-agents. Instead of agents reading 10 ranked relevant pages, we run a usefulness score first and give it only those that pass. We’re able to save token and cost with this and slightly better answers. During our research, we found out that the current search results already do justice when it comes to simple queries. The rankings work well. They struggle when the task requires deep research or recency matters. So, we decided to talk to devs building ai-agents that research companies for sales outreach. Deep research and recency matters a lot to them. And in their words “every so often, stale facts reach emails.” They catch them by someone responding to the email or human review. From our tests, When an agent got outdated alert for 7 companies, it pitched outdated news for 4 out of them. Talking to the engineers already building this agents, we learned that cost saving is not the real goal. They’re ready to pay premium for confident results. So we added another check to our score. We call it superseding score, it check for pages replaced by newer news. For example, if two recent pages were fetched for news on Humane ai pin. If the first talks about how groundbreaking the product is and the second did that + talked about the HP acquisition, then the second page supersedes the first. The first page gets a lower score. We’re looking for feedbacks here and also teams that are building agents that research companies for outreach. Thanks. Plus, we rank a page once and every agent reuses it, so the more the agents use us, the cheaper the search gets.

projects.title: Show HN: Kitaphone – Call mobile phones and landlines directly from the browser
projects.author: beardnetworks
projects.summary: Hi HN Folks, I have been building Kitaphone a web app that lets you call regular mobile and landline numbers directly from your browser. The idea is simple, there are still plenty of situations where apps like WhatsApp, facetime and other internet calling apps aren't an option. For example, when you are abroad and need to call your bank, an airline, or a government office or your son/daughter's school. I wanted to make those calls possible without requiring users to install another app or buy a sim card or even commit to a monthly subscription. I built Kitaphone using Next.js and Twilio, One of the more interesting challenges has been making browser based calling reliable, especially when it comes to dealing with microphone permissions, sending keypad inputs to automated phone systems, and preventing abuse of free calling credits. The product is live and supports international calls to regular phone numbers, users currently need an account to make calls partly because each call has a real telecom cost. I am still improving it and learning from the people using it by receiving feedback. Fun fact: "kita" means our in Bahasa Malaysia, since I am based in this beautiful country and their people are so warm and welcoming I was truly inspired by this place and decided to name it our phone. Interested to know or receive feedback from HN folks who worked with WebRTC or VoiP in the past.

projects.title: Show HN: Are interstellar visitors alien probes?
projects.author: Lucent
projects.summary: There was a lot of debate about whether the 3 interstellar objects found might not be natural. Most of it cherry-picked a few oddities and claimed decisively, for or against. I don't have a strong opinion, and don't trust my eye for coincidence or to spot astrology-like "planetary alignment", so I simulated millions of random paths through the solar system and counted how many came closer than the 3 known objects, either to the planets or to or from nearby stars. 1I and 2I look like chance. Loeb et al. put 3I's planetary passes at 1 in 20,000. Scored against all eight planets and random arrivals of its speed, it's about 1 in 300. I don't know how much more easily surveys spot objects along the ecliptic, which would explain some of 3I's coincidence. I welcome forking the project and adjusting the assumptions I made, like a Bracewell or von Neumann probe would take a traveling salesman path, or that it would need to fly near multiple planets.

projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个 AI 病毒短视频复刻工具： 很多创作者都有过这样的经历：刷到一条宠物半路变身南瓜犬的视频、或者那个橙色房间里两人对唱说唱的 Hotel Lobby 梗，想给自己（或自己的猫）也来一条，打开通用 AI 视频工具却无从下手——提示词写不出那个“梗”的结构，硬写出来的片子既不像爆款，里面的“你”也随时变成另一个人。ClickClips 想解决的就是这一步：从“我想要那个梗”到“我自己的版本”之间的鸿沟。 它的核心能力是模板复刻。站内有 多个从真实爆款拆解出来的模板——宠物变身、万圣节装死惊吓、门铃摄像头宠物保镖、冰封产品揭示、Hotel Lobby 对唱等，每个模板背后都是一份完整的创意蓝图：节拍骨架、机位契约、一致性规则。你要做的是选一个模板、上传自己的照片、点生成，三次点击。 比较特别的是身份保持。你上传的照片不是“参考一下气氛”，而是整条生成链路的视觉锚点：人、宠物、产品的脸、毛发、轮廓全程锁定——宠物变身变的是形态，不变的是“那是我家狗”。Hotel Lobby 模板还带逐句说唱词，两位表演者各念各的词，口型跟着词走；背景色由参考色板精确锚定，不再靠形容词碰运气。每次生成会沿三条不同的创意轴各写一版故事（比如“镜像同步 / 逐句对飙 / 一稳一炸”），你挑最对味的那条再出片。 技术上它是一条四段式工作流：视觉模型分析你上传的照片、故事模型沿创意轴成文、导演模型规划分镜、参考图锚定的视频模型出片——各司其职，而不是一个提示词框硬扛一切。产出 6-15 秒竖版，直接可发 TikTok / Reels / Shorts。 选模板、预览 AI 现场写的故事是免费的，首页不注册就能玩；出片按积分计费，没有订阅。链接再贴一次： ，有兴趣可以先用 Hotel Lobby 模板试试水。 它的定位很清晰：不做从零开始的通用生成，只做生成之前的那一步——使用当前流利的模板快速生成流利短视频

projects.title: 【开源自荐】F3-Win：Windows 原生 Direct I/O 扩容盘检测与自愈工具，自带法庭级维权存证报告与极简热力图
projects.author: Wenaixi

github.name: Wenaixi/f3-win
github.description: Fight Flash Fraud for Windows - Ultra-high-performance flash drive capacity and speed test GUI (Rust + Win32 Direct I/O + egui)

projects.summary: 📎 项目地址 🚀 官方发版 (v0.1.0 单文件绿色版) 💡 背景与痛点 很多数码玩家或普通消费者在电商平台购买低价 U 盘、SD 内存卡或移动固态硬盘时，经常遭遇扩容假盘（标称 512GB 实际仅 8GB 报废黑片，超出部分自动回绕覆盖或读全0）。 而现有检测工具存在明显短板： 1. H2testw：近十余年未更新，缺乏现代硬件快速探测算法，大容量全盘漫长等待动辄数小时，且无法图形化定位坏块； 2. 原版 F3 (Fight Flash Fraud)：基于 Linux 命令行开发，普通 Windows 用户难以直接上手，缺乏原生高效的 GUI 交互； 3. 恶意固件进化：新型假盘主控具备“算力回放 (Compute-on-Read)”能力，利用原版 F3/H2testw 的线性同余乘数模逆元在芯片内现场运算伪造随机数，实施 0 字节闪存欺诈。 为了彻底解决这些痛点，我们打造了 F3-Win —— 一个纯 Rust + Win32 原生 Direct I/O 的单文件绿色扩容盘真伪检测与自愈利器。 ✨ 核心技术亮点 1. Win32 Direct I/O 物理直通： 采用 FILEFLAGNOBUFFERING | FILEFLAGWRITETHROUGH 彻底绕过系统文件缓存，并利用 VirtualAlloc 4KB 扇区对齐双缓冲，物理级压榨硬件总线带宽，测出真实颗粒吞吐。 2. 数分钟快速跳跃探测 (f3probe)： 忠实还原原版 F3 核心跳跃探针算法，在磁盘高位冲刷 32MB 穿透 SLC Cache 缓存，数分钟内侦测出假盘真实物理容量与硬件回绕（Wrap-around）边界。 3. 独家单向雪崩置换防伪 (Anti-Fake PRF)： 引入非线性单向雪崩置换密钥派生算法，Salt 永不落盘，彻底击穿假盘主控模逆元算力回放作弊，信息论强制其实体写入真实物理介质。 4. 实时仪表盘与扇区健康热力矩阵： 1200 点自适应平滑跟焦测速折线图（基于 eguiplot，精准捕捉 SLC 缓存耗尽与主控 GC 垃圾回收卡顿）； 1000 块全盘百分比归一化的扇区健康可视化热力块矩阵（直观渲染 Good、Bad、Changed、Overwritten 状态）。 5. 法庭级维权存证报告中枢： 首创首发故障扇区微观 Hexdump 取证，精准记录故障物理偏移与数据现场； 自动生成符合我国《消费者权益保护法》第五十五条标准的“退一赔三”法律维权公文模板与防灭失 Markdown 存证案卷，方便买家直接截图用于电商投诉或维权诉讼。 6. 双轨分区自愈修复 (f3fix)： 针对假盘提供一键安全自愈重写真实容量分区（Win32 原生 API 直写与标准 diskpart 脚本双轨），让缩水假盘变回真实可用容量的安全盘。 7. 纯正单文件绿色与原生系统托盘： 纯 Rust + eframe/egui 构建，无任何 C++ 运行时依赖，单文件仅 ~3.3MB；内置 Win32 原生系统托盘驱动三级自愈加载架构（崩溃自动重载、关于版本号弹窗、最小化防误触中断）。 📸 运行效果截图 项目内嵌瑞士平面设计极简品牌图标与 Fluent 深色工业风仪表盘，欢迎在 Release 页面直接下载体验单文件绿色版二进制产物。

projects.title: Show HN: Gondwana, a code-first C#/.NET game engine with WebGL
projects.author: isthimius
projects.summary: Gondwana is a 2D/2.5D game engine for C#/.NET 8 that I’ve been building over the past 16 months, using SkiaSharp for rendering. I've spent my career creating web and distributed apps and that has influenced the engine's development, so it will feel very familiar to anyone with a similar background. The engine is deliberately code-first in its implementation but still includes visual authoring tools and a custom CLI. I started creating Gondwana to host my own RTS and SNES-style games, to offload the game ideas percolating in my brain. I wanted to focus more on creating gameplay systems and was less concerned with 3D graphics. The predictability and transparency of the old Win32/GDI era were the ideal for what I was shooting for, but I also wanted something faster and more portable than GDI32. To that end, I am not trying to emulate the bigger engines. Spot! became my primary dogfooding project that I’ve since pushed up to itch.io. Getting a game to that point really helped burn away the cruft that accumulates from trying to create something like this. I was able to get Spot! to render at a consistent 120 fps on my dev machine. I experienced the absolute ecstasy of getting WebGL to cooperate with the engine cycle. And I discovered that even if Gondwana is code-first, you don’t want to hand-code platformer levels, so I added Gondwana Studio to the repository. Studio uses the same file formats that are understood by the core engine. Asset handling was beefed up, UI widgets were added for things like game HUD elements and engine diagnostics, and I fleshed out the CI/release pipeline to keep it organized. As it stands currently, Gondwana supports GPU-backed OpenGL rendering with WinForms and Avalonia hosts, and a dedicated WebGL path with Blazor. Recently a good bit of effort has been put into optimizing the rendering hot-path, reducing contention between simulation and presentation, and into making the visual tooling easy to use by people other than just me. I even was able to get itch.io deployment down to a single command in the custom CLI. The engine is still actively evolving feature-wise, but the core rendering is pretty solid right now. I expect Gondwana will remain 2D/2.5D with parallax support, so I am not trying to supplant Unity, Godot, et al. Also worth noting, Gondwana intentionally does not have an explicit ECS framework built in, although one could absolutely work well with the engine if desired. The project is MIT licensed, the source is hosted on GitHub, the packages are on NuGet, and Spot! is playable in the browser at itch.io. I will include several links in the first comment under this. I’d love to see what other hobbyists or indie game devs think of the project. Feedback on usability, as well as praise and/or criticism of the architecture would be awesome.

projects.author: SinanWang
projects.summary: 我想做一个能陪大家写代码、也能在休息时进去逛逛的小世界，于是有了 Vibe 村：一款面向 Vibe Coding 爱好者的像素风村庄经营游戏。 第一次打开需要加载游戏素材，可能有些慢。 你从一片林地和一间木材厂开始，慢慢搭起生产线、建造住宅、种菜、布置小院，把森林里的小村庄经营起来。 🎮 可以玩些什么？ 🪵 经营木材厂 招募伐木工和种植工，安排采伐、补种和运输，再把原木一步步加工成木板与成品。升级设备、扩展林区，观察哪里缺料、哪里积压，把整条生产线运转起来。 🚚 接订单、做生意 根据客户需求备货、装车、配送，完成订单领取货款，再把收入投入下一轮建设。随着发展，还能解锁更多设备和经营内容。 👷 招募经理，逐步实现自动化 收集和培养不同经理，提高机器效率，解锁运输和接单等自动化能力，看着伙伴们在村里忙碌。 🏡 盖房子，建设自己的村庄 从第一栋住宅开始，收集木材、钉子、油漆和砖块，完成施工与升级，逐渐提高村庄繁荣度。 🥕 种菜、手作、逛小院 经营之外，也可以照料田园、参与小游戏、制作手作品、收集装饰，按自己的节奏安排村庄生活。 💎 把编程日常带进游戏 连接 Vibestead CLI 后，可以同步 AI 编程用量，回到游戏领取钻石，用于村庄建设和装饰。支持接入 Codex、Claude Code 等工具；上传的是每日用量汇总，不上传代码或聊天正文。 游戏内置了全球排行榜，可以跟全球玩家对比Token消耗量，也可以创建一个群组，跟自己的几个朋友一起做一个小榜单互相比比谁消耗的Token更多。 ✨ 我最想分享的几个亮点 写代码与养村庄连在一起：编程用量可以兑换游戏奖励，给每天的 coding 多一点看得见的仪式感。 经营过程看得见：工人采伐、车辆运输、机器加工，资源沿着生产线流转，小村庄会随着投入逐渐成长。 经营与田园生活都能玩：想研究效率就调整产线，想放松就种菜、盖房、布置小院。 打开浏览器就能玩：支持中文和英文，适合在写代码的间隙回来看看。 游戏还在持续打磨中，欢迎喜欢像素风、放置经营和 Vibe Coding 的朋友来试试。也很想听听大家的建议：哪里好玩、哪里卡住、还想在村里做些什么，都欢迎告诉我。

projects.title: Show HN: Sufuku – Sudoku, but Numbers Repeat
projects.author: matthorse
projects.summary: Sudoku is short for "the digits must be single". I wondered if inverting this would work: "the digits must be repeated". And so, by swapping "doku" for "fuku", Sufuku was born. In short, instead of using numbers 1-9 for a 9x9 board, you use 2 twice, 3 three times, and 4 four times (for a total of 9). It plays differently from sudoku than I expected. I assumed it would be simpler, since you have fewer digits. But once I settled on irregular region shapes, I discovered that it can also be quite difficult. In sudoku you eliminate a number by placing it; in sufuku a number is only eliminated once all its copies are placed. So you count lines instead of mostly scanning the board. As I want the game to be approachable, the daily boards are mostly 6x6 or 7x7 for now. Larger boards are more interesting because 6x6 has only one set of numbers: [1, 2, 3]. But for 9x9 you can go with [2, 3, 4], [1, 3, 5], or [1, 2, 6] (I skip pairs like [2, 7] because I consider them boring). 10x10 is the first one that offers a set of four numbers: [1, 2, 3, 4]. Of course it turns out the idea has been around for some time: 2-3-4 Sudoku (Uwe Wiedemann) and Sudoku Ripeto (Miguel Palomo). I'm curious what you make of it as a daily game. Today's Friday, so the board is on the harder side. You can play easier boards in this week's archive.

If you get any question wrong or let the timer expire you're out for that game. Let's also get this out of the way: I used Claude Code to build this game. The first version took a couple of hours and in total I've spent about 10 hours tweaking and improving it. Happy to talk about that! The stack is simple: one Cloudflare Worker and D1 (SQLite), plain JS, no framework If you're a Soundgarden fan you already know what inspired the name of the game, the song Outshined. What inspired me to create the game is I love trivia (even though I'm not great at it) and a friend of mine built a nearly impossible game completely different to this. That got me thinking what kind of nearly impossible trivia game I could make. So far 92% of players fail, which makes me think I should make question #7 more difficult because 8% are getting all 7 questions correct. Totals since launch (not including my own playing/testing): - 651 games played - 178 (26%) out on the first question - 54 (8%) got 7/7 correct I've had feedback that has run the gamut from "I hate time games" to "This is so fun!" so I don't even know what to think about feedback anymore. Happy to hear yours!

github.description: TwexAPI Skills, MCP, and developer tools for structured public social data. Independent third-party service.

projects.summary: 文档： 开源 SDK / MCP / CLI（MIT 协议）： 我是这个服务的开发者，自荐一个读取 X（Twitter）公开数据的 API。 X 官方 API 改为按量计费后，读取 1000 条帖子要 5 美元，读取 1000 个用户资料要 10 美元，个人开发者做点小工具、写个研究脚本，成本很高。TwexAPI 只用一个 API Key，不需要申请 X 开发者账号，也不需要绑定你自己的 X 账号。 主要特点： 1. 支持高级搜索（按关键词、用户、日期筛选）、用户资料、时间线、粉丝/关注列表、回复、引用、转推者、全球趋势、X 长文（Articles）。 2. 按量计费，读取一条帖子或用户资料约 5 Credits（1 美元 = 100,000 Credits），折合每 1000 条约 0.05 美元。新账号赠送 20,000 Credits，大约可以读 4000 条。 3. 提供远程 MCP 服务（ Claude、Cursor 等 AI 工具，让 AI 搜索和分析推文。 4. 开源 SDK 覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Go、Java、C#、PHP、Ruby、Kotlin，另有命令行工具、n8n 节点和 Terraform Provider。 5. 搜索、时间线、粉丝等列表接口统一用 cursor 翻页。 一个请求示例： bash curl -X POST ' \ H "Authorization: Bearer $XAPISCRAPERKEY" \ H 'content-type: application/json' \ d '{"searchTerms": ["from:elonmusk"], "sortBy": "Latest", "nextcursor": ""}' 使用场景：舆情监控、竞品追踪、学术研究收集推文样本，或者让 AI Agent 定时总结某个话题的最新讨论。 说明：TwexAPI 是独立的第三方服务，与 X Corp. 无关联，只读取公开数据。 欢迎试用和反馈。

projects.summary: 我是 Chinese Gender Predictor 的维护者，自荐其中一个可以独立使用的英文工具：Lunar Age Calculator。 输入公历生日和要查询的日期，就能比较传统虚岁与周岁。工具先把两个日期转换为农历年份，再按“目标农历年 − 出生农历年 + 1”计算，而不是一律给周岁加一；页面解释了春节前后、生日和闰日带来的差异，便于向不熟悉中国历法的朋友说明这种计龄方法。 日期计算在访客浏览器内完成，不需要账号，输入的生日、日期和计算结果不会发送给统计服务。网站有可选择的访问统计，不能将它描述成完全没有统计。 同站的传统性别表只是民俗娱乐，明确说明不能用于医学判断；另有免费 A4/US Letter 派对游戏 PDF。制作过程使用了 AI 辅助，历法换算使用 lunar-javascript，计算方法和来源说明见 How it works。

projects.title: 做了个让照片替你吵架的小网站 Bad Times AI，猫狗也能上场
projects.author: fusheng0304
projects.summary: 给 AI 安排了一个非常具体的工作：替照片里的主角吵架。 比如： - 猫粮碗明明还有一半，你的猫却觉得自己快饿死了。 - 你刚说完「今天不遛了」，狗已经开始跟你据理力争。 - 刚下班，又收到一句「有个小需求」。 这些场景，大概都适合配一段 BAD TIMES 。 如果没刷到过这个梗，可以把它理解成一段很有戏的「吵架式表演」：抱头、叉腰、抬手示意「你先听我说」，再冲着镜头输出。配上音乐，整个人都写着「我今天必须把这事说清楚」。宠物版尤其有意思，狗站起来挥着爪子，像是在认真争取家庭话语权。 我围绕这个梗做了个小网站，叫 **Bad Times AI**，是个专门做这个表演的 **AI video generator**：上传一张照片，让照片里的你、猫或狗接管这段表演。不用自己拍，也不用琢磨提示词和剪辑，整个流程就是 **photo to video**。 地址： https://badtimesai.app/ 现在可以玩的内容： - **人物版**：让照片里的自己上场。 - **宠物版（ pet video ）**：把猫狗平时那种「有话要说」的表情，升级成一整段表演。 - **宝宝版**：把照片里的人变成宝宝，再一本正经地据理力争。 可以选 10 秒片段或完整版，人物和宠物完整版是 30 秒，宝宝版是 26 秒。成片带模板原声，支持下载无水印的竖屏 MP4 。首页能先看原版和宠物示例，开声音更有感觉。 里面也做了两种复刻方式：一种根据照片、音频和动作描述生成，另一种用参考视频引导动作和运镜。AI 的发挥还是有随机性，快速动作时长相、爪子和口型可能会跑偏，不能保证每次都跟原片一样。 目前最想打磨的是：让大家一眼看懂怎么玩，以及让成片里的主角更像上传的那张照片。欢迎 V 友看看，也欢迎直接指出哪里别扭。真人照片请用自己的，或征得本人同意的。 如果给你家宠物的这段表演配一句字幕，它会在跟你争什么？

projects.author: ginzberg

One of the things I'm really curious about is understanding LLM performance on subjective domains like design. As an experiment I built this game which presents two designs of the same screen, one of which was generated by AI. First you pick which one you like better and then which one you think was made by AI. Most design work happens in an existing product, so we set up this game to test that. As context, the AI gets 4 screenshots from the existing product, the product's icons + fonts, and a written brief about the screen it is asked to build. It then writes HTML which is screenshotted identically to the real screen. To get the data, we signed up for the products with test accounts and added dummy data. All of the inputs were manually checked to make sure nothing about the target screen was leaked in the prompt. You can read more about the methodology at https://www.realdesignbenchmark.com/methodology . After a few thousand submissions, the surprising result is that people prefer the AI design - 57% prefer AI, 33% prefer the real design, 10% say they are about the same. People are also not great at identifying the AI design, only 59% get it right. The initial results were all generated with Opus 5.5 (medium effort). We just added GPT-6.1 Sol (medium effort) tonight. Give the game a try. Feedback on the approach is appreciated. Or any ideas on what we might improve or try next.
